title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon MSK
descriptionHtml:
Come build the future of data streaming with the Amazon Managed Streaming for Kafka (MSK) team!

We are looking for engineers who are enthusiastic about data streaming, and are as passionate about contributing to open source as they are about solving real customers' business needs, at AWS scale.

As a member of the Amazon MSK team, you will be making contributions to the entire stack - the APIs and the workflows that make up the MSK service, the core Kafka platform, and stand-alone tools that make it easier for Kafka community to operate Kafka better. title: Supply Chain Security Compliance Specialist, Supply Chain Intellectual Property Security
descriptionHtml:
Overview: We're seeking a Security Supply Chain Assessor to help protect Amazon's global supply chain through comprehensive security assessments and risk management. This role requires international travel (up to 75%) across the APAC Regions.
The Supply Chain Security Assessor plays a critical role in evaluating and strengthening the security posture of third-party manufacturing and supplier partners across the global supply chain. This position involves conducting on-site Physical and cybersecurity assessments of supplier facilities, verifying adherence to corporate and industry security standards, and identifying risks related to data protection, software provisioning, and hardware production environments.
The ideal candidate will have deep technical expertise in cybersecurity controls, understanding of physical security controls, a strong understanding of manufacturing and supplier ecosystems, and the ability to collaborate cross-functionally with internal and external stakeholders across multiple time zones and regions.


Key job responsibilities
• Conduct on-site physical and cybersecurity assessments of suppliers and contract manufacturers across APAC.
• Evaluate supplier environments against company and industry security standards (e.g., ISO 27001, NIST 800-171, TAPA, and internal security frameworks).
• Assess security domains including but not limited to:
o Network segmentation and access control
o Data encryption and protection mechanisms
o Endpoint and server security
o Secure software provisioning and storage
o Incident response and monitoring practices
o CCTV Coverage and Monitoring
o Physical and environmental security controls
• Document findings, develop risk ratings, and provide actionable remediation guidance to suppliers.
• Partner with internal security, compliance, and supply chain teams to ensure continuous improvement of supplier risk management programs.
• Track, monitor, and verify closure of remediation actions through follow-up assessments or evidence reviews.
• Contribute to the development and enhancement of standardized assessment frameworks, methodologies, and automation tools.
• Provide training and knowledge-sharing sessions for suppliers and internal stakeholders to improve overall security maturity.
• Maintain awareness of evolving global cybersecurity regulations, threats, and best practices relevant to the manufacturing and supply chain ecosystem.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in Incident Management, Threat Management, Corporate Investigations, Law Enforcement, Security Operations, Crisis Management or a related field that involves conducting threat assessments, workplace investigations, and/or incident response
- 5+ years in cybersecurity assessments, audits, or supplier security evaluations.
- Experience performing on-site assessments or audits in manufacturing, hardware, or software supply chain environments.
- Strong knowledge of security frameworks (ISO 27001, or similar).
- Demonstrated ability to communicate complex security concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Excellent analytical, documentation, and reporting skills.
- Fluency in both Mandarin and English languages

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of supply chain operations and logistics experience
- Certifications such as CISSP, CISA, CISM, or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor.
- Experience working with or assessing suppliers in regulated industries (e.g., electronics manufacturing, cloud hardware, or software supply chain).
- Understanding of software and firmware provisioning security practices.
- Experience with risk management tools and assessment automation platforms.
- Knowledge of NIST CSF

title: Business Analyst, FBA Analytics

title: Senior Reliability Engineer, Amazon LEO
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior Reliability Engineer to join the Hardware Reliability Engineering team within the satellite development organization. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in electronics manufacturing processes, hardware reliability concepts, and reliability test practices, with a focus on ensuring the functional reliability and performance of satellite hardware systems in the harsh environment of space. You will be responsible for developing and implementing design-for-reliability best practices, conducting rigorous testing, and analyzing on-orbit data to enhance the robustness of Amazon Leo satellite hardware.

You will play an important role across key dimensions of a product’s lifecycle: design trades, product development and release, manufacturing process qualification, supply chain reliability, environmental stress screens, and on-orbit fault and failure investigations. You will be a key member of a high-performance team responsible for delivering a reliable satellite constellation.

Key job responsibilities
Reliability Analysis and Testing:
- Develop and implement reliability test plans for satellite hardware components.
- Perform stress screening, environmental testing, and drive failure analysis to ensure satellite hardware meets reliability and performance targets
- Analyze designs and test results to identify potential failure modes and mitigations.

Design and Development Support:
- Collaborate with design engineers to implement design for reliability best practices.
- Act as a key stakeholder in reviewing and approving designs for release.
- Participate in design reviews and failure mode effects analysis (FMEA) to assess potential reliability issues.

Failure Investigation and Root Cause Analysis:
- Investigate manufacturing non-conformances and field hardware failures to determine root cause. Travel as needed to perform deep dives into supplier processes.
- Develop and recommend corrective actions to address identified reliability issues.
- Maintain detailed records of failure analysis and reliability assessments.

Reliability Modeling and Simulation:
- Utilize reliability modeling and simulation tools to predict hardware performance and lifespan.
- Develop and maintain reliability prediction models and databases.

Documentation and Reporting:
- Prepare detailed reliability reports, test plans, and procedures.
- Present findings and recommendations to engineering teams and management.
- Ensure compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements for satellite hardware reliability.

Continuous Improvement:
- Stay current with industry trends, advancements, and best practices in hardware reliability engineering.
- Propose and implement process improvements to drive improvements in reliability across the program.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in developing functional specifications, design verification plans and functional test procedures
- Bachelor's degree or above in Mechanical Engineering, Materials Engineering, Reliability Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
- 5+ years of experience in hardware reliability engineering, preferably with a focus on satellite systems or space applications.
- Significant knowledge of reliability engineering principles, methods, and tools.
- Knowledge with environmental testing
- Proficiency in failure analysis techniques and materials characterization methods.
- Familiarity with electronics (PCBs, PCBAs, electronic components) and moving mechanical assemblies.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working with interdisciplinary teams to execute product design from concept to production
- Experience with the project management of technical projects
- Master's or Doctorate degree or above in Mechanical Engineering, Materials Engineering, Reliability Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
- Experience with environmental testing, including temperature cycling, vibration, highly accelerated limit testing (HALT), and highly-accelerated stress screening (HASS).
- Proficiency in Python, including NumPy, Pandas, SciPy, Plotly, and Matplotlib.
- Familiarity with PCB fabrication, SMT, and polymerics application manufacturing processes.
- Familiarity with relevant industry standards, including IPC, JEDEC, AIAA, AEC, MIL, and SMC standards.

Das Team ist stolz darauf, den Qualitätsservice zu liefern, für den Amazon weltweit bekannt ist.

Hinweis: Du musst zum Starttermin die Arbeitsberechtigung für das Beschäftigungsland haben.


Key job responsibilities
Als Amazon Operations-Praktikant:in hast du die Möglichkeit, deine analytischen Fähigkeiten in wirkungsvollen Projekten anzuwenden, die die Funktionalität und den Service von Logistikzentren, Sortierzentren und Zustellstationen verbessern. Wichtige Aspekte der Rolle umfassen:
• Abschluss von Projekten mit hoher Priorität nach höchstem Standard und Nachweis deiner Fähigkeit, Ergebnisse zu liefern
• Datenanalyse zur Identifizierung operativer Herausforderungen und Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten

• Flexibilität bei verschiedenen Arbeitszeiten und Schichtmustern nach Bedarf zeigen.
• Möglicher Umzug an den vorgesehenen Arbeitsort.


A day in the life
Unsere Praktika sind Bildungsmöglichkeiten, die es dir als unserer zukünftigen Führungskraft ermöglichen, zu entdecken, wie wir unsere Teams von Versandmitarbeiter:innen führen und entwickeln. Du tauchst in die schnelllebige, komplexe Welt unserer Logistikzentren, Sortierzentren und Zustellstationen ein und erlebst, wie unsere Führungskräfte ihre Teams einsetzen, um Kundenerwartungen zu erfüllen.
Dieses Praktikum versetzt dich ins Herz unserer Abläufe und ermöglicht es dir, den Weg einer Kundenbestellung zu verfolgen. Du erhältst einen realistischen Einblick in die Vollzeitchancen, die dich in unserem Unternehmen erwarten.
Du lernst, wie unsere Führungskräfte eine sichere, produktive Umgebung schaffen und das volle Potenzial ihrer Teams durch effektive Einbindung und Leistungsmanagement-Strategien nutzen. Das ist deine Chance, Fähigkeiten zu entwickeln, die dich zu einer lohnenden Karriere bei Amazon führen werden.

Du arbeitest mit Praktikant:innen aus der ganzen Welt zusammen, knüpfst Kontakte und nimmst an sozialen Veranstaltungen teil, um deinen Horizont zu erweitern. Du kannst auch spezialisierten Gruppen beitreten, die sich auf Bereiche wie Nachhaltigkeit konzentrieren, um deine vielfältigen Interessen zu erkunden.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer,NextGen Security, ZeroFriction
descriptionHtml:
Would you like to help implement novel approaches to how security engineers learn about the numerous Amazon applications. How about working with customers and peers from the entire range of Amazon's businesses on products that make a real difference in our Amazon Security goals? Whether you're passionate about building highly scalable and reliable systems in the cloud or a software developer who likes to solve interesting and complex business problems, Amazon Security has the challenges you are looking for.

Amazon Security is responsible for the protection of customer and corporate data. We are connected to all parts of Amazon's business and its massive, worldwide service-oriented architecture. We are looking for a Software Development Engineers who are excited about leading the technical vision and architecture for innovative, mission critical software security systems that affect how Amazon developers create and deploy software that is secure and protects Amazon's and our customers data.

Key job responsibilities
You will work with the leadership team to drive key engineering and business decisions that will automate portions of the pentest experience, driving security and builder efficiencies. Your first mission is to work with this new team to understand opportunities, and rapidly define which opportunities to address first, then build and evaluate the solutions. This will require rapid iteration with a variety of software and security teams. Since our security systems are foundational to the Amazon ecosystem, you will also have the opportunity to learn about various Amazon business including the Amazon e-Commerce websites, Prime, Alexa, and AWS.

We're looking for a creative, customer- and details-obsessed Software Development Engineer with strong software engineering fundamentals (object-oriented design, algorithms and data structures) and a good grasp of advanced systems concepts and design. You must possess strong verbal and written communication skills, be self-driven and be able to deliver high quality results in a fast-paced environment. You need to enjoy working closely with your peers of very talented engineers.

A day in the life
You'll solve complex challenges by designing and implementing scalable solutions that protect Amazon's customers and systems. You'll work with security engineering teams to transform domain expertise into software that mitigates risks at unprecedented scale. In a typical day, you might:

• Develop code that reduces manual security processes by 50% or more, enabling our teams to respond faster and more effectively
• Partner with cross-functional teams to translate intricate security requirements into elegant, high-performance software solutions
• Prototype and implement security tools that protect millions of customers and billions in transactions

You'll work in an environment that values rapid innovation, where your ideas can move from concept to production in weeks, not months. Your work directly impacts Amazon's ability to maintain the highest standards of customer trust and system resilience.

About the team
Our team will work with local and international security teams to design a greenfield product that solves the complex problem of rapidly knowing critical security details about every Amazon application. This team of problem solvers is heavily customer obsessed with a leaning toward rapid prototyping and implementation.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training and Career growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, C++, or C# including object-oriented design
- Experience in professional, non-internship software development
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
- Experience leading the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems
- Experience in development in the last 3 years

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Sr Progrm Manager Returns Carriers, Worldwide Returns and Recommerce - Reverse Logistics Services
descriptionHtml:
# Senior Program Manager, Cost & Carrier Integration – WW Reverse Logistics Services

## About the Team

Amazon's Worldwide Returns and ReCommerce (WWRR) team invents bold solutions in sustainable transportation and returns experiences that create trust and value for customers, selling partners, and shippers and benefit people and the planet.

We are an agile, innovative organization dedicated to "The Four Zeros". We constantly invent to delight customers and create long-term value while encouraging the reuse of returned product and reducing product waste. WWRR includes the full complement of business, product, program, operational, data, and software engineering teams, who work together to identify and remove defects that cause returns, reinvent the return experience, and manage the lifecycle of returned, overstock, and damaged products, with the objective of throwing nothing away.

## Role Overview

In this role within WW Reverse Logistics Services, you will own end-to-end transportation cost strategy and carrier integration across a portfolio of 6–7 carriers, including carrier-managed stores, and last-mile delivery partners. You will lead technology integrations to launch new carriers, and drive cost optimization across the US reverse logistics network.

This is a senior role within the level, requiring strategic thinking, cross-organizational influence, and the ability to operate autonomously in ambiguous, high-impact problem spaces. You will work closely with business stakeholders and technology teams across Amazon to develop scalable solutions for complex carrier and cost challenges. This role represents the are to the senior leadership regularly.

## Key Job Responsibilities

- **Own end-to-end transportation cost strategy** – Develop deep understanding of both 1P (first-party) and 3P (third-party) cost structures across the full reverse logistics lifecycle—from customer initiation through carrier pickup, sortation, and final disposition. Conduct 3P cost assessments, benchmarking external carrier rates against internal capabilities to identify optimization opportunities. Identify cost reduction initiatives by analyzing cost trends, blended rates, carrier mix, and network inefficiencies. Program manage cost workstreams across multiple carrier teams, driving alignment on shared objectives and timelines. Collaborate with Amazon carrier teams to conduct opportunity identification, influence roadmaps, and co-develop solutions that reduce cost while maintaining customer experience. Provide data-driven inputs and cost analyses to inform contract negotiations with external carriers.
- **Manage cost as a core business metric** – Own cost reporting and insights across all business reviews (WBR, MBR, QBR). Ensure cost performance is tracked, communicated, and actioned at every level—surfacing variances, root causes, and corrective actions to senior leadership on a regular cadence.
- **Lead carrier integrations and define success metrics** – Manage technology integrations for new carrier launches, ensuring technical and operational readiness across internal and external systems. Establish pre-defined launch success criteria across all CX, operational, quality, and traceability parameters. Ensure every carrier integration achieves a successful launch against these criteria before transitioning to steady-state operations excellence and performance management.
- **Drive program objectives and define key performance indicators** – Provide program management, define project plans, manage implementation activities, and develop processes, documentation, and communications for carrier integration rollouts and ongoing support. Develop and own metrics for cost, CX, loss, traceability, quality, and pickup success; track delivery against program objectives and SLAs.
- **Scale services and tools** – Design processes and procedures that scale with business growth in volume, complexity, and marketplace across carrier-managed stores and pickup networks.
- **Drive resolution of critical issues** – Support processes/systems deep dives to ensure root cause analysis and correction resulting in improved customer experience and cost outcomes.
- **Communicate programs and results** – Present new/updated programs, policies, and carrier strategies to senior leadership, employees, and cross-functional organizations.

## Basic Qualifications

- 5+ years of program or project management experience with technology usage
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience owning program strategy, end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience managing carrier relationships and/or transportation
- Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional teams and drive alignment without direct authority

## Preferred Qualifications

- 4+ years of driving process improvements experience
- 1+ years of complex Excel model or proprietary technology management experience
- Basic comfort with SQL query
- Experience with transportation management systems, carrier integration platforms, or logistics technology
- Knowledge of reverse logistics, returns processing, or last-mile delivery operations
- Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, supply chain, or related field

Key job responsibilities
Pillar 1: Transportation Cost Strategy & Optimization

This pillar represents the strategic core of the role—owning the end-to-end cost picture across the US reverse logistics network. The Senior PM develops deep understanding of both 1P and 3P cost structures across the full returns lifecycle, from customer initiation through carrier pickup, sortation, and final disposition. This includes conducting 3P cost assessments and benchmarking external carrier rates against internal capabilities, analyzing Cost per unit trends, blended rates, carrier mix, and network inefficiencies to identify and prioritize cost reduction initiatives. The role provides data-driven inputs and cost analyses to inform contract negotiations with external carriers, and collaborates with Amazon carrier teams to influence roadmaps and co-develop solutions that reduce cost while maintaining customer experience. This pillar demands analytical rigor, financial acumen, and the ability to connect operational levers to P&L outcomes.

Pillar 2: Carrier Integration & Launch Excellence

This pillar covers the end-to-end ownership of integrating new carriers into the reverse logistics ecosystem—from technical readiness through to successful launch. The Senior PM manages technology integrations across internal and external systems, ensuring operational, technical, and CX readiness before go-live. A critical component is establishing pre-defined launch success criteria across CX, operational, quality, and traceability parameters, and holding each integration accountable to those criteria before transitioning to steady-state operations excellence and performance management. This pillar requires deep cross-functional coordination with technology, operations, and business teams, and the ability to manage complexity across six to seven carriers simultaneously while maintaining high launch quality standards.

Pillar 3: Business Reviews & Performance Management

This pillar anchors the role's accountability for cost and carrier performance as core business metrics. The Senior PM owns cost reporting and insights across all business review cadences—WBR, MBR, and QBR—ensuring cost performance is tracked, communicated, and actioned at every level. This includes surfacing variances, identifying root causes, and driving corrective actions with senior leadership on a regular cadence. Beyond cost, the role develops and owns metrics for CX, loss, traceability, quality, and pickup success, tracking delivery against program objectives and SLAs. This pillar ensures that performance data drives decisions, that issues are caught early through leading indicators, and that the organization maintains a clear line of sight between operational execution and business outcomes.

A day in the life
- **Drive program objectives** – define project plans, manage implementation activities, and develop processes and communications for program rollout and ongoing support
- **Scale services and tools** – design processes that scale with business growth in volume, complexity, and marketplace
- **Define key performance indicators** – develop metrics and SLAs for core programs, and track delivery against objectives
- **Communicate** new/updated programs, policies, and processes to leaders and cross-functional organizations
- **Drive resolution of critical issues** – support deep dives to ensure root cause analysis and correction
- **Negotiate** efficient and reliable processes across partner teams to systematically eliminate dependencies and defects

Basic qualifications

- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- 3+ years of program or project management experience
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of driving process improvements experience
- Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
- Knowledge of general AI tools
- Experience designing, implementing, and scaling upskilling, apprenticeship, or workforce development programs across large-scale operations or corporate environments, including forecasting workforce needs and leveraging analytics to drive program decisions

descriptionHtml:
Bitte beachte: Wir haben verschiedene Möglichkeiten in ganz Deutschland und benötigen Flexibilität bezüglich der Standorte. Wenn du dich für die Stelle bewirbst, gib bitte alle deine bevorzugten Standorte in Deutschland an.

Amazon Operations ist das Rückgrat der Amazon-Kundenerfahrung. Mit über 50 Logistikzentren, hunderten von Zustellstationen und zehntausenden von Versandmitarbeiter:innen arbeitet das Team zusammen, um Artikel effizient an Kund:innen zu liefern. In den Logistikzentren werden jährlich Millionen von Artikeln kommissioniert und verpackt, während die Zustellteams daran arbeiten, Bestellungen pünktlich an die Kund:innen zu bringen. Sicherheit hat oberste Priorität, und die Betriebskultur ist geprägt von Teamwork, Vielfalt und einer gemeinsamen Arbeitsethik, die das Geschäft reibungslos am Laufen hält. Das Team ist stolz darauf, den Qualitätsservice zu liefern, für den Amazon weltweit bekannt ist.


Hinweis: Du musst zum Starttermin die Arbeitsberechtigung für das Beschäftigungsland haben.

Key job responsibilities
Als Amazon Operations-Praktikant:in hast du die Möglichkeit, deine analytischen Fähigkeiten in wirkungsvollen Projekten anzuwenden, die die Funktionalität und den Service von Logistikzentren, Sortierzentren und Zustellstationen verbessern. Wichtige Aspekte der Rolle umfassen:

• Abschluss von Projekten mit hoher Priorität nach höchstem Standard und Nachweis deiner Fähigkeit, Ergebnisse zu liefern
• Datenanalyse zur Identifizierung operativer Herausforderungen und Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten
• Vorschlagen und Testen von Lösungen in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Team zur Umsetzung der effektivsten Ansätze
• Entwicklung von Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeiten durch die Zusammenarbeit mit Führungskräften, Stakeholdern und Versandmitarbeiter:innen.
• Bewegung im Gebäude, um mit verschiedenen Teams zu interagieren. Das umfasst aktives Wissenssammeln durch Teilnahme an Aktivitäten wie Vorbesprechungen, Ablaufmeetings und Diskussionen mit dem Führungsteam und Versandmitarbeiter:innen.
• Die Fähigkeit, sich im Arbeitsbereich zu orientieren und zwischen verschiedenen Bereichen zu wechseln, ist für diese Position unerlässlich.
• Flexibilität bei verschiedenen Arbeitszeiten und Schichtmustern nach Bedarf zeigen.
• Möglicher Umzug an den vorgesehenen Arbeitsort.

A day in the life
Unsere Praktika sind Bildungsmöglichkeiten, die es dir als unserer zukünftigen Führungskraft ermöglichen, zu entdecken, wie wir unsere Teams von Versandmitarbeiter:innen führen und entwickeln. Du tauchst in die schnelllebige, komplexe Welt unserer Logistikzentren, Sortierzentren und Zustellstationen ein und erlebst, wie unsere Führungskräfte ihre Teams einsetzen, um Kundenerwartungen zu erfüllen.

Dieses Praktikum versetzt dich ins Herz unserer Abläufe und ermöglicht es dir, den Weg einer Kundenbestellung zu verfolgen. Du erhältst einen realistischen Einblick in die Vollzeitchancen, die dich in unserem Unternehmen erwarten.

Du lernst, wie unsere Führungskräfte eine sichere, produktive Umgebung schaffen und das volle Potenzial ihrer Teams durch effektive Einbindung und Leistungsmanagement-Strategien nutzen. Das ist deine Chance, Fähigkeiten zu entwickeln, die dich zu einer lohnenden Karriere bei Amazon führen werden.

About the team
Praktikant:innen-Community:

• Als Amazon-Praktikant:in bist du Teil einer lebendigen, unterstützenden Community, die dein Wachstum und deine Entwicklung fördert. Du arbeitest mit Praktikant:innen aus der ganzen Welt zusammen, knüpfst Kontakte und nimmst an sozialen Veranstaltungen teil, um deinen Horizont zu erweitern. Du kannst auch spezialisierten Gruppen beitreten, die sich auf Bereiche wie Nachhaltigkeit konzentrieren, um deine vielfältigen Interessen zu erkunden.
Unterstützung:
• Das Praktikumsprogramm bietet ein robustes Unterstützungssystem, einschließlich wöchentlicher Praktikant:innen-Sprechstunden, spezieller IT- und HR-Unterstützung sowie einem Programmteam, das sich deinem Erfolg verschrieben hat. Das stellt sicher, dass du die Anleitung und Hilfe hast, die du zum Gedeihen brauchst.
Lernsessions:
• Exklusive Lernsessions werden deine Fähigkeiten weiter verbessern und dir Zugang zu Amazons modernsten Lernplattformen und der Expertise von Branchenführern gewähren. Diese strukturierten Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten bereiten dich auf den nächsten Schritt in deiner Karriere vor.
Möglichkeiten:

Zusätzlich erhältst du ein wettbewerbsfähiges Monatsgehalt, Umzugsunterstützung und Zugang zu einer Reihe von Mitarbeitervorteilen.
Praktikums-Starttermine über das Jahr:

Amazon is seeking customer focused individuals eager to develop a collaborative leadership style with a team of hourly employees across our Operations network! Our warehouses are fast-paced supply chain environments where standing, walking, and having on-the-production floor conversations are common.

As an Area Manager Intern, you will have the opportunity to learn how to coach, motivate and mentor a team of Amazon associates in a warehouse environment. Amazon provides extensive training and development to become an exceptional people leader. Your main focus will be learning to manage a team as well as developing a summer project in partnership with your site leadership.

Key job responsibilities
• Learn to coach, manage and develop a team of 50-100 Amazon Associates.
• Drive standard work and continuous improvement through an intern project.
• Work independently and operate in an autonomous environment.
• Stand/walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours.
• Willing and able to regularly work shift patterns that include nights, weekends, and/or holidays based on business needs. While shifts vary site to site, most follow a fixed 4-day work week with 3 days off.

A day in the life
As an Area Manager intern, no two days look exactly the same, but every shift gives you the chance to learn how to lead a team, solve real problems, and directly impact how millions of customers receive their orders.

Start of Shift: Set the Tone
• Shadow a current Area Manager and begin to:
• Get a handoff from the outgoing manager and review what's carrying over so nothing falls through the cracks.
• Lead a team huddle to kick off the shift. Huddles are used to align on goals, safety priorities, and key focus areas.
• Confirm your team is in place, positioned for success, and ready to go before operations begin.

Middle of Shift: Lead from the Floor
• Walk the floor regularly to stay connected to your team, spot issues early, and keep things running smoothly.
• Drive results across safety, quality, and productivity — balancing all three in real time.
• Adjust staffing and resources as volume and priorities shift throughout the day.
• Coach and develop your team members, respond to challenges as they come up, and partner with support teams to remove roadblocks.
• Keep peers and leadership informed on how the shift is tracking and flag risks before they become problems.
• Develop your internship project.

End of Shift: Close Strong
• Do a final walkthrough to make sure your area is clean, organized, and set up for the next team's success.
• Review your shift's performance data and capture what went well and what to improve
• Hand off to the incoming manager with a clear picture of priorities, open items, and next steps.
• Wrap up any remaining administrative tasks so you leave the shift with a clean slate.

Every shift, you'll see the direct results of your leadership: from the energy of your team to the packages that reach customers' doorsteps. This is where your decisions have real, visible impact.

title: Duales Studium - BWL
descriptionHtml:
Ein Job im Operations-Bereich bei Amazon versetzt dich ins Zentrum dessen, wie Dinge vom Klick bis zur Haustür gelangen. Du hilfst dabei, Systeme zu entwerfen, zu verbessern und zu betreiben, die Menschen, Produkte und Orte miteinander verbinden – und das in großem Maßstab. Du übernimmst früh Verantwortung, arbeitest eng mit Teams zusammen, um reale Herausforderungen zu lösen, und siehst die direkten Ergebnisse deiner Entscheidungen, wenn sie täglich bei den Kunden ankommen. Hier ist die Wirkung dessen, was du aufbaust, nicht abstrakt – sie ist sichtbar, unmittelbar und bedeutsam – und hält eine der komplexesten Betriebsorganisationen der Welt am Laufen. Hier nimmt deine Reise Gestalt an – durch Handeln, Verantwortung und die Möglichkeit, in viele Richtungen zu wachsen

Dein Einstieg in die Führung - Das Duale Studium bei Amazon
- Studiengang: BWL / Logistikmanagement (B.A.)
- Studienpartner: IU Internationale Hochschule (30+ Standorte deutschlandweit)
- Programmbeginn: 1. August 2027
- Dauer: 3,5 Jahre
- Einsatzorte: mehr als 20 Amazon-Standorte in Deutschland (Fulfillment Center und Sort Center)
Das duale Studium bei Amazon ist ein strukturiertes Führungsentwicklungsprogramm, das dich Schritt für Schritt auf eine operative Führungsrolle vorbereitet. Wer das Programm erfolgreich abschließt, hat die Chance direkt eine Position als Area Manager:in in unserem Netzwerk zu bekommen - ohne weiteres Bewerbungsverfahren.
________________________________________
Drei Phasen auf dem Weg zur Führungskraft
Das Programm ist in drei aufeinander aufbauende Phasen gegliedert, die deinen Verantwortungsbereich kontinuierlich erweitern.
Phase 1 - Operative Grundlagen: Zunächst lernst du die operativen Abläufe im Fulfillment Center von Grund auf kennen, analysierst Kennzahlen und setzt eigenständig Projekte zur Prozessverbesserung um.
Phase 2 - Rotation & Führungsentwicklung: Anschließend rotierst du durch verschiedene operative Bereiche, übernimmst schrittweise Führungsaufgaben - von der Begleitung der Team Leads über Schichtplanung bis hin zur Personalsteuerung - und entwickelst ein Verständnis für bereichsübergreifende Zusammenhänge.
Phase 3 - Area-Manager-Niveau: In der Abschlussphase arbeitest du auf Area-Manager-Niveau: Du steuerst operative Kennzahlen, führst Teams eigenständig und trägst echte Verantwortung für deinen Bereich.

Das bieten wir dir
• Karriereperspektive: Nach erfolgreichem Abschluss des Programms wechselst du direkt in eine Area Manager Position im Amazon-Netzwerk - ohne erneutes Bewerbungsverfahren
• Studienfinanzierung: Amazon übernimmt die Studiengebühren an der IU
• Mentoring: Strukturierte Begleitung durch Learning Manager:in und operative Führungskräfte
• Netzwerk: Zugang zu einem europaweiten Operations-Netzwerk
• Mobilität: Kostenloses Deutschlandticket
• Verpflegung: Bezuschusste Mahlzeiten am Standort
• Mitarbeitervorteile: Vielfältige Vorteile, wie ein Amazon Mitarbeiterrabatt
• Technologie: Arbeite täglich mit modernster Automatisierungs- und Robotiktechnologie"

Key job responsibilities
• Analyse und Optimierung operativer Prozesse in Fulfillment- und Sortierbereichen
• Eigenständige Durchführung von Continuous Improvement Projekten mit messbaren Ergebnissen
• Übernahme von Führungsaufgaben im Rahmen von Lead-Rotationen (Schichtverantwortung, Teamsteuerung, KPI-Management)
• Mitarbeit an bereichsübergreifenden Projekten in den Bereichen Arbeitssicherheit, Prozessoptimierung, Personalwesen und Technik
• Vorbereitung auf die eigenständige Steuerung eines operativen Bereichs als Area Manager:in
• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit einem internationalen Team innerhalb des europäischen Amazon-Netzwerks

A day in the life
Deine Betreuung im Programm
Du bist nicht allein. Während des gesamten Programms wirst du von zwei Seiten unterstützt:
• Dein:e Learning Manager:in am Standort begleitet dich durch alle drei Phasen, ist deine zentrale Ansprechperson und koordiniert deine Entwicklung
• Operative Führungskräfte mentoren dich während deiner Rotationen und geben dir direktes Feedback aus der Praxis
Zusätzlich bist du Teil einer deutschlandweiten Community dualer Student:innen - ein Netzwerk, das mit dir wächst.

________________________________________
Dein Alltag: Theorie und Praxis im Wochentakt
Das Studium läuft parallel zur Praxis - keine langen Blockphasen, sondern ein wöchentlicher Rhythmus:
• 2 Tage Studium an deinem IU-Standort (Logistik, Supply Chain, BWL, Personalführung)
• 2-3 Tage / 20 Stunden im Amazon Fulfillment Center oder Sort Center

Du bist kein Besucher im Betrieb. Du bist Teil des Teams - von Tag eins an.

Basic qualifications

- Allgemeine Hochschulreife, Fachhochschulreife / fachgebundene Hochschulreife
- Fließende Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (C1-Niveau)
- Fortgeschrittene Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (B2-Niveau)
- Affinität für das Fach Mathematik
- Umgang mit MS-Office (insbesondere Kenntnisse in Excel, Word und PowerPoint)

Preferred qualifications

- Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit
- Eigeninitiative, Vorbildfunktion und „Hands-on-Mentalität"
- Interesse, Führungsverantwortung zu tragen

title: Delivery Station Customer Service Associate, SDS
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, our mission is to be Earth’s most customer-centric company. To achieve this goal, we strive to exceed expectations by innovating and providing best-in-class customer support as we expand our logistics products and services including improving how we fulfill and deliver customer orders. We’re making history and the good news is that we’ve only just begun. At Amazon you get to Work with smart, passionate people who are building new products and services every day on behalf of our customers.

As a Delivery Station Customer Service Associate, you will help improve the customer experience by providing in station real-time, hands-on support to ensure our customers receive their packages on time, as promised. The role will also help connect customers with experts who can provide them the most accurate and up-to-date information about their packages. The work is beyond fulfilling and delivering customer orders; it’s making sure we put smiles on customer’s faces.


Key job responsibilities
As a Delivery Station Customer Service Associate, you will be responsible for:
- Communicating with customers directly in-person, in addition to communicating via phone and email
- Empathizing with and prioritizing customer needs
- Upholding company values and respecting every customer
- Resolving issues and setting appropriate expectations with customers
- Clearly understanding and responding appropriately to the issues that customers present
- Consistently composing grammatically correct, concise, and accurate written responses to customer issues
- Approaching problems logically and with good judgment to ensure the appropriate customer outcome
- Making quick and effective decisions on behalf of the customer
- Working a flexible Full-Time (40+ hours per week) schedule

Performing the following tasks, with or without reasonable accommodation:
- Carry, lift, push and pull up to 49 pounds
- Frequently push, pull, squat, bend and reach
- Stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud (hearing protection will be provided)
- Work in an environment where the temperature may vary due to outside weather conditions and is not controlled

A day in the life
You’ll be based at one of our last-mile delivery warehouses, where Amazon’s leading logistics system operates. As orders are dispatched and delivered, you’ll be in contact with our warehouse, associates, delivery partners and customers when they need guidance. Where a customer needs to reschedule a delivery, you’ll be informing our delivery partners. Where you notice a delivery issue, you’ll get to work resolving it straight away, so that our customers get a great experience every time without having to contact Amazon.

Operating at the heart of Amazon’s logistics, you’ll develop logistical and customer expertise that sets Amazon apart. You’ll connect with our customers every day, using your in-depth understanding of our supply chain and local knowledge of delivery connections and warehouses.


About the team
Our mission is to be Earth’s most customer-centric company, and few departments have as direct an impact on that mission as our Customer Service team. We're an inclusive team who empower and look after our people, so they have the time and energy to focus on our customers’ happiness. Our goal is to reduce customer effort every way we can, helping them get the best results quickly and efficiently. We support our self-service channels to offer expert insights into our customers’ most complex issues.

Within Customer Service, there are opportunities in process improvement, customer experience, data analysis and customer retention. The CS team is always looking for ways to make Amazon’s customer service even better, and we need excellent people to make that happen.

- High school or equivalent
- Experience in Customer Service
- Experience working with computers and Microsoft Office (including Outlook, Word, and Excel)
- Experience prioritizing and managing time effectively in dynamic environments
- Experience with basic web-based tools and products like Outlook, Excel, Word and SharePoint

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience in understanding performance metrics and developing them to measure progress against key performance indicators
- Experience with written and verbal communication and presentation
- Experience working on a merchandising/brand ambassador team for a nationally recognized consumer brand

title: Sr. Applied Scientist, Fauna
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a Sr. Applied Scientist to focus on Robot Navigation. In this role, you'll research and develop advanced navigation systems that enable robots to move reliably and safely through complex, dynamic environments. You'll work across a broad spectrum of navigation approaches—from classical methods to learning-based techniques and foundation models—to build robust solutions for autonomous robot navigation.

Key job responsibilities
- Develop and implement robust navigation systems that enable reliable autonomous operation in complex, dynamic indoor environments with static and dynamic obstacles
- Build simulation-based and on-device evaluation frameworks with comprehensive benchmarks and metrics for systematic comparison of navigation methods
- Conduct sim-to-real transfer experiments, analyzing performance gaps and developing techniques to ensure reliable real-world navigation performance
- Collaborate with world model, manipulation, and other teams to ensure seamless integration of navigation capabilities into the full robot system
- Stay current with the latest advances in robot navigation, spatial reasoning, and related fields, and apply relevant findings to improve system performance
- Mentor fellow scientists and engineers while maintaining strong individual technical contributions

About the team
Fauna Robotics, an Amazon company, is building capable, safe, and genuinely delightful robots for everyday life. Our goal is simple: make robots people actually want to live and interact with in everyday human spaces.
We believe that future won’t arrive until building for robotics becomes far more accessible. Today, too much effort is spent reinventing the fundamentals. We’re changing that by developing tightly integrated hardware and software systems that make it faster, safer, and more intuitive to create real-world robotic products.
Our work spans the full stack: mechanical design, control systems, dynamic modeling, and intelligent software. The focus is not just functionality, but experience. We’re building robots that feel responsive, expressive, and genuinely useful.
At Fauna, you’ll work at the frontier of this space, helping define how robots move, manipulate, and interact with people in natural environments. It’s an opportunity to solve hard problems across hardware and software with a team focused on making robotics accessible and joyful to build.
If you care about making robotics real for everyone and building systems that are as delightful as they are capable, we’re interested in hearing from you.

Basic qualifications

- PhD, or Master's degree and 6+ years of applied research experience
- 3+ years of industry or academic research experience
- Strong publication record at major Robotics/ML/AI conferences (e.g., RSS, CoRL, ICRA, IROS, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR)
- Experience programming in Python, C++,or related language
- Experience with sim-to-real transfer for robotic systems
- Demonstrated track record of leading technical projects
- Experience mentoring junior scientists/engineers

Preferred qualifications

- History of impactful first-author publications at major conferences
- Experience bridging research with practical engineering implementation in robotics systems
- Experience with visual navigation, semantic navigation, or foundation models applied to robot navigation
- Experience evaluating and benchmarking multiple navigation approaches (classical, learning-based, foundation model-based)
- Experience with reinforcement learning for legged robot control (e.g., locomotion policies, terrain-adaptive gaits, or agile movement)

Annapurna Labs stands at the forefront of hardware/software co-design, leading innovation not just within Amazon Web Services (AWS) but across the entire industry. We design and build every component of our hardware and software to create best-in-class machine learning products that accelerate customer workloads through industry leading hardware using our custom silicon solutions. If you're passionate about building the highest-performing, hardware-accelerated Machine Learning systems and want to be part of the entire journey from pre- through post-silicon development, Annapurna Labs offers an exceptional career opportunity. Join us in shaping the future of AI acceleration

We're seeking an experienced C/C++ engineer to join our embedded software team, where you'll develop bare metal firmware that drives neural network model execution across our custom ASIC-based ML Accelerator chips.

Working at the intersection of hardware and software, you'll collaborate closely with our architecture and design teams to design and implement firmware and custom hardware that enables machine learning within our accelerator chips. Our mission is ambitious: to democratize access to industry-leading ML infrastructure and make deep learning capabilities accessible to everyday software developers. The Annapurna Labs team operates with the agility and culture of a startup, but with the full weight of Amazon behind us and we invite you visit the link below for a glimpse inside our labs to see exactly the incredible technology and people you will work with at Annapurna Labs!

descriptionHtml:
We are looking for an experienced Operations Lead to drive operational excellence across our London studio. In this role, you will own the day-to-day operational rhythm of the studio — overseeing workflow, production planning, capacity management, and performance tracking to ensure we consistently meet our quality and productivity targets.

You will lead a team of Operations Associates, ensuring resources are in place to meet daily production goals while coordinating directly with creative teams, production leads, and cross-functional partners. You will be responsible for forecasting volumes, planning capacity against demand, and reacting quickly to shifting priorities — building contingency plans that keep production on track.

You will ensure standard operating procedures are followed, identify inefficiencies in workflow, and drive a culture of continuous improvement. You'll collaborate with regional peers, sharing best practices and delivering scalable operating procedures that maintain rigour as the studio grows.

Key job responsibilities
Lead a team of Operations Associates supporting studio logistics, volume processing, and daily production goals
Own the planning and flow of product and assets through all stages of the studio workflow, from sample intake through to final delivery.
Support annual and quarterly planning cycles for volume, productivity, and goals; track progress through continuous inspection and iteration, working through obstacles and gaining stakeholder support.
Support monthly and quarterly financial analysis for the studio.
Ensure studio KPIs are met on a weekly and monthly basis — inspecting metrics, identifying risks early, and driving corrective action.
Use data and systems to track, forecast, and plan for volume and product flow requiring stills and videos.
Drive a culture of continuous improvement — contributing Kaizen expertise, collecting and analysing data, and testing solutions for process improvements and new initiatives.
Regularly report key productivity and quality metrics to studio leadership and stakeholders.
Build and scale process-related solutions with measurable metric impact through automation and cross-team adoption.

title: Critical Infrastructure Controls Engineer, Data Center Field Engineering
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

As an Amazon Field Engineer you will support critical infrastructure in AWS data centers. This support will span the full building lifecycle from design and construction reviews for new sites to upgrades and maintenance standards for existing ones. As the primary engineering resource for your region, you will apply your subject matter expertise to troubleshoot critical failures, conduct Root Cause Analyses, and develop corrective actions. You will own conceptual designs for capacity, availability, and efficiency improvements, lead engineering audits, and provide technical escalation support for sites in operation. Working across Data Center Operations, Design Engineering, Hardware Engineering, Health & Safety, and partner Controls teams, you will drive standards that ensure consistency and reliability fleet-wide, while managing concurrent projects that may span multiple geographic regions.

Key job responsibilities
• Lead post-event engineering analysis for controls-related incidents — including root-cause investigations, technical field reports, and time-sensitive reviews — and identify recurring failure patterns to develop corrective actions and reliability improvements across the facility portfolio.
• Develop, review, and maintain controls logic and reusable code templates for mechanical and electrical equipment, ensuring alignment with approved Sequences of Operations and deployment readiness across air-handling units, cooling systems, chillers, pumps, and electrical infrastructure.
• Own the full engineering lifecycle for legacy controls first of kind pilots, from request intake and technical review through field execution, results analysis, and go/no-go recommendations for broader rollout.
• Serve as the technical escalation point for complex controls issues that exceed existing procedures or support models, including traveling to facilities to support investigations and developing corrective actions. Review controls drawings, wiring diagrams, network topologies, equipment submittals, and deployed configurations to identify risks related to reliability, operability, and maintainability.
• Provide engineering support for proprietary and third-party controls products by aggregating design update proposals and partnering with product and partner Controls teams to drive bug fixes and continuous improvement.
• Build and maintain technical baselines, including test scripts, points lists, naming conventions, alarm thresholds, setpoints, code libraries, and engineering playbooks.
• Develop engineering standards and system-health metrics that improve control system reliability and standardization across the facility portfolio.
• Partner with facility operations, Commissioning, Design Engineering, Technical Program Managers, and partner Controls teams to resolve technical issues.

A day in the life
Each day you will interact with different teams responsible for all aspects of the data centers. You will prioritize your activities to support data center capacity availability and safety focusing on the actions that are most impactful. You will have the opportunity to work on projects locally and globally.

If you meet these qualifications, exude passion, and enjoy the challenge of innovative projects at hyper-scale, this job is for you!

About the team
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. Basic qualifications

- Experience reading and editing construction documents (design drawings, control diagrams, specifications, etc.)
- 2+ cumulative years of controls experience with industrial, municipal, or commercial engineering including but not limited to the following sectors: data centers, power generation, oil/gas facilities
- Bachelor’s degree in Controls Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Automation Engineering, Computer Engineering, or an equivalent technical degree or experience.
- Must have a valid US driver's license and reliable personal transportation by start date.

Preferred qualifications

- Hands-on experience with BMS,BAS, SCADA, PLC, or power monitoring platforms and industrial communication protocols such as BACnet, Modbus, MQTT, or OPC.
- Familiarity with mechanical and electrical systems including cooling (chillers, CRAHs, AHUs), power distribution (switchgear, UPS, generators, VFDs, ATSs), pumps, sensors, and field I/O.
- Experience writing and standardizing controls code (Python, structured text, ladder logic, function block), building reusable templates, and managing version control across multiple sites or equipment types.
- Proficiency using Python, SQL, and visualization tools to analyze time-series data from BMS, EPMS, SCADA, or historians, and building dashboards or pipelines to support system health monitoring and root-cause analysis.

title: Duales Studium - BWL
descriptionHtml:
Ein Job im Operations-Bereich bei Amazon versetzt dich ins Zentrum dessen, wie Dinge vom Klick bis zur Haustür gelangen. Du hilfst dabei, Systeme zu entwerfen, zu verbessern und zu betreiben, die Menschen, Produkte und Orte miteinander verbinden – und das in großem Maßstab. Du übernimmst früh Verantwortung, arbeitest eng mit Teams zusammen, um reale Herausforderungen zu lösen, und siehst die direkten Ergebnisse deiner Entscheidungen, wenn sie täglich bei den Kunden ankommen. Hier ist die Wirkung dessen, was du aufbaust, nicht abstrakt – sie ist sichtbar, unmittelbar und bedeutsam – und hält eine der komplexesten Betriebsorganisationen der Welt am Laufen. Hier nimmt deine Reise Gestalt an – durch Handeln, Verantwortung und die Möglichkeit, in viele Richtungen zu wachsen Dein Einstieg in die Führung - Das Duale Studium bei Amazon
- Studiengang: BWL / Logistikmanagement (B.A.)
- Studienpartner: IU Internationale Hochschule (30+ Standorte deutschlandweit)
- Programmbeginn: 1. August 2027
- Dauer: 3,5 Jahre
- Einsatzorte: mehr als 20 Amazon-Standorte in Deutschland (Fulfillment Center und Sort Center)
Das duale Studium bei Amazon ist ein strukturiertes Führungsentwicklungsprogramm, das dich Schritt für Schritt auf eine operative Führungsrolle vorbereitet. Wer das Programm erfolgreich abschließt, hat die Chance direkt eine Position als Area Manager:in in unserem Netzwerk zu bekommen - ohne weiteres Bewerbungsverfahren.
________________________________________
Drei Phasen auf dem Weg zur Führungskraft
Das Programm ist in drei aufeinander aufbauende Phasen gegliedert, die deinen Verantwortungsbereich kontinuierlich erweitern.
Phase 1 - Operative Grundlagen: Zunächst lernst du die operativen Abläufe im Fulfillment Center von Grund auf kennen, analysierst Kennzahlen und setzt eigenständig Projekte zur Prozessverbesserung um.
Phase 2 - Rotation & Führungsentwicklung: Anschließend rotierst du durch verschiedene operative Bereiche, übernimmst schrittweise Führungsaufgaben - von der Begleitung der Team Leads über Schichtplanung bis hin zur Personalsteuerung - und entwickelst ein Verständnis für bereichsübergreifende Zusammenhänge.
Phase 3 - Area-Manager-Niveau: In der Abschlussphase arbeitest du auf Area-Manager-Niveau: Du steuerst operative Kennzahlen, führst Teams eigenständig und trägst echte Verantwortung für deinen Bereich.

Das bieten wir dir
• Karriereperspektive: Nach erfolgreichem Abschluss des Programms wechselst du direkt in eine Area Manager Position im Amazon-Netzwerk - ohne erneutes Bewerbungsverfahren
• Studienfinanzierung: Amazon übernimmt die Studiengebühren an der IU
• Mentoring: Strukturierte Begleitung durch Learning Manager:in und operative Führungskräfte
• Netzwerk: Zugang zu einem europaweiten Operations-Netzwerk
• Mobilität: Kostenloses Deutschlandticket
• Verpflegung: Bezuschusste Mahlzeiten am Standort
• Mitarbeitervorteile: Vielfältige Vorteile, wie ein Amazon Mitarbeiterrabatt
• Technologie: Arbeite täglich mit modernster Automatisierungs- und Robotiktechnologie

Key job responsibilities
• Analyse und Optimierung operativer Prozesse in Fulfillment- und Sortierbereichen
• Eigenständige Durchführung von Continuous Improvement Projekten mit messbaren Ergebnissen
• Übernahme von Führungsaufgaben im Rahmen von Lead-Rotationen (Schichtverantwortung, Teamsteuerung, KPI-Management)
• Mitarbeit an bereichsübergreifenden Projekten in den Bereichen Arbeitssicherheit, Prozessoptimierung, Personalwesen und Technik
• Vorbereitung auf die eigenständige Steuerung eines operativen Bereichs als Area Manager:in
• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit einem internationalen Team innerhalb des europäischen Amazon-Netzwerks

A day in the life
Deine Betreuung im Programm
Du bist nicht allein. Während des gesamten Programms wirst du von zwei Seiten unterstützt:
• Dein:e Learning Manager:in am Standort begleitet dich durch alle drei Phasen, ist deine zentrale Ansprechperson und koordiniert deine Entwicklung
• Operative Führungskräfte mentoren dich während deiner Rotationen und geben dir direktes Feedback aus der Praxis
Zusätzlich bist du Teil einer deutschlandweiten Community dualer Student:innen - ein Netzwerk, das mit dir wächst.

________________________________________
Dein Alltag: Theorie und Praxis im Wochentakt
Das Studium läuft parallel zur Praxis - keine langen Blockphasen, sondern ein wöchentlicher Rhythmus:
• 2 Tage Studium an deinem IU-Standort (Logistik, Supply Chain, BWL, Personalführung)
• 2-3 Tage / 20 Stunden im Amazon Fulfillment Center oder Sort Center

Du bist kein Besucher im Betrieb. Du bist Teil des Teams - von Tag eins an.

Basic qualifications

- Allgemeine Hochschulreife, Fachhochschulreife / fachgebundene Hochschulreife
- Fließende Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (C1-Niveau)
- Fortgeschrittene Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (B2-Niveau)
- Affinität für das Fach Mathematik
- Umgang mit MS-Office (insbesondere Kenntnisse in Excel, Word und PowerPoint)

Preferred qualifications

- Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit
- Eigeninitiative, Vorbildfunktion und „Hands-on-Mentalität"
- Interesse, Führungsverantwortung zu tragen

title: Senior Applied Scientist, Leo Security
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband network connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world.

We are looking for an Applied Scientist to be a founding scientist on the Engineering and R\&D team within Leo Infrastructure and IP Security. The team defends the manufacturing lines, launch sites, and global ground infrastructure behind the constellation from the most sophisticated threat actors on the planet. These requirements create open scientific problems at the intersection of agentic AI, real-time stream processing, graph-based reasoning, and behavioral analytics. You will build the science behind a neurosymbolic reasoning platform and the models that detect the behavior of sophisticated threat actors. This is an R\&D role with a production mandate, where you define the problem rather than solve a pre-scoped one, and every model, detection, and agent workflow you build becomes the system Leo's security teams use to protect the constellation.

#### Export Control Requirement

Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen.


Key job responsibilities
- Design and implement scalable, production-grade neurosymbolic systems that integrate symbolic reasoning over graph-based knowledge representations with LLM agents to deliver reliable, verifiable security outcomes.
- Design and run reinforcement learning and fine-tuning pipelines (GRPO, PPO, DPO) to optimize language models for security reasoning, triage, and detection-authoring tasks.
- Build behavioral and statistical models that detect threat actor behavior, and design the evaluation frameworks that measure model performance against that behavior before trusting a model in production.
- Design and build multi-agent systems that autonomously triage, enrich, and contain security events, including the constrained reasoning, safety guardrails, and validation mechanisms that make automated decisions trustworthy at scale.
- Own the end-to-end science lifecycle, from research and experimentation through production deployment, defining the metrics that measure system performance and real-world security impact.
- Advance the state of the art through publications at top-tier venues, patents, or open-source contributions, and shape the scientific agenda and research culture from day one.


A day in the life
You will move between research and production in the same week: framing an ambiguous security problem as a scientific question, prototyping an approach, and partnering with software engineers to ship it as a capability the platform runs continuously. Security engineers on your team translate threat intelligence into the adversary behaviors that matter; you build the models that detect those behaviors and evaluate model performance against them. You will obsess over the two latencies that define the platforms, the time from event to detection and the time from detection to containment action, and design agents and detections that drive both down. You will backtest candidate detections against retained telemetry, review evaluation results before a model or agent capability graduates to automated execution, and deliver scientific artifacts that ship.


About the team
Leo Infrastructure and IP Security protects the people, facilities, hardware, and supply chain behind a global satellite constellation. The Engineering and R\&D team within this organization builds the platforms and tooling the security pillar teams operate on, moving security operations from manual triage to correlation-based detection, automated response, and agentic AI. The team is composed of applied scientists, software engineers, and security engineers working across physical and digital security domains.

#### Inclusive Team Culture

In Amazon Security, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

#### Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of building machine learning models for business application experience
- PhD, or Master's degree and 6+ years of applied research experience
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- Experience with neural deep learning methods and machine learning
- - Experience with graph algorithms, knowledge graphs, unsupervised learning (clustering, dimensionality reduction, anomaly detection), NLP, and embedding-based retrieval
- - Experience designing evaluation frameworks for AI systems where ground truth requires human judgment, including staged rollouts, A/B testing, and expert feedback loops

Preferred qualifications

title: Finance Manager, Customer Service Finance
descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to drive global financial excellence and operational improvement at Amazon? We're looking for a Finance Manager who can deliver world class financial and business partnership across the spectrum of roles we interact with including VPs, Directors, Engineers, Technical Product Managers and Associates. We need someone able to translate complex customer and operational metrics into clear global financial narratives and guide business decisions based on customer experience and return on investment reasoning. This role requires someone who can consolidate multiple workstreams into a cohesive global financial story while providing support to partner finance teams and strategic guidance to leadership.

As a Finance Manager in the Customer Service Network Solutions (NS) team, you'll build mechanisms to support your business partners in defining the optimum strategy to drive world class customer experience, associate experience and cost-to-serve performance. You will support the teams in making well-educated financial decisions and ensure investments are realizing the appropriate return. You will also play a critical role in articulating your business partners performance and progress across other CS Finance teams, developing deep cross team relationships and ensuring accuracy in your business partner's commitments into WW CS staffing plans. You'll ensure accuracy of financial submissions, deliver monthly financial reviews to senior leaders, flag risks and opportunities, and guide course corrections to achieve and exceed financial goals. This position offers a strong mix between global project and strategic finance whilst requiring a deep knowledge of controllership and will require strong executive presence and backbone skills.

Key job responsibilities
This role will support either Planning Intelligence (PI), the technology brain that decides how CS plans and routes work or Network Strategy & Planning Performance (PP) who designs the strategy that decides where and how CS's physical network serves customers
The role will build and maintain robust mechanisms with the Directors, engineering partners and planning orchestrators within NS to track accurate financial performance vs commitments and provide network financial performance visibility to NS teams.
Deliver comprehensive monthly worldwide financial reviews to senior leadership, incorporating clear narratives and actionable insights that drive business decisions.
Partner with WW FP&A on ensuring storylines flow correctly from Network Solutions to wider teams.
Collaborate with Global CS Finance teams working in both Demand reduction and Supply Optimization, ensuring proper alignment of operational metrics and financial outcomes.
Own analysis and mechanism development for translating engineering commitments into operational plans, leading to cost improvements through lower supply hiring.
Partner with the other Network Solution Finance team members in collaborating with Science and Economist teams to develop a robust customer value cost process to understand customer lifetime value from solutions built.

A day in the life
Your day starts with reviewing network performance (productivity metrics) and system performances for your appropriate team. You'll have daily connects with your Director, PMTs, PMs, SDEs and Planners to fully immerse yourself in their project progress and help guide prioritization decisions. You will then spend time creating strong monthly financial review documentation in which you are a) building a comprehensive financial and operational Page0, b) tracking actual performance vs commitments to the operational plan and c) drafting a strong narrative on ROI performance and headcount prioritization debates. You will then also provide ad-hoc support to teams to cost out initiatives, provide knowledge transfer on financial systems and think big on how to incorporate financials into system builds. You will also have weekly syncs with finance team members across CS Finance to ensure the PI and PP initiatives are fully known and being correctly represented in financial forums outside of NS.

About the team
Our team focuses on supporting the ambitious goals of the NS team in building the most customer and associate obsessed CS network in the world. We are dedicated in providing our partners the highest caliber of financial advice and work to ensure committed improvements are met while surfacing risks and opportunities to leaders. We work to achieve and exceed ROI expectations and support annual VCPC goals through close collaboration with all CS and Finance teams.

We operate at the intersection of finance, engineering and operations translating complex metrics into clear stories that incorporate impacts from different dependencies and providing guidance on how to course correct or excel in financial performance. Our insights directly impact critical business decisions and help shape the future of customer service operations. Our team will be particularly obsessed over accurately reflecting long term customer value through the products and programs launched, a signal we're delivering for customers.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
- Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting or related field
- Experience with advanced use of SQL for data mining and business intelligence
- 5+ years of dissecting financial data and identifying patterns that support business strategy experience
- 5+ years of contributing to cross-functional initiatives that drive financial performance and strategy experience

Preferred qualifications

- 6+ years of identifying incomplete or inaccurate data, identifying the root cause and creating/implementing an escalation plan experience
- 6+ years of solving complex business challenges by delivering accurate and timely financial models, analysis, and recommendations that have a proven impact on business (e.g., financial savings, operational improvements, or customer benefits) experience
- MBA, or CPA
- Knowledge of SQL/ETL
- Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards)
- Experience delivering forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis, and data interpretation of results

title: Transportation Associate
descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to help Amazon deliver world class service in its transportation operations? Transportation Associates will perform trailer moves in the trailer yard, coordinate yard activities (such as checking in trailers, traffic flow, internal communications with operations, etc.), conduct yard audits, complete applicable driver training programs (Hostler, Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) School, etc.), and operate multiple vehicle types based on business need (including but not limited to hostlers and day cabs) to support Amazon’s transportation network. Benefits of being a Transportation Associate include the opportunity to work outside and understand the new and exciting world of transportation operations.
As a Transportation Associate you will:
• Make safety a priority by adhering to company rules and regulations. You will follow and enforce safety measures and policies to all who operate vehicles on behalf of Amazon and those who enter the yard, including vendors and senior team members
• Perform various functions within the yard, support site operations teams, internal transportation field teams, and external carriers, as needed, to ensure all trailers arrive and depart on time with zero defects and to maintain workflow for buildings.
• Be professionally trained to operate Commercial Motor Vehicles (CMVs) on non-public roads or in yard to move trailers to/from dock and parking locations.
• Learn Department of Transportation (DOT) regulations and comply with company policies, procedures of those DOT regulations (size, weight, route designations, parking, trailer designations, violation and incident reporting requirements, break periods, etc.)
• Complete driver vehicle inspection reports on equipment and notify managers of any maintenance or delivery issues encountered.
• Follow hostler and delivery schedules, track and report working hours and breaks at appropriate times in compliance with Amazon policy and federal and state regulations, adhere to yard safety policies, obey all applicable traffic laws, and drive in accordance with weather/road conditions.
• Support the business on an as needed basis by serving as a peer trainer and/or working at nearby site locations within the area
• Drive, maneuver, and load/unload a truck using approved equipment (pallet jack, etc.).
What else does the team have to offer? We’re glad you asked!
• Opportunity to work outside and drive different commercial motor vehicles in the yard and over the road
• Exposure to different Amazon site types including NACF, NASC, Air, AMZL & AMXL.
• Long-term growth potential via comprehensive training in transportation with Amazon.
• Dependent on business need, you may have the opportunity to earn your Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) paid for by Amazon.

Join ATS! ATS is one of the fastest growing business lines within Amazon over the past 5 Years with continued growth to come!

If requested due to business need, Transportation Associates must obtain their Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) and Driver Qualification File (DQF) and utilize it as a condition of the role, paid for by Amazon. If Associate is requested to become CDL and DQF certified to drive Over-the-Road for Amazon, this position becomes regulated by the Department of Transportation (DOT) and follows regulations issued by the DOT’s Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (FMCSA). Candidate must hold a valid driver’s license for the state in which they reside and be eligible to drive in accordance with DOT requirements. For Department of Labor/Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration roles (roles for which you receive a CDL), English proficiency is required per federal regulation.
The timing of this requirement is dependent on business need. Continuing in the position with CDL and DQF certification is contingent upon the successful completion of a DOT-regulated pre-employment background screening, a DOT physical and Amazon’s pre-employment drug test.

A day in the life
Du arbeitest in einer unserer Schichten (Früh-, Spät- oder Nachtschicht). Dabei ist das Einhalten der Sicherheitsstandards an deinem gesamten Standort für dich höchste Priorität. Als Schichtleitung führst du routinemäßig Teammeetings durch und führst Feedbackgespräche mit deinen Mitarbeitenden und deinen Stakeholdern. Mit Hilfe von Datenauswertungen nimmst Du Einfluss auf die Produktivität und die Qualität deines Standortes. Als wichtiges Mitglied des Teams vor Ort arbeitest Du mit anderen Abteilungen, sowie externen Stakeholdern zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass wir die Anforderungen unserer Kundschaft, ebenso wie unsere eigenen Vorgaben jederzeit erfüllen. Durch die Analyse von Daten mit Führungskräften und die Besprechung der betrieblichen Vor- und Nachteile von technischen Verbesserungen mit den Fachabteilungen trägst du zu „best in class“ Lösungen bei.

About the team
