Own the end-to-end marketing strategy for Amazon's owned and operated channels globally — developing campaigns that reinforce Amazon's brand across marketplace priorities (e.g., Prime, Amazon Retail). Own creative briefing and guide creative development and timelines through close coordination with Creative, Operations, and Product. Drive the strategic roadmap for emerging channels, building the business cases to bring new capabilities from concept through validation to scale.

Operations, Marketing & Business Integration. This role sits at the intersection of brand strategy and operations. You will partner directly with operational teams to understand fleet deployment schedules, label print and application workflows, packaging specifications, and delivery station logistics — then translate those realities back into marketing plans that are both ambitious and executable. Success requires fluency in the operations of the physical channels — you do not need to own these systems, but you must be able to ask the right questions, identify risk, and ensure that marketing commitments match operational capacity.

Strategic Communications & Decision Framing. Write recommendations, stakeholder updates, and strategy documents that are concise, insight-led, and built to drive decisions. Translate complex program narratives into clear strategic recommendations that build alignment and move work forward. Frame alternatives with specificity — articulate trade-offs, estimate business impact, and distinguish one-way from two-way doors.

Analytical Rigor & Measurement. Partner with Science and Operations teams to define campaign measurement frameworks, evaluate performance against target perceptions and high-value actions (HVAs), and translate complex data into clear strategic recommendations. Conduct performance deep-dives, build learning agendas, and set the strategic measurement priorities for the channel. Identify when data is directional versus conclusive and communicate uncertainty with intellectual honesty.

Cross-Functional Stakeholder Management. Lead alignment across a broad stakeholder ecosystem spanning internal Amazon teams, Creative, Legal, Science, Operations, and Global marketing teams. Navigate competing priorities, resource constraints, and partner escalations across organizations. Serve as the connective backbone between teams — educating cross-functional partners on channel strategy, managing expectations, and driving shared understanding of how the work ladders up.

What Success Looks Like
Within 90 days, you have authored or refined the current batch of campaign briefs, established relationships with key cross-functional partners, and developed a point of view on what's working and what needs to change. Within six months, you are the person stakeholders seek out when they need a crisp recommendation backed by evidence — and the person the team trusts to put the right words on the page. Within a year, you have measurably advanced the strategic position of Chariot Marketing's brand-building programs and are shaping the roadmap for what comes next.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
- Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
- Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
- Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional marketing programs
- Experience leading go-to-market for consumer software or hardware product launches
- Experience applying quantitative analysis to solve business problems and making data-driven business decisions
- Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, or equivalent
- Proven ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder programs across business functions and geographies
- Demonstrated track record of exceptional written communication — from creative briefs to QBRs

Preferred qualifications

- Experience using any of SQL or other analytical tools for conducting data analysis
- Experience with customer segmentation, profiling, and targeting
- Experience in go-to-market planning or scaling marketing programs across digital or physical channels
- Background working with analytics or data science teams across measurement (A/B testing, hold-out experiments) and personalization models
- Comfort operating in ambiguity — able to pair high judgement with available data to make recommendations and drive strategy forward
- Familiarity with international campaign launches and localization
- Experience with out-of-home media or non-traditional brand surfaces

title: エリアマネージャー, SSD
descriptionHtml:
※このポジションの勤務地は東京都品川区を予定しています。

私たちのグローバルオペレーションネットワークは、日々何百万もの荷物と笑顔をアマゾンのお客様にお届けしています。私たちは、エリアマネージャーとして私たちのチームに加わってほしいと考え、意欲的で顧客重視の人材を探しています。この役割では、複数メンバーのチームをリードし、シフト中のチームの安全性、品質、出勤率、およびパフォーマンスを最高水準に維持するため、チームに働きかける責任があります。また、お客様の注文が適切な時間に適切な場所へ確実にお届けされるよう、お客様の期待に応えることにおいても重要な役割を担います。

私たちの業務の流れには3つの主要な要素があります。
商品が保管され注文に備える「ファーストマイル」、注文品をお客様のエリアまで輸送する「ミドルマイル」、そして商品をお客様の玄関先までお届けする「ラストマイル」です。各拠点で運営方法に若干の違いはありますが、一貫して変わらないものが一つあります、それは顧客を第一に考える私たちのビジョンと献身的な姿勢です。

本ポジションはAmazonの新しいエキサイティングな物流拠点で業務を行います。可能な限り最速でお客様のご自宅に商品をお届けすることでお客様のカスタマーエクスペリエンスを向上します。私たちと一緒に歴史をつくりましょう！

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。
AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。

Key job responsibilities
■業務内容■
「エリアマネージャー」には、他業種・職種も含めこれまでの経験、スキルを活かし、改善点を模索しながら、「People First」の考え方で、各種プロジェクトをリードし、またピープルマネージメントを行っていただきます。また、「エリアマネージャー」は拠点の全ての工程を担当し、上司の示す部署全体の方針や安全・品質・生産性の年間目標に沿って、担当工程における改善を積み重ね、日々の計画、進捗、実績管理に責任をもち活動いただきます。

具体的な業務は以下の通りです。

主な責任と職務内容：
① チームメンバーの育成とサポート
現場の最前線にいるマネージャーとしてチームメンバーと積極的に関わり、メンバーからの意見に基づく職場改善によりエンゲージメントを高めます。また、数名から数十名のチームのマネージャーとして、業務上の知識・スキル、アマゾンカルチャー等の指導を行うことはもちろん、部下の悩みに傾聴し、問題の解決に向けて自ら動きます。さらに、部下の勤怠や労働時間等の把握、管理を適切に行います。

② 担当プロセスの安全・品質・作業効率の向上
マネージャーはそれぞれ特定のプロセスを担当し、そのプロセスの安全・品質・作業効率の向上をリードします。日々の安全活動、品質チェックに加え、作業環境の改善、トレーニングの進捗管理など多岐にわたる改善活動が該当します。問題を特定し、対策を立案し、チームメンバーを巻き込みながら実行に移し、結果を出していくことが求められます。

③ 日々のオペレーション対応
物流拠点のすべての工程を管理し、商品の管理からお客様へお届けするまでの一連の流れの中で計画を立案し管理していただきます。日々のオペレーションにおいてお客様にお約束した納期を確実に守るため、物量の上振れや下振れ、急な労働力不足、システムトラブル等の変動要素に際し、適切に判断して対応していくことが求められます。

④ プロジェクトリーダーとして改善を推進
Amazonでは日々改善が推進されています。エリアマネージャーは通常業務と並行して、安全上のリスクや生産性を改善するプロジェクトのリーダーとして拠点内の年次/月次プロジェクト活動を推進します。これらのプロジェクトにおいては関連部署との協業等も含まれます。

title: Stage en Maintenance Industrielle (F/H) – Équipe RME (Reliability Maintenance Engineering)
descriptionHtml:
Ce poste peut être basé dans l'un de nos sites logistiques en France (centre de distribution, centre de tri ou agence de livraison) : Senlis (60), Lauwin-Planque (59), Boves (80), Colombier-Saugnieu (69), Ensisheim (68), Saran (45) ou Augny (57)
Remarque : Vous devez avoir le droit de travailler dans le pays d'emploi à la date de début.
Introduction
Rejoignez l'équipe RME (Reliability Maintenance Engineering) d'Amazon en France pour un stage de 3 à 6 mois. Notre équipe est le lien essentiel entre les Opérations et la satisfaction client : en garantissant la disponibilité et la fiabilité d'équipements à la pointe de la technologie — des systèmes de tri automatisés aux innovations facilitées par l'intelligence artificielle — nous permettons à chaque colis d'arriver à temps.
Nos sites logistiques intègrent des milliers d'unités mobiles autonomes, des convoyeurs automatisés et des systèmes intelligents orchestrés en temps réel par l'IA. Nos équipements sont surveillés par des milliers de capteurs IoT et des outils de diagnostic avancés (caméras thermiques, détecteurs ultrason, caméras rapides), et nos équipes utilisent Quartz, un agent IA déployé dans plus de 600 sites Amazon dans le monde, qui transforme radicalement le diagnostic de pannes.
En tant que stagiaire RME, vous ne serez pas simple observateur : vous piloterez un projet d'ingénierie à impact réel, encadré par des ingénieurs expérimentés, dans un environnement où la sécurité est la priorité absolue.


Key job responsibilities
Responsabilités clés
Votre projet pourra s'inscrire dans l'un des domaines suivants :
● Fiabilité et maintenance préventive : Analyser les performances des équipements, exploiter les données de maintenance prédictive et proposer des plans d'action pour améliorer la disponibilité des systèmes automatisés (convoyeurs, systèmes de tri, cellules robotisées).
● Amélioration continue et résolution de problèmes : Mener une analyse de causes racines sur des pannes récurrentes, concevoir et déployer des solutions techniques, et mesurer leur impact sur les indicateurs opérationnels.
● Automatisation et innovation : Contribuer à la conception ou à l'amélioration de projets d'automatisation (tri haute vitesse, convoyage, robotique), en collaboration avec les équipes d'ingénieurs du site et du réseau européen.
● Sécurité et standards : Participer à l'amélioration des processus de sécurité liés aux interventions de maintenance, contribuer à la standardisation des meilleures pratiques et à leur déploiement sur le réseau.
● Gestion de projet technique : Soutenir l'installation et la mise en service de nouveaux équipements, coordonner les parties prenantes internes et externes, et assurer le suivi des jalons du projet.


A day in the life
À propos de l'équipe
Notre équipe RME (Reliability Maintenance Engineering) veille à ce que nos équipements fonctionnent au mieux. title: Senior Supplier Quality Engineer, (Infrastructure Reliability & Quality Engineer)
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The AWS Field Engineering organization provides engineering support for our data centers throughout their lifecycle. A critical piece of this support is ensuring the highest level of initial quality and ongoing support from our vendors. As a Senior Supplier Quality Engineer you will interface daily with AWS Engineering teams, Procurement teams, and vendors to manage infrastructure equipment quality. Our Senior Supplier Quality Engineer is responsible for supplier qualifications, quality monitoring at supplier sites, supplier quality issue resolution and supplier development and quality improvement initiatives.

If you want to be a part of a team that has a daily impact on company success, this is a great opportunity for you.

In this role you will lead internal and external engagements with engineering, procurement, supply chain management, operations, finance, construction, and suppliers to deliver robust and resilient quality systems at our vendors and within AWS. You will identify supplier quality defects or waste in AWS processes, and drive new processes to eliminate the defects and prevent them from recurring without posing risk to availability.

In this role your responsibilities include:
• Develop, implement and maintain the Supplier Quality roadmap for complex electrical and or mechanical infrastructure equipment to meet the technical and quality requirements.
• Manage complete equipment lifecycle quality, working closely with suppliers, engineering, procurement and other internal stakeholders.
• Responsible for improving equipment quality by identifying and closing gaps by performing thorough on-site audits to ensure suppliers' quality systems, products, and processes are meeting AWS Quality and product specification requirements.
• Drive Supplier Quality Improvement Programs track supplier performance along with goal settings for key performance indicators.
• Develop critical to quality parameters, perform critical-to-quality inspections and functional testing for complex equipment to ensure suppliers provide defect-free, high quality equipment to AWS and its customers.
• Review historical failures, equipment design changes and lessons learned to incorporate relevant inspections & tests and update equipment technical specifications.
• Lead complex electrical and mechanical infrastructure equipment as well as critical component(s) root cause analysis, working with suppliers, cross-functional teams such as reliability and design engineering teams.
• Responsible for evaluating and validating complex root cause analysis reports from a technical perspective using critical thinking and quality principles.
• Develop new product (equipment) and/or new supplier qualification plans in terms of quality. Drive the quality program from prototyping to mass production stage for complex electrical and mechanical equipment that are part of AWS Data Centers.
• Ability to perform data analysis on failures reported during the equipment life cycle and create technical reports to provide design and specification improvement inputs and to drive improvement(s) at supplier factories.
• Work on concurrent projects, sometimes in multiple geographical regions.
• Demonstrate a can-do attitude and thriving in a fast-paced work environment.
• Keys to success in this role include sound judgment and excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• This role requires 30-50% international and domestic travel.

About the team
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related field
- 8+ years in a quality management function with direct interaction with suppliers.
- 8+ years in Electrical, Mechanical Product manufacturing, supplier quality

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in data center engineering or operations
- Ability in managing multiple qualification activities and development schedules.

title: Software Development Engineer, Woot!
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to have a large impact on a growing business? Do you want to have a wide breadth of ownership? Do you want to see your impact daily on both internal and external customers? Do you want to collaborate with the kind of folks who would enjoy selling something called a "Bag of Crap" almost as much as our customers love buying them?

Woot! is the original daily deals website where an entertaining shopping experience meets deals so good they can't last long. Behind the scenes, our engineering teams build the web and app experiences our customers love, create the tools and automation that surface the right deals at the right time from millions of options, and develop the platforms that power Woot's business.

You’ll get to learn, grow and work with amazing team to:
- Unlock Woot's growth by innovating the systems and tools that power Woot's business-within-a-business - customer service, fulfillment, and finance functions to name a few.
- Design, develop, and improve systems, owning the entire lifecycle - from working with the product team, to design and architecture, to implementation and release, to operations.
- Work with a wide array of technologies every day, including AWS tech stacks (Lambda, EC2, SNS, DynamoDB, etc), Typescript, NextJS, CDK, REST, C#.
- Work closely with internal customers to drive new solutions that impact internal and external customers.

Work/Life Balance:
Woot! values work-life balance. We aim to work efficiently. Working long hours is an exception, not the rule. As an engineering team, we are builders and operators, and thus have an on-call rotation that you will participate on. Getting paged is not seen as inevitable, and we work to make our systems more fault tolerant over time.

Inclusive Team Culture:
We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust. We seek to make every team member feel valued and connected. We are looking for a new teammate who is empathetic and curious and will further amplify our positive and inclusive culture.


Key job responsibilities
- Technical Ownership & System Design: Take full ownership of strategic projects, building scalable, low-latency products and services while designing fault-tolerant distributed systems across teams
- Code Quality & Engineering Excellence: Deliver high-quality, cloud-first AWS solutions using technologies like Lambda, Fargate, and ML while maintaining operational excellence and identifying technical improvements
- Leadership & Mentorship: Collaborate with and mentor junior engineers, conduct technical assessments and code reviews, and make independent medium-impact decisions while considering diverse perspectives
- Cross-functional Impact: Convert business requirements to technical designs through stakeholder collaboration, shape product direction, and leverage worldwide platforms to build decoupled solutions that drive business outcomes
- Technical Influence: Work with senior engineers to evolve product design, set software quality standards, and demonstrate technical influence across multiple teams while focusing on long-term scalability

A day in the life
You'll spend time designing scalable solutions for complex projects, writing clean code with AWS services, and reviewing pull requests from teammates. You'll collaborate with product managers to turn business needs into technical designs, mentor junior engineers through challenging problems, and make architectural decisions that impact multiple systems. Beyond the typical coding and reviews, you might find yourself leading technical discussions, driving best practices across teams, or diving deep into performance optimizations. The role keeps you engaged with both hands-on development and strategic technical leadership that shapes how your team builds and operates software.

About the team
You'll join the EDM (Engagement and Deal Merchandising) team which owns the front-end platform and backend services that power deals on Woot!, the original daily deals site. We build responsive, locally-testable services with simplified architecture, rigorous logging, and high observability. Our stack spans customer-facing web experiences and the systems that create, manage, and merchandize deals at scale. We value clean code, low tech debt, and fast debugging. If you want to ship production features with direct customer impact, solve real-world distributed systems challenges, and work on a team that prioritizes engineering excellence, EDM is the place.

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Preferred qualifications

- Experience building web applications with React and modern web technologies
- Experience with AWS Services including EC2, Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, SQS
- Prior experience building consumer-facing products at scale

title: Engineering Operations Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.


Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12 hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:
- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs

A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of electrical facilities maintenance, or 1+ years of mechanical facilities maintenance experience
- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work a flexible work schedule including evenings, overnights, and weekends

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of data center engineering experience
- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
- Associate's degree in related field, or technical degree in related field

title: Regional Quality & Benchmark Specialist
descriptionHtml:
Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. The Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME) team are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it happen. We drive continuous improvement, and maintain all of the robotics and material handling equipment (MHE) to ensure our customers are met with the Amazon smile. Come join us on our journey!

About the Role:
As the Regional Quality & Benchmarking Specialist, you will build and implement quality systems for Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME). You will guide field teams in creating effective decision-making tools for site managers, evaluate Fulfillment Center RME performance, and implement best practices to improve reliability metrics year over year. You will be instrumental in leading Amazon RME towards World Class Maintenance.

What Do We Offer?
Amazon offers competitive compensation packages including comprehensive healthcare benefits starting on Day 1, matching 401(k) program, and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave. But wait, there’s more: We provide lightweight fire-resistant daily wear and composite toe safety shoes for your safety!


Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
- You will develop parts cage quality standards by creating work benches, tracking quality data and vendor defect rates, and building standard work processes for parts quality management
- You will create risk-based forecasting tools that help site maintenance leaders prioritize work based on asset failure probability and partner with central reliability and RAPA teams to develop tracking automation for audit and parts mechanisms
- You will define RME standard work procedures for maintenance quality, timing, and structure across all sites and providers, while conducting regular field audits to analyze performance against best practices
- You will lead network-wide Continuous Improvement initiatives using AMS Standards and validate new company-wide Program Management (PM) processes that meet safety and effectiveness standards
- You will be able to travel domestically up to 80%

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Technology, or Reliability Engineering, or 2+ years of Amazon (BB/3P) Full Time Exempt experience
- 5+ years of maintenance or engineering experience
- 5+ years of directly managing and responsible for multiple large projects experience
- 5+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in Lean Management, Six Sigma and other operations engineer tools
- PMP certificate
- Experience with analytical tools and ability to dive deep into metrics and reporting
- Experience communicating and delivering presentations to customers, stakeholders, and/or teammates

title: Data Center Engineering Operations Technician - 2027 Internship, DCEO
descriptionHtml:
Important: This role is based at a location with limited public transport. A valid driving license and access to a personal vehicle are required.

Want to be part of the team that keeps the world's largest cloud running? As an Engineering Operations Technician Intern at Amazon Web Services (AWS), you will get hands-on experience with the critical infrastructure behind Amazon's global data centers — and your work will directly impact millions of customers worldwide.

This internship is designed as a potential pathway to full-time employment. Interns who demonstrate strong performance throughout their internship may be considered for a full-time Engineering Operations Technician position, subject to available roles and business needs.

Who Should Apply

We welcome applications from:
- Students in the last year of their Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field who are looking for an internship that could

About the Role

As an intern, you will provide technical support within Amazon's owned and operated data centers. Your work will ensure that the data center's mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems operate at 100% availability while maintaining first-class customer service to the teams and groups on site.

You will be exposed to both independent work and team-based collaboration. Prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to being successful.

What You Will Do

The Engineering Operations team is Amazon's front-line responders for hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operations. You will work with equipment that supports mission-critical servers and must maintain better than 99.999% uptime. This equipment includes, but is not limited to:

- Stand-by diesel generators and switchgear
- Uninterruptible Power Supplies (UPSs) and Power Distribution Units (PDUs)
- Air Handling Units (AHUs), chillers, and cooling towers
- Chemical treatment systems, pumps, motors, and Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs)
- Building automation systems

Your day-to-day duties include:
- Maintaining mechanical and electrical equipment
- Assisting with root cause analysis of equipment failures
- Troubleshooting facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLAs)
- Taking daily operational readings of all mechanical and electrical equipment
- Using internal Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS) to manage building workflows
- Interacting with third-party vendors and contractors working on site

Internship Structure
Amazon internships are full-time (40 hours per week) for 24 consecutive weeks. This position requires the intern to report to work on site daily. Intern schedules are typically day schedules, Monday through Friday.

Please note that full-time Engineering Operations Technician roles operate on a rotating shift pattern, which may include days, nights, weekends, and public holidays. Candidates should be willing and able to commit to shift work upon transitioning to a full-time position.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed below, we encourage you to apply. If your career is just starting, has not followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, do not let that stop you from applying.

Your Career at Amazon — A Universe of Opportunity

At Amazon, your career is not a straight path. It is a journey you build as you go.

From your first day as an intern, you will own real work that matters. You will troubleshoot and maintain the systems that keep AWS running for millions of customers. Your mentors and teammates will champion your growth, helping you build skills you did not know existed — and you will see your work come to life at massive scale.

- Impact. Your work shapes the infrastructure that millions of customers rely on every day. From cloud computing to artificial intelligence, the systems you maintain power it all.

- Action. You will move fast, experiment, and learn by doing. Your ideas do not get stuck in approval chains — they get tested, refined, and put into practice.

- Curiosity. Every project teaches you something new. You will apply what you learned in the classroom to real challenges and explore different teams, technologies, and career paths within Amazon.

- Mentorship and career growth. You will start with structured onboarding and get paired with experienced mentors. Beyond that, you will find continuous learning opportunities and the chance to work on different projects. Your journey here is yours to shape.

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. We are the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on.

You will join a diverse team of engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You will collaborate with people across AWS to deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers.

Basic qualifications

- In pursuit of a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as Mechanical Engineering or Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, graduating in 2027/2028
- Professional English proficiency, both written and verbal
- Ability to work well with others in a team environment, with strong time management skills
- You must have access to your own transport (note: public transit options may be limited)

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in program or project management
- Knowledge of mechanical systems (Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning systems, controls)

We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. title: Sales Operations Analyst, AWS Israel ENT & PS
descriptionHtml:
AWS is seeking a talented Sales Operations Analyst to join Israel Sales Strategy and Operations team.

This role will be responsible for supporting the operations and rhythm of the business activities like business reviews, pipeline and forecast. Providing reporting and insights. Managing sales planning which include territory formations, quota and account movements. The role works closely with Sales managers as well as Sales Strategy & Operations leaders, and is analytical in nature and require a person willing to "role up their sleeves" to solve revenue routing issues and re-route accounts to the right owner. Work with AWS business leaders to define and answer key business questions, then work backwards to deliver meaningful insights to streamline the decision making process.

The successful candidate will be a fast learner, proactive, detailed, structured and motivated person with the ability to collaborate effectively with internal end-users and cross-functional teams to solve problems and implement new solutions. You should be passionate about creating simple, scalable solutions to difficult problems while setting high standards. Your deep operational and analytical skills, and focus on our core operational inputs will make you a critical partner to sales and sales operations leaders as you help them prioritize initiatives, identify gaps in process and performance, and remove barriers to execution.

We are looking for a candidate with a strong AI experience, who is used to building tools and agents to automate processes.

Key job responsibilities
* Manage key sales support systems and processes required to meet the growth of the business and achieve revenue attainment and market development objectives
* Partner closely with the Sales Operations Leads to set ambitious yet achievable goals for the sales organization, then put a framework in place to report, analyze and measure progress against them
* Manage territories, accounts, revenue flow, and quota for the sales teams
* Develop relationships and work with sales, regional sales operations, and other stakeholders to create and refine the tools and processes needed to drive productivity increases
* Operate as the local focal point for the company's account management roles (including revenue routing, segmentation, exceptions, etc.)
* Prepare ad hoc analysis
* participate in strategic projects
* Create metrics, processes and mechanisms

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve. 
Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: Sr. Technical Program Manager - AI Manufacturing, Annapurna AI Manufacturing Quality and Reliability
descriptionHtml:
In Annapurna Labs we are at the forefront of hardware/software accelerator solutions for not only Amazon Web Services (AWS), but across the industry. The Annapurna AI Systems team owns design, validation, deployment, manufacturing, quality, reliability and fleet operations end to end.
Turning the silicon and systems into serving capacity is a manufacturing problem at a scale and pace the industry has not run before: cards, boards, sleds and servers built into racks across a global manufacturing footprint, then shipped to globally diverse datacenters and converted into capacity customers can launch on.

The Trainium Manufacturing, Quality and Reliability team owns that path end to end, and we looking for candidates interested in diving deep into our manufacturing, scaling and quality processes to support current and future generations of accelerator silicon/systems.

You will be responsible for managing server and rack manufacturing programs across our North America footprint — build plan attainment, rolled-through yield, test cycle time, work-in-process health and on-time shipment to datacenter — at ODM and CM sites.

We are seeking an experienced TPM who is equally comfortable on a factory floor and in a data set. You will reconcile what a partner reports, what the test data says, and what the design actually permits — and then drive the plan that closes the gap. Come join us!

Key job responsibilities
- You will own manufacturing programs end to end across our ODM and CM partners: build rate against plan, rolled-through yield, first-pass test cycle time, aged work-in-process, and on-time shipment to datacenter.
- You will establish the operating cadence with each partner — weekly build and recovery reviews, clear commitments, and an escalation path into vendor leadership that you are trusted to use.
- You will own material readiness, operational support and constraint resolution — critical component supply, mechanical and enclosure quality, and staging capacity at each site. The job is to identify the constraint before it caps the build rate, and to drive the cross-functional plan that clears it.
- You will drive manufacturing readiness for new rack platforms, defining entry and exit criteria for each build phase and gating ramp decisions on demonstrated yield and cycle time rather than on schedule pressure.
- You will coordinate across Design Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Manufacturing Test, Quality and Reliability, Supply Chain, Global Supplier Management, Logistics and EC2. Manufacturing sits between design intent and deployed capacity.
- You will build the reporting layer — define the metrics that describe manufacturing health, automate them where you can, and give senior leadership a clear weekly position on what shipped, what is at risk, what you need and by when.

You will work independently in a dynamic, challenging, and fast-changing organization. We’re changing an industry, and we need individuals who are ready for this challenge and who want to reach beyond what is possible today.

A day in the life
Your day to day responsibilities will include interfacing with our engineering teams, vendors and customers to understand project requirements and facilitate manufacturing output and scaling . You will work directly with vendors and ODM/JDM/CM teams to develop and manufacture your product at scale.

You will review build, yield and ship numbers from each site against plan and determine key bottlenecks and engage the right teams to overcome them. You will lead output and recovery reviews with ODM/CM leadership, pushing back on a commitment you do not believe the line can hold and landing on a number you can both defend. You will coordinate with vendor and Amazon supply chain teams to align materials with your build plans. You will write daily/weekly reports as necessary to inform leadership on the current state and key challenges.

About the team
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge-sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring and thorough reviews. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects that help our team members develop your engineering expertise so you feel empowered to take on more complex tasks in the future. We care about growing the people on this team — the work is genuinely hard, the feedback is direct and kind, and nobody here is short of problems worth solving.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
- 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
- Experience working with cross-geographic vendors in the ODM/CM model
- Experience owning manufacturing or operations metrics — yield, cycle time, throughput or work-in-process — and driving measurable improvement

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
- Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
- Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

descriptionHtml:
Amazon’s North American Customer Fulfillment (NACF) Finance is looking for a Senior Financial Analyst, supporting operational and functional leaders. Amazon operates the most complex retail networks in the world, delivering billions of packages to hundreds of millions of homes and businesses annually. Come be part of this tremendous organization and join a dedicated team committed to operational and financial excellence where you will focus on the inputs, think like an owner and where every day is Day One.

The NACFinance team vision is to provide cost controllership, projects return on investment (ROI), and financial insights for end-to-end defect reduction processes and initiatives across supply chain. Our team supports various North America teams through translating operational KPIs into financial impact to ensure our stakeholders have the most up to date and reliable information to make the best possible decision for Amazon. The ability to learn and be curious while working through a high degree of complex ambiguity in order to think big while inventing and simplifying for process improvement is mission critical.

Key job responsibilities
Key Business Support:
• End-to-end ownership of the financial planning cycles which include forecast modeling, bridging, network partnership and presentations to senior leadership.
• Perform projects financial validations to ensure accurate return-on-investment insights.
• Collect, analyze and manage quantitative data and create meaningful reports to lead business improvement and defect cost reduction strategy.
• Perform root cause analysis to uncover core issues using data, then assisting the operation stakeholders to improve and create new measures for sites productivity.

The DCC team supports multiple teams across North America Customer Fulfillment, and collaborates with Customer Service, Transportation and Delivery teams for an end-to-end financial controllership. In cases of worldwide workstreams, the team collaborates with business partners across the globe. The endless opportunity to invent on behalf of our customers ensures the work is always fun.

title: Transportation Specialist, Relay Ops
descriptionHtml:
NOC (Network Operation Center) is the central command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon Supply Chain network supporting multiple geographies. It ensures hassle free, timely pick-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, NOC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem-solving NOC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data. Overall, NOC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.
Risk and Compliance Monitoring Team (RCMT) within NOC is the centralized risk management function for RoW Surface Transportation. This team leads risk assessments across ST programs and develops tailored risk mitigation initiatives, programs, and audits to meet the needs of our business customers. RCMT is dedicated to preventing bad actors from exploiting Amazon services for illicit purposes and collaborates closely with legal, finance, and HR departments to conduct thorough investigations and take necessary actions against such actors. We harness advanced technology to enhance our processes and develop projects, programs, and products that optimize Surface Transportation Operations across RoW countries — Brazil, Mexico, AMET (Egypt, KSA, South Africa, UAE), Japan, India, and Australia.
The role operates on a rotational shift model (including nights and rotational week-offs) to provide round-the-clock coverage across time zones.


Key job responsibilities
• Investigation & Case Management — Serve as a primary investigator conducting daily investigations across assigned geographies. Review cases from monitoring dashboards, determine root cause (process gaps, SOP non-compliance, or deviations), and document findings with supporting evidence within established SLA timelines.
• Deep-Dive Analysis & Root Cause Determination — Perform deep-dive analysis into raised cases by validating operational justifications. Distinguish between legitimate operational exceptions, process loopholes, and potential compliance deviations to ensure accurate case classification.
• Data Extraction & Monitoring — Extract and manage data from multiple internal portals and monitoring dashboards to support daily investigation operations. Maintain familiarity with data sources, system tools, and reporting platforms used across assigned geographies to ensure comprehensive case review.
• Trend Identification & Anomaly Reporting — Identify recurring patterns, emerging risk trends, and anomalies through systematic review of investigation outputs. Report identified trends and anomalies to managers for further review, escalation, and strategic action.
• SOP Compliance & Process Gap Identification — Evaluate investigated cases against established SOPs and operational guidelines. Identify control gaps and process loopholes and recommend SOP revisions or corrective actions to strengthen compliance controls across assigned geographies.
• Documentation & Reporting — Generate and maintain accurate investigation records, periodic reports (daily, weekly, monthly), and case documentation. Ensure all findings, evidence, and outcomes are systematically documented to support audit trails and leadership reviews.
• Quality Assurance & Calibration — Participate in quality assurance reviews and calibration sessions to ensure consistency and accuracy of investigation outputs across the team. Cross-validate investigation findings and support peer reviews as directed by managers.
• Continuous Improvement — Actively seek solutions through logical reasoning and identify trends to suggest process improvements. Provide feedback on detection accuracy and dashboard logic refinement to leadership for further evaluation and action.
• Confidentiality & Compliance — Uphold strict confidentiality standards for all sensitive information handled during investigations. Adhere to all Amazon policies, ethical guidelines, and compliance protocols governing risk management activities.

- Bachelor's degree in a quantitative/technical field such as computer science, engineering, statistics
- Experience with Excel

descriptionHtml:
Amazon is the most customer-centric company. In the light of this, the company is offering our vendors the highest level of services, encouraging them to participate to grow their businesses on Amazon.

The Financial Deduction Vendor Consultant Program (FD VCP) works with Amazon AVS Retail Vendors and internal stakeholders who are facing supply chain defects that lead to financial deductions. The service provides a dedicated support aimed to identify and sustainably resolve the defects causing financial deductions. We are seeking a Financial Deductions (FD) Expert to join our team.

The FD Expert is a strategic role that combines financial analysis, vendor management, and process optimization responsibilities. This professional manages a portfolio of companies within the VCP Evergreen program, focusing on improving financial metrics such as ISR, PPV, and Chargebacks through data-driven analysis and proactive vendor engagement. They serve as an essential bridge between vendors and internal stakeholders, conducting deep-dive analyses of financial data, leading vendor-facing Kaizen sessions, and implementing improvement plans while maintaining strong relationships with all stakeholders involved. The role demands expertise in financial operations, data analysis, and stakeholder management, as they work to optimize processes, develop automation initiatives, and provide mentorship to team members. Through their comprehensive understanding of financial deductions and vendor operations, they enhance vendor experience (VX) while ensuring operational excellence and driving continuous improvement across the organization.

Key job responsibilities
Business Impact:
Manage and optimize the FD VCP Evergreen program vendor portfolio, focusing on key performance metrics such as ISR, PPV, and Chargebacks. Implement preventive measures and action plans to drive vendor performance while enhancing overall vendor experience. Streamline interactions between vendors and internal teams to improve efficiency and support quality.

Dive Deep, Data Analysis & Reporting:
Conduct comprehensive financial data analysis to identify deduction patterns and root causes through thorough auditing and utilization of internal systems. Prepare and distribute detailed reports to all levels of stakeholders, ensuring effective communication of findings and insights.

Stakeholder Communication:
Cultivate strategic relationships with internal and external stakeholders to gain a deep understanding of vendor financial deduction metrics and activities. Lead Kaizen sessions, manage cross-functional communications, and handle escalations while providing regular updates to vendors and senior management. Represent the team in project reviews and operational meetings, delivering data-driven presentations and supporting internal teams in financial metric performance.

Operations & Process Excellence:
Independently execute and optimize financial deductions processes while identifying and implementing tactical solutions for operational challenges. Drive continuous improvement initiatives, develop comprehensive Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and actively participate in Correction of Error (COE) processes. title: Logistics Specialist - 2027 Internship
descriptionHtml:
Roles starting from March 2027 in South Africa.

We especially encourage applications from candidates with disabilities. Please note you will need to share supporting documentation ahead of the interview.

Behind every click, stream, and cloud service is real hardware — and someone needs to make sure it gets where it needs to be. As a Logistics Specialist Intern at Amazon Web Services (AWS), you will help manage the supply chain that keeps our data centers running, from receiving and tracking parts to ensuring the right equipment is in the right place at the right time.

This internship is designed as a potential pathway to full-time employment. Interns who demonstrate strong performance throughout their internship may be considered for a full-time Logistics Specialist position, subject to available roles and business needs.

Who Should Apply

We welcome applications from:

- Students who have completed — or due to complete before the internship end date — a higher education qualification (National Qualifications Framework level 4 to 6) or a Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution in a relevant field such as Supply Chain, Logistics, or similar

About the Role

You will join a creative, dynamic team of Logistics Specialists dedicated to providing world-class customer service — and you will be part of operating the world's largest cloud computing infrastructure.

This hands-on role supports our procurement and supply chain operations. Prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to being successful.

What You Will Do

- Monitor inventory levels to ensure proper stock levels are maintained

- Receive parts, maintain inventory records, and check out parts

- Load and unload shipments and transport parts between different locations

- Assemble, address, stamp, and arrange for the shipment of merchandise and materials

- Assist in daily scheduling of deliveries and pick-ups to and from production locations

- Unpack incoming shipments and verify contents

- Maintain precise records of all commodities going in and out of the facility

Physical Requirements

This role involves physical activity, including:

- Regularly lifting and moving up to 16 kilograms (approximately 35 pounds) unassisted, and participating in group lifts for heavier items

- Lifting loads of up to 22 kilograms (approximately 49 pounds) and carrying them for short distances

- Continuously climbing and descending stairs safely (applies to sites with stairs)

- Reaching and stretching to position equipment and fixtures while maintaining balance

- Pushing or pulling heavy objects into position

If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation during the application or hiring process, visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information.

Internship Structure

Amazon internships are full-time (40 hours per week) for six consecutive months, starting in March/April 2027. This position requires the intern to report to work on site daily. Intern schedules are typically day schedules, Monday through Friday.

This is a paid internship.

Please note that a full-time Logistics Specialist position could involve day, evening, or weekend shifts and on-call rotations. Candidates should be willing and able to commit to shift work upon transitioning to a full-time position.

South Africa Employment Equity Requirements

In line with applicable legislation, preference will be given to eligible applicants from designated groups (that is, Black people (used as a collective term for Africans, Colored, Indians and Chinese) women, and persons with disabilities who are citizens of South Africa). Appointments will be made on merit and in accordance with organizational requirements).

- Be a South African citizen with a valid Identity Document

- Unemployed before joining the internship program.

- Age requirement: below 35 years

- Must have completed a higher education qualification in a related field (Minimum NQF level 4-6 qualification)

- Qualification must be from an accredited institution of higher education

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed below, we encourage you to apply. If your career is just starting, has not followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, do not let that stop you from applying.

Your Career at Amazon — A Universe of Opportunity

At Amazon, your career is not a straight path. It is a journey you build as you go.

From your first day as an intern, you will own real work that matters. You will help keep the supply chain moving for one of the world's largest cloud infrastructures — making sure the right parts arrive at the right place at the right time so millions of customers stay connected.

Impact. Your work keeps data centers stocked and operational. Every shipment you process and every part you track plays a role in keeping AWS running for customers around the world.

Action. You will move fast, solve real logistics challenges, and see the results of your work every day. Your ideas do not get stuck in approval chains — they get tested, refined, and put into practice.

Curiosity. Every project teaches you something new. You will learn how a world-class supply chain operates at massive scale and explore different teams, technologies, and career paths within Amazon.

Mentorship and career growth. You will start with structured onboarding and get paired with experienced mentors. Our team is dedicated to supporting new members in an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing. Projects and tasks are assigned in a way that leverages your strengths and helps you further develop your skill set. Your journey here is yours to shape.

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. We are the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on.

You will join a diverse team of engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You will collaborate with people across AWS to deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers.

Basic qualifications

- Completed — or due to complete before the internship end date — a higher education qualification (National Qualifications Framework level 4 to 6) or a Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution in a relevant field such as Supply Chain, Logistics, or similar
- Professional English proficiency, both written and verbal
- Ability to work well with others in a team environment, with strong time management skills

Preferred qualifications

- You must have access to your own transport (note: public transit options may be limited)
- Customer service experience
- Ability to manage work and priorities through a ticketing system and coordinate with your manager

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer, and we value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. We welcome applications from all members of society irrespective of age, sex, disability, sexual orientation, race, religion or belief. Amazon is strongly committed to diversity within its community and especially welcomes applications from South African citizens who are members of designated groups who may contribute to Employment Equity within the workplace and the further diversification of ideas. In this regard, the relevant laws and principles associated with Employment Equity will be considered when appointing potential candidates. descriptionHtml:
Are you enthusiastic about the latest advancements in industrial automation and robotics? Would you like to play a vital role in Amazon's investment in advanced technologies? If you have a passion for making an impact on the future today, consider joining Robotics Delivery & Packaging Innovations (RDPI) Technology Deployment team within Amazon Robotics (AR) org. In RDPI, we have the unique role and privilege of deploying leading edge industrial robotics and customer fulfillment technologies across North America Stores operations. We raise the bar on the speed, quality and cost of deploying industrial technologies at scale across North America, functioning as the field team who plan, execute and launch the technologies that our internal design and product strategy partners in RDPI develop. Project durations vary from a few days to several months, with travel across North America. This is a travel-based role and you will be expected to travel to meet the requirements of your projects across North America, upwards of 75% or more.

As a Systems Engineer in RDPI, you will be overseeing large scale project planning, installation, and launch of industrial automation technologies across Amazons growing Stores network. This field engineering position demands strong technical skills for deploying robotic equipment, including mechanical and electrical systems, network configurations, and software coordination. The ideal candidate has experience with complex electro-mechanical and network systems, demonstrating leadership in installation, maintenance, upgrades, and troubleshooting of technologies being deployed across North America. You will work with cross-functional partners across our engineering, product strategy, software, supply chain, third-party installers, contracted deployment engineers, construction teams, and internal operations customer teams, functioning as the lead on-site project manager to provide technical oversight on installation Amazon-designed automation equipment. This Systems Engineer position is an individual contributor role, influencing and leading stakeholders from planning through go-live of each project. Candidates should have a proven track record of successfully leading multiple concurrent projects across one or more automation solutions.

**Relocation to Amazon Corporate offices in Seattle, Boston, Nashville or Austin will be required for the role.



Key job responsibilities
As a Systems Engineer I, you will work with a team of 1-5 engineers and collaborate with an on-site project manager to provide technical oversight on the installation of both third party and Amazon designed robotics equipment that may be in various phases of the product life cycle. These deployments require extensive collaboration with various stakeholders, including third-party installers, contracted engineers, construction, hardware, software, IT, and other partner teams. Strong communication skills are essential for interacting with both internal and external partners and customers. As an Amazonian, you must demonstrate independent initiative to identify and solve problems in real time during deployments. A strong technical understanding, love for field work, and a keen interest in diving deep into the understanding of Amazon’s robotics systems are key attributes for this role.

- You will support and guide installation of robotics, packaging and sortation technologies at Amazon fulfillment centers

- You will develop detailed knowledge of the operation of robotic systems and guide installation, commissioning, and troubleshooting of these systems both on site and remotely

- You will manage technical ambiguity around integration of work cells in fulfillment centers

- You will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams

- You will travel to project sites and collaborate both virtually and in person to ensure all business stakeholders are aligned on program status

- You will manage day to day project scheduling and budget management

- You will work on continuous improvement activities to improve the projects in your space

- You will generate and implement continuous improvement ideas around work-scopes

- You will lead teams of other engineers on projects

- You will travel to both live warehouses and new construction sites, the scopes may vary significantly in length and include heavy travel

- You will travel to project sites across North America, upwards of 75% or more

A day in the life
In this role you will be focused on execution of end-to-end deployment and manage technical ambiguity around integration of workcells in fulfillment centers. On a daily basis you will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams, to ensure the product you are deploying, is both ready for deployment and capable of achieving the business requirements. You will travel to your project sites, collaborate both virtually and in person, to ensure all business stakeholders are aligned on program status. You will manage the day-to-day project execution, and work on continuous improvement activities to improve the projects in your space. You will spend time with mentors and your manager to develop your professional skills and collaborate amongst your team to move the needle on the services you are accountable for.

Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:

1. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
2. Maternity and Parental Leave Options
3. Paid Time Off (PTO)
4. 401(k) Plan

If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you! At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!



About the team
Are you inspired by invention? Is problem solving through teamwork in your DNA? Do you like the idea of seeing how your work impacts the bigger picture? Answer yes to any of these and you’ll fit right in here at Robotics Delivery & Packaging Innovation (RDPI) within Amazon Robotics (AR). We are a smart, collaborative team of enthusiastic doers that work passionately to apply new and innovative advances in robotics and software to solve real-world challenges that will transform our customers’ experiences in ways we can’t even image yet. We invent new improvements every day. We are RDPI and we will give you the tools and support you need to invent with us in ways that are rewarding, fulfilling and fun

RDPI Tech Deployment are missioned with enabling the delivery of large scale automation technologies designed and manufactured by Amazon. The team is multi-disciplinary, and consists of Field Deployment Engineers, Controls Engineering, Design for Deployment, Product Single Threaded Leaders, and a Program Management Office team, who collaborate on enabling the delivery of new technologies and packaging solutions that delight our customers, and improve the safety, quality and costs within the Amazon fulfillment processes. The team is geographically located across four North America hub locations. The work we deliver directly impact high priority goals set each year to our most senior leadership at Amazon.

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial Engineering, or related STEM field
- 1+ years' Experience working on mechanical, electrical, IT networked, or software systems
- Understanding of data collection, reporting processes, and ability to make data-driven decisions
- Ability to review data to set troubleshoot priorities on highly complex technical systems
- Ability to handle multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced environment
- Interest to work primarily in a construction or warehouse environment in a field-based role
- Ability to travel domestically 75% or more of the year

Preferred qualifications

- Proven experience working on hardware integration or complex mechanical-electrical or networked industrial equipment. Knowledge of specific robotic equipment (Fanuc, ABB), and Allen Bradley PLC experience
- Knowledge of networking protocols such as HTTP, DNS and TCP/IP
