title: International Business Development Manager, AWS GCR ENT Programs
descriptionHtml:
About Amazon Web Services
Since 2006, Amazon Web Services has been the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud. AWS has been continually expanding its services to support virtually any workload, and it now has more than 240 fully featured services for compute, storage, databases, networking, analytics, machine learning and artificial intelligence (AI), Internet of Things (IoT), mobile, security, hybrid, media, and application development, deployment, and management from 105 Availability Zones within 33 geographic regions, with announced plans for 18 more Availability Zones and 6 more AWS Regions in Malaysia, Mexico, New Zealand, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Thailand. Millions of customers—including the fastest-growing startups, largest enterprises, and leading government agencies—trust AWS to power their infrastructure, become more agile, and lower costs. To learn more about AWS, visit aws.amazon.com.

AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.

The Role
We are looking for an International Business Development Manager to join our International Business Development (IBD) team, based in Singapore, report to China & Hong Kong (CMHK) organization and focused on the Asia Pacific & Japan (APJ) region. Our mission is to accelerate CMHK customers’ global expansion — helping high-growth companies grow across borders in both directions. You will own the cross-border go-to-market bridge between customers expanding into and out of CMHK, connecting them with the right regional teams, partners, and programs to turn expansion ambitions into launched business.
This is a high-ownership, result-driven role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, works comfortably across cultures and time zones, and is energized by making others successful. You will act as a single-threaded owner for cross-border growth in APJ — spotting opportunities early, orchestrating the players who can capture them, and driving momentum from first introduction through to sustained growth.

Key job responsibilities
What You’ll Do
• Own cross-border go-to-market in APJ. Act as the single-threaded owner for cross-border growth in the region — driving strategy, execution, and outcomes end-to-end rather than waiting for boundaries to be drawn. Connect customers with the right teams. Orchestrate high-quality introductions between customers and the regional account, partner, and specialist teams best placed to serve them, accelerating pipeline through relationships and trust.
• Lead China–ASEAN / APJ collaboration. Own the region’s most active cross-border corridor, building and sustaining the relationships and cadences that move opportunities forward across markets.
• Accelerate pipeline and drive launched business. Identify, unblock, and progress cross-border opportunities — measured by influenced pipeline and launched revenue across both expansion motions. Orchestrate events and GTM activities. Plan and run the executive engagements, customer events, and go-to-market activities that create momentum and open doors across regions.
• Partner across a matrixed organization. Work hand-in-hand with program teams, regional sales leaders, and partners — succeeding by making others successful and strengthening ownership in the ambiguous spaces between teams.
• Make cross-border value visible. Define and communicate a clear service model — what you offer, when to engage you, and what you deliver — so your contribution compounds into recognized business impact.

A day in the life
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.


Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.


About the team
About the Team
The International Business Development team drives a two-way, cross-border growth mandate. We help customers based in one market succeed as they expand into another — combining deep local relationships, cross-regional coordination, and go-to-market expertise that no single account team owns alone. The team operates across the two core motions that define cross-border growth:
• China2Global (C2G) Outbound expansion — supporting fast-growing customers as they enter APJ market, connecting them to the regional account teams and resources that accelerate their launch and scale.
• Global2China (G2C) — helping APJ customers land and grow in CMHK, building the local relationships and go-to-market motion that turn interest into launched business.
This APJ-based seat concentrates on the region’s highest-value cross-border flows, with a particular focus on collaboration between China and the broader ASEAN and APJ markets — the single heaviest cross-border corridor the team supports.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience in Go-To-Market, Business Development, Sales, or Consulting
- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
- 3+ years of working with Core Cloud Technology Services, including, but not limited to Compute, Edge, Hybrid, Security, and/or Networking experience
- A track record of driving cross-border, regional, or international business growth — particularly across APJ and/or China markets. Excellent communication skills in English; professional proficiency in Mandarin is highly valued given the China–APJ focus.

Preferred qualifications

- Strong relationship and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to influence and mobilize teams you do not directly manage.

title: Design Manager, Operations Design Team
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is seeking an experienced and business orientated Design Manager who will own the delivery of innovative designs within a portfolio for the International Operations Design Team. The Design Manager is responsible for the management of processes, information flow and acts as an SME in facilitating collaboration and portfolio alignment to deliver layouts on time and to a high quality.

The ideal candidate will be a natural self-starter and experienced in logistics and design, possessing a high work capacity & agility. They will be detail-orientated and data-driven with a talent for problem-solving and a positive can-do-attitude. Knowledge of operations processes, design dependencies and execution for a construction and fit-out environment is critical. In this role, the individual will understand all aspects of planning, design and deployment of an Amazon Fulfillment Centers (FC) and co-ordinate the composite design deliverables. The individual will ensure that customer needs for designs are met and drive year-on-year improvement in stakeholder collaboration and efficiency. The Design Manager will support the Design Program Manager in planning, execution and tracking of the program, working within a cross-functional team to provide best in class designs and deliver turnkey ready projects from day 1.

The role will be based in Barcelona, with some travel expected for up to 50% of the time, depending on the project portfolio.


Key job responsibilities
• Manage and deliver composite designs, with no compromise on safety and the quality of customer experience. Bring scale to programs and establish opportunities to share value of initiatives with multiple teams;
• Foster a culture of collaboration and common objectives to ensure stakeholders are brought on the journey and customer solutions can be delivered with precision;
• Run efficient high-quality designs and processes ready for field execution. Ensure that designs are reviewed and accepted prior to enable approvals within SLA and meeting regulatory compliance. Protect overall quality, drive consistency and avoid compliance issues across the program;
• Contributes to cost reduction efforts, identify opportunities for cost savings/avoidance through clash detection, flow and process improvement, P&D allocations and other initiatives within the program;
• Own end-to-end design for projects assigned, mentor/support team members on design improvements. Demonstrate proactivity in solving design problems for the wider business. Manage strategic non-portfolio program development;
• Act as a subject matter expert for Ops Design processes within and outside GES;
• Facilitate program level meetings and tracking;
• Collaborate with stakeholders across multiple teams during design, execution and launch, and with technical partners to ensure timely elevation and resolution of potential risks and issues
• Comfortable in different roles and able to effectively communicate & work with subject matter experts in Safety, Construction, Engineering, Real Estate, Procurement etc

Basic qualifications

- Master's degree in Engineering (any domain) or foreign equivalent, Operations, Business Administration, or a related field
- Experience in Design/Innovation, research & development, manufacturing, process, industrial engineering, or related work
- Experience in management of engineering design projects
- Experience leading engineering design projects and interacting with cross-functional teams
- Experience with Microsoft Office products and applications
- Experience using one or more of the following technologies (e.g., AutoCAD, Rhino, Revit, SolidWorks, CREO, BIM360, SketchUp, KeyShot, etc.) to deliver high quality models and designs
- Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of concepts like system architecture, optimization, system dynamics, system analysis, statistical analysis, reliability analysis, and decision making
- Experience with complex automated material handling equipment, packaging technologies, and systems and high-speed manufacturing
- Experience with design-in-safety
- Experience with process design based on Lean Principles

title: Senior Ad Policy Manager, Ads Trust Policy
descriptionHtml:
Advertising is one of the fastest growing businesses at Amazon and that growth generates challenges in managing huge volumes of advertising submissions while maintaining a high customer experience and working at the speed that advertisers demand. We believe that advertising, done well, can enhance the value of our customer experience and generate a positive ROI for our advertising partners.

As part of Advertising Trust’s Policy & Integrity team, you will have high visibility across Amazon business lines, establishing the right customer experience and long-term strategy for the success of Amazon Advertising. We are a global and diverse team with a long tenure in online advertising, expertise in developing customer experience solutions for highly complex situations, risk mitigation, and brand integrity. We are looking for deep thinkers, innovators, and individuals who are customer obsessed.

Key job responsibilities
• Develop and implement advertising product policies, including brand safety and suitability guidelines to protect customers, advertisers, and publishers.
• Relationship management of a portfolio of Amazon owned and operated publishers on behalf of the Ads Trust Policy Team.
• Clearly communicate risks, including through high-quality written presentations, behind policies to internal stakeholder teams to support understanding and consensus of policy positions
• Work with product teams by creating business requirement documents to ensure policy compliance for developing ad products
• Build collaborative relationships across other policy teams within the Ad Trust Policy team, across Ads Trust, the Sales organization, Legal, PR, Public Policy and other business units outside of Ads as necessary to support policy management.
•Occasionally support high-risk and high-impact escalations in partnership with moderation and tiered support teams.
•Build an understanding of how ad tech systems generally function and how Amazon’s functions to inform policy work.

A day in the life
In a typical day a Policy Manager will monitor policies for accuracy and fit using a variety of signals and may handle escalated questions related to compliance with our ad policies in categories. They will develop knowledge in locale specific requirements and make decisions that consider cultural and societal norms. They will be build policy recommendations based on assessing risk across multiple risk vectors. They work with product teams to understand the intersection of policy and product to solve for risks in the most efficient ways. They will partner with internal publishers and external supply partners. They will identify areas for collaboration, resource sharing and escalation management coordination between multiple teams across Amazon that work in the same space, in order to bring consistency to our advertisers and shoppers.

About the team
The Ad policy team owns global ad policies across all ad products and Amazon Publishers. This dynamic team is an integral part of how we support Amazon Advertising and as such has touch points across multiple areas of our business. We make a customer impact with every ad we serve and pride ourselves on doing so with a customer-centric focus.

Basic qualifications

- Master's degree or above in a relevant discipline (e.g. Law, Political Science, Public Policy, Public Affairs, Economic Development)
- Experience in programmatic advertising

- Experience with advertising publishers and marketing/creative agencies

title: Technicien en infrastructure réseau | Network Infrastructure Technician , Global Network Deploy- YYC
descriptionHtml:
Nous cherchons à recruter des techniciens réseau hautement motivés et de premier ordre pour rejoindre notre équipe en pleine croissance au sein des opérations d'infrastructure. Les candidats travailleront avec un minimum de supervision dans un environnement dynamique afin d'assurer la stabilité et la durabilité de nos réseaux de nouvelle génération, et de développer des moyens innovants pour automatiser et faire évoluer notre réseau à mesure que nous nous développons.

Les responsabilités du poste incluent le soutien à la mise à l'échelle de plusieurs centres de données AWS en Alberta, ainsi que la gestion quotidienne de la capacité. Le technicien réseau travaillera en étroite collaboration avec les clients internes d'AWS et les fournisseurs externes afin de faciliter la bonne exécution des projets, sous la direction des gestionnaires de programmes techniques.

Les candidats idéaux seront très autonomes, extrêmement soucieux du détail, posséderont d'excellentes compétences en communication écrite et verbale, et auront une expérience significative dans le soutien de réseaux d'entreprise à grande échelle. D'excellentes compétences en mise en œuvre et en dépannage réseau, combinées à une méthodologie de documentation éprouvée, sont également requises. De solides compétences en communication écrite et verbale ainsi que la capacité d'interagir efficacement avec les collègues et les clients sont indispensables. Le désir et la capacité de travailler dans un environnement collaboratif et au rythme soutenu sont essentiels. En plus de fournir une gestion et un soutien de premier niveau pour la vaste infrastructure réseau d'Amazon, les techniciens réseau doivent créer ou améliorer des outils, développer les meilleures pratiques, affiner les procédures opérationnelles et constamment penser de manière proactive et innovante.We are looking to hire highly motivated, best-in-class Network Technicians to join our growing team within infrastructure operations. The candidates will work with minimum supervision in a dynamic environment to drive the stability and sustainability of our next-generation networks and to develop innovative ways to automate and scale our network as we expand.

The position responsibilities include scaling support of several data center locations of AWS in Alberta, and be responsible for day-to-day assistance with capacity management. The Network Technician will work closely with both internal customers of AWS and external vendors to facilitate smooth project execution as directed by Technical Program Managers.

Ideal candidates will be highly autonomous, very detail oriented, possess strong written and verbal communication skills and have significant experience in supporting large scale, enterprise class networks. Excellent network implementation and troubleshooting skills combined with proven documentation methodology are also required. Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to interact efficiently with peers and customers are required. The desire and ability to work in a fast paced, collaborative environment is essential. In addition to providing top-tier management and support of Amazons vast network infrastructure, Network Technicians are expected to build or enhance tools, develop best practices, refine operational procedure and constantly think proactively and innovatively.


Key job responsibilities
En tant que technicien réseau ID, les responsabilités clés, les connaissances et l'expérience requises incluront les éléments suivants :

Surveiller la file d'attente pour les nouvelles demandes, les changements ou les projets
Planifier et mettre en œuvre les projets assignés conformément aux processus et normes définis
Estimer les exigences des projets en termes de temps, de coûts et de ressources
Suivre les directives de gestion du changement lors de l'exécution des projets ; travailler avec les fournisseurs selon les besoins des projets et surveiller leur travail ; collaborer avec les équipes interfonctionnelles, y compris les gestionnaires de programmes techniques réseau et les ingénieurs ; se tenir informé des nouvelles technologies, processus et conceptions ; respecter les normes de sécurité et de sûreté
Dépanner les problèmes réseau ou de composants physiques selon les besoins lors du déploiement
Communiquer avec les parties prenantes, partager des mises à jour régulières et travailler à l'élimination des obstacles aux projets
Dépanner les problèmes de réseau, de routage et d'interconnectivité, y compris le dépannage de la configuration des équipements réseau et des interactions applicatives de bas niveau
Gérer le travail et les priorités via le système de billetterie et les flux de travail
Des déplacements pouvant aller jusqu'à 30 % peuvent être requis
Dépanner les problèmes de connectivité de l'infrastructure de câblage, y compris les panneaux de brassage et les cordons de raccordement
Traiter les demandes des clients via le système de billetterie
Participer à l'installation, la migration, la configuration de base et le déploiement de matériel nouveau ou mis à niveau
Familiarité avec les termes courants de réseautique
Expérience substantielle dans la mise en œuvre de réseaux à grande échelle en centres de données et le soutien de la couche physique de l'infrastructure réseau
Connaissances en réseautique TCP/IP
Compréhension générale des technologies d'infrastructure
Connaissance du câblage réseau, des types de fibres optiques et des équipements de test, tels que le VFL (localisateur visuel de défauts), le puissance-mètre et l'OTDR (réflectomètre optique temporel)
Expérience avec les meilleures pratiques et méthodologies d'infrastructure de câblage
Familiarité avec les termes courants de réseautique
As ID Network Technician key responsibilities, Knowledge and Experience required will include the following :
• Monitoring the queue for new requests, changes or projects
• Plan and implement assigned project as per defined processes and standards
• Estimate project requirements in terms of time, cost and resources
• Follow change management guidelines during the execution of projects work with vendors as needed for the projects and monitor their work collaborate with cross functional teams including network TPM and engineers remain updated about the new technologies, processes and designs follow safety and security standards

title: Field Support Engineer, Fauna
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for an Field Support Engineer to join the Fauna Robotics support team. This role is hands-on technical problem-solving combined with operational ownership that helps the team scale. You will be a primary point of contact for customers experiencing issues with Fauna robots in the field, responsible for diagnosing problems that span hardware and software, and driving those issues to resolution with a high degree of independence. You will take active ownership of building and improving support infrastructure: establishing the tools, processes, documentation, and feedback loops that the team needs as our customer fleet grows.

You will work directly with highly technical customers including engineers, scientists, and researchers, conducting troubleshooting across mechanical, electrical, and software systems and driving issues to root cause and resolution.

You will work as part of a cross-functional support team that includes field engineers and technical support staff, collaborating on issue resolution from initial diagnosis through on-site repair.

Key job responsibilities
- Serve as a primary technical point of contact for customer-reported issues with Fauna robots, conducting remote troubleshooting and driving problems to root cause and resolution across hardware and software domains.

- Develop and maintain support infrastructure including ticketing/case management, knowledge base, troubleshooting playbooks, and corrective action documentation.

- Analyze and report on support metrics (response time, resolution time, issue categorization, repeat failure rates) to identify trends, surface insights, and inform product improvements.

- Communicate field issues clearly to engineering and software teams through structured reporting, advocating for resolution priority by providing field impact context and detailed reproduction steps.

- Refine and improve escalation criteria and handoff processes for issues requiring on-site field support or bench-level repair, identifying gaps and driving process improvements.

- Create and maintain customer-facing and internal support documentation including troubleshooting guides, FAQs, known-issue bulletins, and repair procedures.

- Collaborate with field engineers by providing diagnostic context and handoff documentation when issues require on-site intervention.

- Proactively identify recurring issue patterns, build decision trees, and develop tools or scripts that accelerate troubleshooting and reduce resolution time.

Basic qualifications

- Experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems
- Experience troubleshooting and documenting findings
- Experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems, or experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities and experience in software development
- 4 years of experience in a technical support, applications engineering, systems engineering, or field engineering role, or equivalent hands-on experience working with robotic or electromechanical systems.
- Demonstrated ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to technical audiences, both verbally and in writing.
- Experience documenting technical processes, writing troubleshooting guides, or building knowledge base content.
- Ability to independently manage multiple open issues simultaneously, prioritize based on severity and customer impact, and drive problems to resolution.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working with robotic systems in a support, integration, test, or applications role.
- Familiarity with hardware troubleshooting including mechanical assemblies, actuators, sensors, and electrical systems.
- Experience building or owning support documentation, knowledge bases, or operational processes.
- Background supporting highly technical customers (researchers, engineers, scientists).
- Experience setting up or administering case management or ticketing systems, not just using them.
- Familiarity with ROS, embedded systems, or common robotics middleware.
- Exposure to field service operations, spare parts management, or repair workflows.

title: Sr. Supplier Quality Engineer, Infrastructure Reliability & Quality
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services Infrastructure Reliability & Quality (IRQ) engineering team provides engineering support for our data center infrastructure mechanical and electrical equipment (Air Handling Unit, Switchgear, Breaker, Panel Board, UPS, Transformers, Generators, ATS etc.) as well as infrastructure security equipment (Cameras, Access Control, etc.) throughout their lifecycle. A critical piece of this support is ensuring the highest level of initial quality and ongoing support from our suppliers.

As a Senior Quality Engineer, you will ensure the highest standards of quality for AWS infrastructure equipment from supplier selection through field deployment. You will evaluate supplier capabilities through technical assessments and on-site evaluations, investigate quality issues using analytical approaches including failure mode analysis and apply engineering judgment to assess quality risks across design, manufacturing, and deployment stages. You will use critical thinking to drive field root cause analysis, identifying underlying failure mechanisms and developing effective corrective actions. Working closely with AWS Engineering teams, Procurement teams, Commissioning teams, and suppliers, you will develop data-driven insights from supplier performance metrics and field observations to drive improvements that enhance equipment quality. You will partner with engineering teams to define equipment specifications and acceptance criteria, work with suppliers to implement improvements through technical guidance and capability building, and collaborate with commissioning and operations teams to translate field performance findings into actionable quality improvements. You will also build and maintain quality roadmaps that align with AWS infrastructure goals, analyze trends across multiple equipment categories and suppliers to identify systemic quality challenges, and manage multiple concurrent quality initiatives across different regions and equipment types.

Keys to success in this role include sound judgment and excellent written/verbal communication skills.

Travel required, both international and domestic, approximately 30-50%

In this role you will:
- Develop, implement and maintain the supplier quality roadmap across engineering and procurement teams.
- Conduct technical investigations of equipment failures to understand root causes and prevent recurrence
- Provide technical expertise on quality evaluation methods, testing approaches, and failure analysis techniques
- Drive supplier and product qualification and assessment processes in support of procurement teams. This includes developing technical approaches for evaluating new equipment and suppliers entering the AWS ecosystem
- Drive continuous improvement initiatives that address both immediate quality issues and long-term performance optimization
- Develop and implement Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to monitor supplier quality performance and drive accountability
- Work on concurrent projects, sometimes in multiple geographical regions.

A day in the life
Your day will be a dynamic blend of technical investigation, strategic problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration. You'll dive deep into equipment performance data, conduct detailed failure analyses, and develop innovative solutions that prevent future technical challenges. From remote meetings with global supplier teams to on-site technical assessments, you'll be at the forefront of maintaining AWS's infrastructure excellence.

descriptionHtml:
Are you excited about building the marketing engine for a new business from the ground up? We are looking for a Product Marketing Manager to own and drive growth for the Ring Appstore. This is not a traditional marketing role — you will run the full marketing motion for a business that connects hardware, software, and third-party integrations, taking responsibility for strategy, execution, measurement, and iteration. You will own marketing for two distinct customer segments: third-party developers who build apps for Ring, and Ring customers who subscribe and use 3P apps.

Your mission: accelerate Ring Appstore growth by driving awareness, acquisition, engagement, and retention across Ring customers and third-party app developers.

descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

We’re seeking an experienced Infrastructure Technical Program Manager in Herndon VA to oversee data center build projects in the Northern Virginia region. You will lead cross-functional and technical teams from conceptual design feasibility through requirements, budget, completed design, implementation, testing, and deployment. Along the way, you will use your judgment, negotiation skills, ability to influence without authority, analytical talent, technical aptitude, and leadership to collaborate with a diverse set of stakeholders across multiple time zones, manage capital budgets, eliminate non-value-add activity, design solutions, remove blockers, and find creative ways to accelerate project delivery.

The candidate must be comfortable managing remote project delivery teams, and possess the ability to facilitate technical whiteboard sessions to troubleshoot project implementation issues, and remove barriers to project success. Being able to stand up cross-functional teams, establish trust with a variety of stakeholders across multiple time zones, manage capital budgets, eliminate non-value-add activity, design solutions, remove blockers, and find creative ways to accelerate project delivery is a must.

The ideal candidate will be an exceptionally strong communicator, both written and verbally, and possess experience in tactical project management of highly technical initiatives, as well as strategic program management. They will be able to apply a variety of project management tools, methodologies and techniques for all phases of the project lifecycle and exhibit demonstrated experience in core project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, resources, quality and risk management, reporting and metric development/tracking. Experience with MS Project, Asana, Tableau, and systems integration a plus.

The candidate will work through ambiguity, competing priorities, and be capable of understanding mechanical/electrical engineering concepts. Experience in managing data center infrastructure deployments is a plus. Candidates possessing a background in architecture/design, mechanical/electrical engineering, software/hardware engineering, data center infrastructure/operations, and/or construction, who have transitioned to a program management discipline will have a distinct advantage.

If you enjoy the challenges of deploying highly technical and innovative projects at massive scale, this job is for you!

title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Payments & Fraud Prevention
descriptionHtml:
What if the data you engineer could stop fraud before it happens - and protect millions of AWS customers worldwide?
The Payments and Fraud Data Platform team within AWS Payments & Fraud is the backbone of one of the most critical missions at AWS: ensuring every transaction is safe, every suspension is justified, and every customer experience is seamless. We process petabytes of data daily, powering the ML models, rule engines, and real-time reporting systems that allow us to detect bad actors.
We are looking for a Software Development Engineer who is passionate about building large-scale data systems, thrives in ambiguity, and wants to work at the intersection of big data, machine learning, non-payment and fraud prevention.

Key job responsibilities
Architect & Build Petabyte-Scale Data Pipelines - Design, develop, and optimize batch and near-real-time data pipelines using Amazon Managed Airflow (MWAA), Fargate, EMR, Apache Iceberg, and Amazon Redshift to ingest, transform, and serve data at massive scale.
Power ML & Rules Engines - Deliver high-quality, timely datasets that fuel non payment and fraud detection ML models and business rule engines, directly impacting fraud prevention and non-payment suspension accuracy.
Build Intelligent Data Access Layers - Design and implement a Smart Query & Data Access Analyzer that profiles query patterns, identifies hot data, and automatically promotes frequently accessed datasets into hot memory tiers (e.g., OpenSearch, DynamoDB DAX, Redshift RA3 caching) for sub-second retrieval.
Create Natural Language SQL Interfaces - Leverage Amazon Bedrock and LLM (large language models) to build a natural language-to-SQL generation tool that empowers analysts and stakeholders to query complex fraud datasets conversationally - no SQL expertise required.
Develop Real-Time Dashboards & Insights - Build rich, interactive dashboards using Grafana and internal tooling that provide real-time visibility into fraud trends, pipeline health, data quality metrics, and operational KPIs.
Curate a Living Data Dictionary - Design and maintain a comprehensive, searchable data catalog and dictionary that provides rich metadata, lineage, and documentation - improving discoverability and self-service analytics across the organization.
Champion Data Quality at Scale - Implement automated data validation, anomaly detection, and reconciliation frameworks that ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency across the entire data lifecycle.
Secure & Govern Sensitive Data - Implement encryption, fine-grained access controls, audit trails, and compliance frameworks to protect highly sensitive payments and fraud data.
Monitor, Optimize, Repeat - Build observability into everything , proactive alerting, pipeline performance tracking, SLA monitoring, and intelligent auto-remediation to ensure five-nines data reliability.

About the team
The AWS Payments & Fraud Prevention team protects AWS and its customers from fraud, abuse, and account compromise at global scale. We build highly scalable, batch and near real-time systems that ingest billions of signals daily, process petabytes of data, and make timed decisions to stop bad actors from account registration through the entire customer lifecycle. Our platform is built on a modern, cloud-native architecture designed for petabyte-class batch processing. Our stack includes Amazon MWAA orchestrates workflows, while EMR and Fargate handle scalable data processing. Amazon Redshift powers our data warehouse, complemented by an Apache Iceberg lakehouse for open table format flexibility. DynamoDB and OpenSearch drives search and analytics, and Amazon Bedrock serves as our AI/ML foundation. Development is accelerated with Kiro, an AI-powered IDE, and Grafana provides full-stack observability.
We are a team of builders who care deeply about customer trust and love solving complex problems at massive scale.

- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

title: Propulsion Functional Technician, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is an initiative to launch a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world. The Propulsion team is seeking a Manufacturing Functional Technician to join the team to support production manufacturing of future flight hardware.
The Propulsion Manufacturing Functional Technician will work within the Amazon Leo Propulsion Manufacturing Team supporting the build and integration of electric propulsion subsystems, including feed systems, thrusters, cathodes, PCBAs, tanks, and the integrated propulsion system.
This technician will be knowledgeable across multiple manufacturing process paths, perform troubleshooting activities, support training programs, and lead process improvement initiatives within their scope. The ideal candidate brings hands-on manufacturing experience with flight hardware and thrives in a fast-paced production environment.

Additional Requirements:

Standing for long periods of time, climbing up and down ladders, bending, grasping, sitting, pulling, pushing, stooping, and stretching may be required to perform the functions of this position

Able to lift-up to 25lbs. unassisted

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Candidates must be 18 years or older with the ability to understand and adhere to all job requirements and safety guidelines.

The starting pay for this role in Washington State is up to $33.50 / hour and employees are eligible for incremental raises based on tenure. This information is provided per the Washington State Pay Transparency Act. Base pay information is based on market location. Applicants should apply via Amazon’s internal or external careers site.

Key job responsibilities
Assemble, fabricate, and process materials into complex manufactured products across propulsion subsystems per engineering documentation and SOPs, following one or more defined process paths.

Learn to perform troubleshooting activities associated with manufacturing products, observing, receiving, and obtaining information from all relevant sources to assist in debug and root cause analysis. Seek guidance when deviation from available procedures is needed.

Learn to perform hardware inspections and document discrepancies. May assist with development stage assemblies and first article builds under guidance of senior peers.

Read, interpret, and work from engineering documentation and drawings following well established processes.

Provide engineers with feedback on tooling, consumables, debug observations, and process issues through structured channels such as MES WOT entries.

Identify training needs for the team and assist in the training of new hires and junior peers to help them scale in their role.

Contribute to process improvement ideas within your project scope, working with leaders and engineers individually or in group settings.

Follow best practices as defined by leaders, lead techs, manuals, and SOPs. Meet productivity and quality standards consistently.

Uphold job and site safety standards and operations protocol. Follow proper procedure when quality or safety issues occur.

Attempt to resolve individual work blockers before escalating. Identify additional tasks once assigned work is complete and communicate to Lead Technician before proceeding.

Utilize MES and SAP systems for production tracking, traceability, and work order documentation. Capture and record data accurately in applicable systems.

May assist with servicing, repairing, calibrating, regulating, fine tuning, and testing machines, devices, and equipment.

Attend all relevant technical trainings offered by the organization.

A day in the life
The Propulsion Manufacturing Functional Technician will perform a variety of hardware manufacturing, testing and integration tasks across propulsion subsystems to ensure hardware meets production requirements for flight. They will work closely with engineering teams to provide feedback on processes and identify improvements.
This technician is expected to be knowledgeable across multiple process paths, support peers and new hires, and lead process improvements within their scope. They will utilize MES and SAP systems for daily production tracking and traceability and will actively support the team in resolving work blockers and general operational needs.
A successful candidate thrives in a fast-paced, start-up-like environment and can apply their technical expertise and commitment to quality to positively impact team metrics and organization goals. To be successful they will need to be highly motivated and detail oriented while showing the highest standards of execution.

About the team
The Amazon Leo Propulsion Team is responsible for the design and development of the propulsion system which provides maneuvering capability to the spacecraft. The Propulsion Team is made up of a variety of sub-teams which are responsible for various aspects of the development process, such as mechanical design, systems engineering, subject matter experts, manufacturing, and test. This integrated team structure allows direct communication and rapid process feedback while also promoting close collaboration across the team.

- Can lift up to 49 pounds, stand/walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- High school diploma or equivalent
- 2+ years relevant aerospace/automotive manufacturing experience or equivalent industry experience
- 2+ years of hands-on work experience with electro-mechanical assemblies, final integration and/or harness integration experience
- 2+ year’s experience in a fast-paced production environment with flight hardware
- 2+ years of hands-on experience with precision torque, measurement and inspection devices (i.e., automated and manual torque wrenches, calipers, micrometers, profilometers, optical inspection devices, multi-meters, etc.)

- Experience working with FOD, ESD sensitive hardware and clean room requirements

descriptionHtml:
Amazon Protective Services' Emergency Services and Global Standards is looking for a highly motivated physical security professional to serve as Risk Lead on the Global Services & Standards team. This is a remote role with about 50% international travel.

The team runs on a Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) model, and this role owns the Risk piece. You'll assess risk in new and existing policies, standards, technology and training across Amazon Security and Amazon's subsidiaries. You'll focus mainly on the support functions ESGS teams provide to their customers and on risks to Amazon employees, operations, assets and data. Your assessments will help senior leaders make informed decisions to protect their portfolios.

What you'll do

Build and lead risk assessments that give senior leaders clear findings they can act on.
Work with Amazon Security, Amazon Corporate Security, Amazon Fulfillment Network Security, subsidiaries and other partners to analyze real-world risk and apply the right physical security controls.
Evaluate new and emerging security technologies and practices that could strengthen Amazon's security.
Lead or support evaluations of physical security measures that Amazon Security is considering.
Help develop, analyze and improve global physical security standards, applying Amazon Global Security Policies and Standards throughout.

About you
You're an experienced security professional who works well with people at every level of the organization. You know physical security principles in depth and how to put them into practice. You have hands-on experience with Crime Prevention Through Environmental Design (CPTED), including its principles, data collection and analysis, how people behave in built environments, and presenting findings in reports and briefings. You consistently plan and deliver high-quality work for internal and external customers.

Key job responsibilities
Build programs driven by data and metrics, and agree on goals, objectives and performance outcomes with business partners.

Create and manage global risk and resilience programs that cover both preparing ahead of time and responding in proportion when incidents happen.
Run analytical deep dives to find vulnerabilities and root causes, and turn the findings into thorough risk reports.

Complete detailed threat and risk assessments, with risk treatment plans and recommendations.

Work with teams across functions to develop standards, procedures and processes that match business needs and help identify and reduce security risks.

Produce risk analysis that feeds reports for Amazon Security's most senior leaders.

Keep up with industry trends and events, and maintain relationships with key industry contacts and manufacturers.

Work independently as a self-starter.

A day in the life
No two days are the same. Some days you'll be traveling to an Amazon site somewhere in the world to run an onsite risk assessment, walking the space and talking with local security teams. Other days you'll work remotely, analyzing data, finding root causes and writing risk treatment plans. You'll work with PS teams, Fulfillment and subsidiary partners to understand their challenges. You'll turn your findings into clear recommendations for senior Amazon Security leaders, and you'll keep up with new security technologies and industry trends.

title: Applied Scientist II, International and Emerging Stores Payments
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to translate cutting-edge science into products that expand financial access for millions? At International and Emerging Stores Payments (IESP), we build payment solutions for communities and geographies that Amazon's selection and prices do not yet reach because of payment barriers. These markets make up roughly 80% of the world's countries and 85% of its population.

As an Applied Scientist II on our team, you will design, build, and ship machine learning and generative-AI solutions that remove those barriers and advance financial inclusion, working at the intersection of research and production alongside scientists, engineers, and economists. If you are a curious, self-motivated researcher who turns ambiguity into clarity, we would like to hear from you.

What you will work on:

• Build models that recommend the most suitable payment method for each customer—for example installments, cards, or local payment options—and identify the right customers to reach, balancing customer preference, cost, and risk.
• Take models to production behind a real-time, low-latency personalization layer that serves live shopping traffic at scale.
• Build multi-agent generative-AI systems that turn unstructured inputs—customer feedback, documents, and operational data—into reliable, decision-ready insight, with verification that guards against model hallucination.
• Help customers discover and adopt installments and alternative payment methods.
• Design and analyze large-scale online experiments and causal measurement to validate real customer and business impact.


Key job responsibilities
• Design, develop, and evaluate machine learning and deep learning models, and deploy production-ready solutions to complex customer and business problems.
• Conduct rigorous scientific research: form hypotheses, run experiments, evaluate model performance, and iterate on approaches within your domain of expertise.
• Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code that integrates smoothly into larger systems and meets a high bar for operational excellence.
• Partner with engineering to take your models to production, and with scientists across related payments ML teams to solve shared, complex problems.
• Contribute to team roadmaps, priorities, and technical direction; mentor peers and provide constructive feedback on research and code.
• Publish at peer-reviewed venues and file patent applications where appropriate.

A day in the life
You will start your day reviewing experiment results and refining model architectures based on new insights. Throughout the day you will alternate between writing research code, analyzing data, and discussing technical approaches with teammates, working closely with engineering to build your ideas and take them to production. You will regularly present findings and propose new ideas, and you may write research papers and submit patent applications.

About the team
We are the science team for International and Emerging Stores Payments. We build solutions that directly shape how customers pay and that drive conversion across Amazon's fast-growing international markets—and there is no shortage of hard science and engineering problems, since these markets span most of the world's countries and the majority of its customers. We value scientific rigor, creative problem-solving, and a genuine commitment to learning and growth. If you are excited about building impactful solutions and advancing financial inclusion through applied science, we would love to have you join us.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of building models for business application experience
- PhD, or Master's degree and 4+ years of CS, CE, ML or related field experience
- Experience programming or scripting language like Python, Java, C or C++
- Experience in solving business problems through machine learning, data mining and statistical algorithms

Preferred qualifications

- Ph.D. in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent, or Master's degree and 1+ years of a quantitative field such as statistics, mathematics, data science, business analytics, economics, finance, engineering, or computer science experience
- Experience in building machine learning models for business application
- Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences, including executive level stakeholders or clients
- Experience working with big data, machine learning and predictive modeling
- Experience providing and effectively communicating strategic and tactical recommendations based on data
- Experience in solving complex business challenges by delivering accurate and timely financial models, analysis, and recommendations that have a proven impact on business (e.g., financial savings, operational improvements, or customer benefits), or experience communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience in written and verbal communication skills to communicate with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership
- Experience working with stakeholders to plan and execute programs that are strategic in nature
- Experience in building large-scale machine-learning models and personalization

title: Senior Solutions Architect, National Security Solutions Architecture Team
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services is seeking a Senior Solutions Architect to support our US Government customers in the Northern Virginia / DC Metro area. (Relocation assistance is available.)

This position requires that the candidate selected must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph. The position further requires the candidate to opt into a commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

As a Solutions Architect on the National Security team, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor to your Intelligence Community customers. You are the “face of Amazon” to your customers, and they will consult you regarding a broad variety of technical challenges that are complex and mission-critical. You can build sample solutions, “think big,” and provide architecture designs and cloud enablement strategy that suit your customer’s business and technical needs. This is a high-visibility role where you collaborate with and influence external stakeholders (our government customers) and internal AWS teams like Sales and Platform Engineering.

National Security Solutions Architects are regarded as technical “thought leaders” within the Intelligence Community who evangelize emerging technologies on a conceptual level and on a practical, architectural level. Our SAs have played a critical role in the widespread adoption and advancement of cloud computing capabilities within the Intelligence Community. SAs think outside of the box to deliver results to our customers and provide solutions that are cost-effective, time-saving, and secure. As a National Security SA, you’ll solve problems at both the business and technical levels. You'll work backwards from our customers’ requirements and envision new mechanisms and strategies we can leverage that would enable agencies to operate more efficiently and better execute on their goals. Then, you'll figure out how to make the puzzle pieces fit together from the technical side and deliver the offering to the customer at scale. Frequently, you will be responsible for mission-critical solutions with life-saving implications.

Sometimes, the best way to innovate around a customer pain point is to create a new product altogether. This position offers you the unique opportunity to drive the AWS service roadmap to support our customers’ requirements within the complex technical constraints of the cleared environment.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for technologists who align with our Leadership Principles and possess a unique balance of technical depth and strong interpersonal skills. You will partner with customers, AWS Sales, and several other AWS teams to craft highly scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures that address Intelligence Community customer business problems and accelerate the adoption of AWS services. In collaboration with Sales, you will drive revenue growth across a broad set of customers. As a trusted customer advocate, the solutions architect will help organizations understand best practices around advanced cloud-based solutions and how to migrate existing workloads to the cloud. You will have the opportunity to help shape and execute a strategy to build mindshare and broad use of AWS within the Intelligence Community. The ideal candidate is be self-motivated, with a proven track record in software/technology sales or consulting. The ability to connect technology with measurable business value is critical to a solutions architect. You should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, products, and technical challenges.

We are looking for someone who is passionate about the following:
- Be great fun to work with at AWS. We have a credo of “Work hard. Have fun. Make history." In this role, you will love what you do and instinctively know how to make work fun. You will be dynamic, creative, and willing to take on any challenge and make a big impact.
- Enjoy working with Intelligence Community customers. You will have a passion for educating, training, designing, and building cloud solutions for a diverse and challenging set of Intelligence Community customers.
- Have a strong understanding of large-scale computing solutions. The ideal candidate will have past experience working as a systems or support engineer and pre-sales experience. You will enjoy keeping your existing technical skills honed and developing new ones, so you can make strong contributions to deep architecture discussions. You will regularly take part in deep-dive education and design exercises to create world-class solutions built on AWS.

This position can have periods of up to 25% travel.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph.

Key job responsibilities
- In partnership with the sales team, formulate and execute a sales strategy to exceed revenue objectives through the adoption of AWS
- As a key member of the business development and sales team, ensure success in building and migrating applications, software and services on the AWS platform
- Educate customers of all sizes on the value proposition of AWS, and participate in deep architectural discussions to ensure solutions are designed for successful deployment in the cloud
- Conduct one-to-few and one-to-many training sessions to transfer knowledge to customers considering or already using AWS
- Capture and share best-practice knowledge among the AWS solutions architect community
- Author or otherwise contribute to AWS customer-facing publications such as whitepapers and other reusable content
- Build deep relationships with senior technical individuals within customers to enable them to be cloud advocates
- Act as a technical liaison between customers, service engineering teams and support

About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic qualifications

- 8+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
- 6+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
- Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences, including executive level stakeholders or clients
- Experience working with customers, technical teams, and management to collect requirements, describe software product features, and technical designs
- Current, active US Government Security Clearance of TS/SCI with Polygraph

Preferred qualifications

- 10+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience
- Experience architecting or deploying Cloud/Virtualization solutions in enterprise customers
- Experience architecting infrastructure solutions using both Linux/Unix and Windows with specific recommendations on server, load balancing, HA/DR, & storage architectures
- Bachelor's degree, or CASP+ (CompTIA Advanced Security Practitioner) or CCSP (Certified Cloud Security Professional) or Cloud+ or CSSLP (Certified Secure Software Lifecycle Professional)

descriptionHtml:
Impulsione a adoção da nuvem em escala, projetando e executando campanhas de geração de demanda que conectam empresas às soluções AWS sob medida para suas necessidades. Você atuará em parceria com equipes de vendas, marketing e desenvolvimento de negócios para identificar oportunidades de alto impacto e guiar prospects ao longo de sua jornada na nuvem, influenciando diretamente a forma como as organizações transformam suas operações.

Key job responsibilities
- Executar campanhas de geração de demanda direcionadas a listas de prospects estabelecidas e setores-chave para impulsionar a geração de leads qualificados.
- Desenvolver e manter listas estratégicas de contatos dentro dos setores e empresas-alvo, garantindo dados precisos e segmentação relevante.
- Comunicar a proposta de valor e os casos de uso aplicáveis dos serviços AWS para clientes potenciais por meio de mensagens de campanha e ações de outreach.
- Colaborar com a gestão regional de vendas, operações de marketing e equipes de desenvolvimento de negócios para alinhar metas de campanha, mensagens e processos de roteamento de leads.
- Gerenciar múltiplas campanhas simultâneas em diferentes regiões, acompanhando métricas de desempenho e atingindo metas mensais de oportunidades qualificadas.

A day in the life
Nesta função, você se concentrará em executar campanhas de geração de demanda direcionadas que apresentam os serviços AWS para clientes potenciais em múltiplas regiões. Você começará o dia revisando métricas de desempenho das campanhas e identificando oportunidades de otimização, para então dedicar-se ao desenvolvimento de listas estratégicas de contatos dentro de setores e empresas-chave. Ao longo do dia, você colaborará com a gestão regional de vendas e operações de marketing para refinar mensagens e garantir que as campanhas ressoem com casos de uso específicos e segmentos de clientes. Você também trabalhará para articular como as soluções AWS resolvem desafios reais de negócios, e em seguida coordenará com a equipe de vendas para assegurar que os leads qualificados recebam acompanhamento oportuno. Seu trabalho abrange múltiplas campanhas simultâneas, exigindo que você equilibre prioridades enquanto mantém relacionamentos sólidos com stakeholders internos e externos.

About the team
Experiencia Diversas
A AWS valoriza experiências diversas. Mesmo que você não atenda a todas as qualificações e habilidades preferenciais listadas na descrição da vaga, encorajamos os candidatos a se inscreverem. Se sua carreira está apenas começando, não seguiu um caminho tradicional ou inclui experiências alternativas, não deixe que isso o impeça de se candidatar.

Porque AWS?
A Amazon Web Services (AWS) é a plataforma de nuvem mais abrangente e amplamente adotada do mundo. Fomos pioneiros em computação em nuvem e nunca paramos de inovar — é por isso que clientes, desde as startups mais bem-sucedidas até empresas do Global 500, confiam em nosso robusto portfólio de produtos e serviços para impulsionar seus negócios.

Cultura de Time Inclusivo
A AWS valoriza a curiosidade e a conexão. Nossos grupos de afinidade, liderados por colaboradores e patrocinados pela empresa, promovem a inclusão e empoderam nossas pessoas a terem orgulho daquilo que nos torna únicos. Nossos eventos de inclusão fortalecem equipes mais colaborativas. Nossa inovação contínua é impulsionada pelas ideias ousadas, perspectivas novas e vozes apaixonadas que nossas equipes trazem a tudo o que fazemos.

Mentoria e Crescimento de Carreira
Estamos continuamente elevando nosso padrão de desempenho à medida que nos esforçamos para nos tornar o Melhor Empregador do Mundo. É por isso que você encontrará aqui infinitos recursos de compartilhamento de conhecimento, mentoria e outros recursos para o avanço da carreira, que o ajudarão a se desenvolver como um profissional mais completo.

Alcançar o sucesso no trabalho nunca deve acontecer à custa de sacrifícios em casa, e é por isso que buscamos flexibilidade como parte da nossa cultura de trabalho. Quando nos sentimos apoiados no ambiente de trabalho e em casa, não há nada que não possamos alcançar.

title: Senior VAT Analyst, AWS International Compliance
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's diverse business requires VAT filings in a number of jurisdictions globally. Amazon is seeking a driven and enthusiastic VAT Compliance Senior Tax Analyst to work in its International Indirect Tax Compliance team based in London or Manchester, UK. The Amazon tax team is a fast-paced, team-focused, and dynamic environment. This position will be responsible (as part of a larger team) for the preparation of EMEA VAT returns and related filings.

You will be expected to own critical VAT compliance activities, support internal and external audits, liaise with colleagues across tax and the wider business and participate in business projects on behalf of indirect tax. You should possess a strong understanding of ERP systems and intermediate to strong technical accounting skills. You will also be expected to identify process improvement opportunities for existing processes and controls, and drive positive change across the organisation.


Key job responsibilities
Working within the International Indirect Tax Compliance team, the Senior VAT Compliance Analyst will be required to:

• Prepare, analyse, review and submit EMEA VAT returns and related filings;
• Prepare, analyse, review and submit intrastat returns as necessary;
• Organise VAT registrations across various jurisdictions;
• Assist with VAT compliance queries from Amazon businesses operating across EMEA;
• Assist in the mapping of VAT processes, and identify areas for improvement and solutions for VAT issues;
• Prepare and review month-end VAT account reconciliations;
• Provide internal and external audit support, including data analysis;
• Provide VAT compliance support to colleagues throughout the business and, in particular, accounting groups and contributing and driving preparation of Tax Requirement Documents for tech teams;
• Lead and participate in cross-functional projects with a priority on automation and in-housing.
• Supports business growth and on-boarding of new entities to VAT compliance processes.

Basic qualifications

- Experience working in a large public accounting firm or multi-national corporate tax department
- Bachelor's degree in business, finance, accounting, tax, economics, or a related analytical field, or a Bachelor's degree and experience in tax, finance or a related analytical field
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications (especially Excel)
- 4+ years of experience of working in VAT
- Business fluent in English

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in ownership of projects and communicating timelines and executing independently
- Experience prioritizing and handling multiple assignments at any given time while maintaining commitment to deadlines, or experience completing complex tasks quickly with little to no guidance and react with appropriate urgency to situations that require a quick turnaround
- Experience working in a large team or fast-paced corporate environment
- A recognised accounting or tax qualification (CIMA, ACCA, ACA, AAT or similar);

title: Principal Product Manager - Technical, Mechanical Infrastructure, Data Center Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services is seeking a high-impact Principal Product Manager with a deep specialization in mechanical infrastructure to define and execute the product strategy for our next-generation infrastructure and facility systems. As a technical leader, you will bridge the gap between abstract business/scale goals and physical engineering realities, ensuring our designs are fit for purpose, scalable, and cost-effective.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

As a Principal Mechanical Product Manager you will be responsible for defining the "what" and "why" of our mechanical strategy, ensuring alignment across cross-functional teams, and driving critical decisions even in the face of complexity or resistance. The leader in this role has the ability to make tough calls, stand behind decisions, and navigate obstacles. You must be comfortable pushing back on stakeholders and driving alignment.

You are the voice of the business at the front of the pipeline — the person who decides which platforms earn the organization’s capacity, and why. You own the customer need each platform serves, its system-level requirements, and how it fits into the broader roadmap. You own the technical requirements strategy that sets the foundation for timing, cost, and execution. You own the mechanism by which field, cost, and customer signals are collected, converted into requirements for a new platform or its next revision, and prioritized against everything else in the portfolio. You bring rigor to the front end so that platforms enter the pipeline with validated business requirements, clear boundaries, and a defensible priority.






Key job responsibilities
- System-Level Ownership: Own and understand how mechanical designs impact the broader infrastructure (e.g., cooling, electrical, structural). Evaluate how new business requests affect the entire fleet and propose integrated solutions.
- Product Strategy & Roadmap: Define and communicate a multi-year vision, strategy, and product roadmap for advanced mechanical infrastructure products. Coordinate between multiple teams to develop compelling business cases to substantiate business value, define product prioritization, and outline budget and resources required to implement product roadmaps.
- Modular Standardization: Standardize complex mechanical systems into modular, prefabricated skids to compress on-site data center construction and commissioning timelines.
- Global Compliance & Localization: Ensure the core mechanical product line remains compatible across multiple global geographic zones, accommodating varying regional building codes, environmental constraints, and extreme climate variations.
- Strategic Alignment & Vision: Lead the definition of challenges at the facility and product levels. Ensure all stakeholders are aligned on the path forward, particularly when navigating complex transitions.
- Value Engineering & Decision Making: Actively challenge existing assumptions regarding cost and complexity.
- Technical Leadership: Serve as a subject matter expert who can evaluate technical trade-offs.
- Systems Thinking: Ability to see the big picture and understand the upstream/downstream impacts of mechanical design choices on electrical and structural systems.



A day in the life
Your day moves between signal and strategy.
