title: Commissioning Engineer, AWS Commissioning, AMER-West
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Are you experienced in Critical Infrastructure Commissioning and looking for a fast paced environment to work in? As a Data Center Commissioning Engineer (CxE), you will be part of highly creative, efficient team tasked with tackling fascinating and challenging problems building and supporting the operations of Amazon owned data centers. The Amazon Commissioning team (ACx) understands, evaluates, defines and manages the expectations of construction quality in accordance to engineering designs to meet the customer requirements. The CxE is responsible for supporting vendors, contractors, and other teams involved in the construction and commissioning of various systems such as:

-Medium and low voltage power systems
-Generators
-UPS
-HVAC (Air Handlers / Exhaust Fans / VFD)
-Chilled Water Systems
-Building Management systems (BMS)
-Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS)
-Testing and balancing
-Pumps and Hydronic systems

Physical Requirements
Walk job sites in uneven terrain
Work at heights and from ladders
Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl
Lift and/or move up to 49 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 50 pounds or more
Carry objects weighing up to 49 pounds for short distances
Work shifts longer than eight hours in duration with potential for night and weekends
Perform physical tasks throughout the day without becoming overly tired
Ability to manipulate small wires and objects easily
Work in a noisy environment
Work in environments that are colder or hotter than a normal office environment

Additional Job Requirements
· Ability and willingness to travel domestic and internationally for up to 80% of the year.
· Hold a US passport or have the ability to acquire one.
· Required to provide personal transportation for meetings and job visits away from the office; reimbursed.

U.S Citizenship Required

Key job responsibilities
The Commissioning Engineer (CxE) provides testing and validation oversight of AWS data center electrical and mechanical infrastructure. CxEs review design documents, lead Factory Witness Testing (FWT), and manage third-party commissioning vendors in the performance of onsite pre-functional, functional, and integrated systems testing. They take Ownership of their projects’ successes by Diving Deep to resolve technical issues and having Bias for Action to address everchanging schedule and coordination demands onsite. Additionally, CxEs communicate lessons learned and continuously collaborate on program improvements.

The CxE shall provide multi-discipline input into the scheduling, test script development, designing, and planning of projects. In addition, the CxE will be required to review component submittal packages, lead Factory Witness Testing (FWT), perform system level and integrated system testing. During commissioning the CxE will continuously audit activities to ensure compliance with environmental, quality, and safety requirements. Additionally, the individual will be responsible for comprehensive weekly reporting of status of all ongoing projects and lessons learned to continually improve the quality of our program. This position will include coverage of multiple inflight projects and short timelines.

A day in the life
On a typical project, the CxE works across AWS engineering, capacity delivery, operations, and contractor teams to coordinate site activities, prioritize tasks, and ensure each issue has clear path to resolution. The CxE manages the project commissioning vendor whose primary scope is to identify issues, determine criticality, propose solutions, and document their findings. If project turnover is at risk, the CxE escalates to the appropriate stakeholders. Upon project completion, the CxE will communicate lessons learned to help peers on similar projects in flight and participate in initiatives that drive improvement to the commissioning program.

About the team
The AWS Data Center Commissioning Team (ACx) is a wholly independent business within the DCGS organization. This team of veteran professional Electrical Engineers, Mechanical Engineers, Controls Engineers, Architectural Engineers, Project Managers, Operators and seasoned Amazonians are uniquely positioned to provide deeply detailed engineering and operational review and testing of equipment designs, operational functionality and construction practices. We are focused on ensuring the rapid delivery of a quality product while maintaining full transparency, recording metrics of manufacturer/contractor/equipment issues pre-PFHO, and identifying opportunities for all our peers and customers.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: Sr. Commercial Operations Mgr, Amazon Manufacturing Services
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Manufacturing Services (AMS) is Amazon's internal advanced manufacturing operation, delivering rapid prototyping and production services to engineering teams across the company. Our manufacturing capabilities span metals fabrication, CNC machining, and additive manufacturing, and we are actively expanding into new service areas to meet growing internal demand.
We take products from concept to finished hardware, enabling Amazon engineering teams to move faster and at lower cost than external sourcing allows. AMS is in a high-growth phase, adding capabilities and service lines, and we are building the commercial engine to match.

Commercial operations at AMS is not a support function. It is the engine that connects our manufacturing capabilities to our customers and drives the growth of the business. The Commercial Operations Manager owns that engine entirely.
You will be the commercial leader for AMS. You set priorities, build the team, own the customer relationship, and drive revenue execution. You decide how orders are sequenced, how customers are served, and how the commercial organization scales. You are the primary point of contact for customers from first quote to final delivery.
AMS has a strong and growing pipeline of manufacturing work across Amazon business lines. The prototyping flywheel is real and it is accelerating. The right commercial leader will build the systems and team to capture that demand, shorten cycle times, and grow the customer base. This role has scope, authority, and room to grow.


Key job responsibilities
Commercial Operations and Order Management
• Own the full order lifecycle from intake through delivery, including quoting, estimation, scheduling, and customer communication.
• Drive quoting and estimation turnaround to consistently meet our promise dates.
• Hold the team accountable to the rapid prototyping SLA at greater than 95% on-time performance.
• Plan and execute on orders generated by business development, ensuring clean hand-offs from opportunity to active order.
• Manage order sequencing and customer prioritization. Make tradeoff decisions when demand exceeds capacity.
• Negotiate delivery timelines directly with customers, including for large and complex projects.

Customer Success and Account Growth
• Own the customer relationship from order acceptance through delivery completion.
• Drive account growth with existing customers across new prototyping and managed order projects.
• Build and sustain a high customer satisfaction score by managing the end-to-end customer experience.
• Resolve escalations and service failures directly. Own the outcome.

Commercial Growth and Marketing
• Own rapid prototyping revenue growth by managing pipeline, capacity utilization, and order execution.
• Develop and execute the marketing and branding strategy for AMS services, including customer-facing materials and service catalog management.
• Build and maintain the commercial processes that support AMS as it scales.

Team Leadership
• Hire, develop, and retain the commercial operations team.
• Set clear expectations, delegate with accountability, and build a team that runs without requiring escalation on standard decisions.

Technology and Process
• Drive requirements for the tools and systems that support quoting, order tracking, and customer communications.
• Identify and prioritize improvements to commercial systems. Get requirements onto the technology roadmap.
• Design scalable processes that reduce manual effort and improve speed and accuracy across commercial operations.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or other STEM field
- 3+ years of people management experience
- • 7+ years of Manufacturing industry experience, including direct exposure to production operations, order management, or customer-facing commercial functions in a manufacturing environment.
- • 3+ years of Commercial operations experience: managing a sales or order funnel, owning customer accounts, and managing customer projects end to end.
- • Demonstrated ability to make prioritization and tradeoff decisions under capacity constraints without escalating routine issues.
- • Track record of holding a team accountable to measurable service commitments.

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree, or MBA in management, business administration, economics, engineering, marketing
- Experience developing and implementing systems and tools utilized for CRM, variable compensation, revenue reporting, forecasting, sales force automation or equivalent
- Experience in technical sales for B2B or in solution-sales / technology-related environment
- • 3+ years of experience building commercial operations processes in a high-growth or startup-to-scale manufacturing environment.
- • Experience owning revenue growth targets or a commercial P&L.
- • Familiarity with rapid prototyping, additive manufacturing, or digital manufacturing services.

descriptionHtml:

descriptionHtml:
As a Data Centre Construction Manager you will be a part of creative, efficient team tasked with tackling fascinating and challenging problems building and supporting the operations of Amazon owned data centres. - Direct interface with construction general contractors during the bidding, award, execution, and project closeout/punch list phases.

- Lead negotiations with general contractors and evaluate bids/proposals with detail and accuracy.
- Creation of construction project scope and request for proposals.
- Capital requests/financial analysis of construction work including change orders, purchase orders, and invoicing.
- Construction project management for specific initiatives aimed at increasing the resiliency of our data centres.

- Construction submittal review.
- Construction project quality control including the creation of a commissioning plan and support of the commissioning process.
- Recording and reporting key construction metrics to team members and management.
- Drive teams to perform troubleshooting and root-cause failure analysis associated with equipment or electrical failures.
- Be a leader within the group as well as within internal and external teams that support the data centre.

title: Controls Technician, Data Center Capacity Delivery, Amazon Data Services, Inc
descriptionHtml:
As a member of the Global Controls Team, you will collaborate with highly motivated operators, engineers and technicians in the data center industry to maintain and optimize critical infrastructure systems. You will be responsible for troubleshooting and maintaining the Building Management System (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS) while developing new processes and standards that drive innovation in the controls space.

AWS data centers utilize sophisticated industrial control systems to automatically operate mechanical equipment, maintaining optimal temperature and pressure conditions throughout the facilities. These systems integrate and monitor multiple critical components, including generators, uninterruptible power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic and static transfer switches, air-cooled and water-cooled chillers, pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, Computer Room Air Handlers (CRAHs), and air economizers. Within this industrial control system infrastructure, the BMS serves as the primary control platform for all mechanical systems within the data center, while the EPMS functions as the primary monitoring platform for all electrical systems. This position offers the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology in mission-critical environments while contributing to the reliability and efficiency of AWS's global infrastructure.

This position requires access to information that is subject to U.S. export control regulations, and applicants must be a 'U.S. Person' as defined by applicable law, which includes U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents, refugees, and asylees.

Key job responsibilities
Primarily work in and support multiple data centers by deploying, servicing, and upgrading BMS and EPMS systems.
Mentor and train Facilities team members on the operation and control of BMS and EPMS systems.
Audit, maintain, and manage computer enterprise asset management systems for BMS and EPMS installations.
Manage small to medium-sized projects and programs.
Perform point-to-point checkouts between field devices and controllers.
Perform first-line diagnostics, troubleshooting, and maintenance of programming code and hardware associated with BMS and EPMS in data centers.
Execute provisioning processes for servers, controllers, industrial PCs, and network configurations, including communication testing between third-party devices and controllers or servers.
Install, replace, configure, and calibrate sensors.
Read and interpret electrical schematics and control panel drawings with a basic understanding of closed-loop controls, field sensor scaling, and functions typically performed by industrial controllers.
Supervise low-voltage electrical contractors performing wiring and installation of field devices in compliance with AWS requirements.
Provide commissioning and systems-level testing support.

A day in the life
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- Associate's degree or above
- Basic understanding of Industrial controls system, knowledge of meters, devices, sensors, relays and troubleshooting utilizing standard hand tools, digital metering, or calibration/diagnostic equipment in a data center, hospitals, large commercial complex, water, power, oil & gas or similar industries.
- Ability to work non-standard hours and differing work rotations/shifts and overtime as required.
- Associate’s degree, trade school certification, or other certified training in a related technical field with 1 years of relevant industrial Controls or HVAC controls experience, OR 2 years of relevant industrial or HVAC controls experience in lieu of a degree.

Preferred qualifications

- International Society of Automation (ISA) Certified Controls System Technician (CCST) Level I or higher certification.
- Experiencing using common communication protocols (MQTT, BACnet, and/or MODBUS).
- 5+ years of experience in controls/automation, construction or related field in a technical environment.
- Demonstrated understanding of engineering documentation, electrical and mechanical diagrams, and standard operating procedures.
- Experience in data centers or mission critical environment
- Fundamental knowledge of network design and layout as well as low voltage (copper/ fiber) cabling.
- Prior AWS/Amazon experience
- 4+ Yr. Military Service

title: Risk Manager, NA Water, EAP
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Global Environmental Assurance and Protection team works to make Amazon the global benchmark for environmental excellence across our operations. As the NA Water Program Manager, you own the lifecycle of Amazon's most complex water compliance programs across North America and translate an ambiguous, fast-moving regulatory landscape into program frameworks the field can execute. That scope covers water quality and discharge compliance, stormwater and wastewater management, water stewardship and conservation, and emerging water regulatory obligations across the NA region. You take partially defined business problems and regulatory requirements and turn them into structured programs with clear objectives, milestones, and success criteria, owning each program through its pilot, prove, and scale phases.


As an individual contributor, you own the strategic definition and lifecycle management of these water programs. You decompose ambiguous challenges into program plans that account for real field constraints, define what "done" looks like, and design the systems, processes, and tools, with measurement built in, that the field organization adopts and sustains without ongoing program-level intervention. You partner with Legal, regulatory affairs, operations, technology, and procurement to keep programs aligned with the operating model, and you contribute to OP1 and OP2 narratives while owning organizational goals within the NA water program portfolio.


You identify and influence cross-functional investments that solve long-term water compliance requirements, negotiating resources, priorities, and timelines across organizations. You build business cases with quantified risk and ROI, present them to Director and VP audiences, and represent EAP in cross-functional planning cadences so that water compliance requirements are embedded in business decisions. You own program controllership mechanisms, business review cadences, escalation paths, and metric dashboards, that surface risk and drive accountability in real time, and you independently proxy for the Senior Manager in business reviews and cross-functional forums with full ownership.


This role requires independent judgment, a high tolerance for ambiguity, and the ability to find a path forward where solutions are not pre-defined, driving cross-functional alignment without deferring decisions upward. You communicate technical compliance requirements clearly to executive, operational, and legal audiences, and you use data and business intelligence to look around corners, spotting and mitigating risk before it materializes. If you are motivated by solving complex regulatory problems at scale and building the compliance infrastructure to match, this role is for you.

Key job responsibilities
- Translate the NA water compliance vision into executable program frameworks, integrating program objectives into OP1, OP2, and quarterly planning cycles across in-scope business units.
- Own the lifecycle of NA water compliance programs, including water quality, discharge, stormwater, and wastewater, taking each from problem definition through pilot, prove, and scale.
- Contribute to multi-year operating plans and program budget inputs, and recommend resource allocation trade-offs that balance immediate compliance obligations against long-term infrastructure investment.
- Design and operate program controllership mechanisms, business review cadences, escalation paths, and metric dashboards, that surface and mitigate water compliance risk and drive accountability across internal and external stakeholders without requiring manager intervention.
- Communicate compliance program status, risks, and escalations clearly and concisely to Director and VP-level audiences across Operations, Legal, Finance, and Technology, and independently proxy for the Senior Manager in WBRs, MBRs, and cross-functional forums.
- Partner with Amazon Legal, state and local regulators, environmental consultants, and technology teams to resolve water compliance barriers, accelerate engineered solutions, and reduce manual dependency in compliance execution.
- Define and implement KPI and compliance metric frameworks that provide real-time visibility into water program performance, milestone achievement, and regulatory posture across in-scope business units.
- Build data-driven business cases with quantified risk and ROI to secure cross-functional investment, negotiating priorities and timelines across organizations.
- Oversee work performed by third-party contractors, consultants, and inspection vendors, holding external partners accountable to program milestones and quality standards through structured audit and governance mechanisms.
- Work autonomously in a highly ambiguous, high-stakes regulatory environment, exercising independent judgment to find paths forward where solutions are not pre-defined and driving cross-functional alignment without deferring decisions upward.
- Embed water compliance objectives into day-to-day operational rhythms and design mechanisms the field sustains without ongoing program-level intervention.
- Travel expected up to 25-50% of the time.

Basic qualifications

- 6+ years of compliance, audit or risk management experience
- 5+ years of program or project Management experience
- Experience owning program strategy, end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Bachelor's degree in Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) or related field

Preferred qualifications

title: Operations Supervisor, Quick Commerce
descriptionHtml:

6:30-15:00 Tuesday to Sunday 

Operations is the heart and soul of everything Amazon does. It is thanks to effective operations that items are processed and dispatched to our customers on time. Being an Operations Lead/Supervisor gives you the chance to see how all the different parts of operations work and play a role in making sure everything runs smoothly.

You’ll be the first point of contact for team members during their shift and help them follow the processes that your managers have put in place. This is a hands-on role, which will give you experience in using the tools and systems that make our operations successful.

Key job responsibilities
Measure and monitor workflows, track onsite performance, and provide important shift information to frontline management to ensure operational excellence across shifts
Support and train employees to deliver great service and supervise them in their daily tasks
Support the Shift/Area Manager with projects to improve processes, cultivate a safe working environment, and increase workforce engagement
Work with other departments to find solutions to address common issues or support needs in areas of key performance
Use data analysis to identify ways to optimise safety, quality and productivity

A day in the life
As an Operations Lead/Supervisor, you’ll be based in one of our operational sites. You’ll support your Shift/Area Manager to carry out the plan for the shift. That will involve helping with pre-shift meetings with your team and monitoring procedures to make sure everyone is following safety rules, quality processes, and the priority plan for the day.

You’ll escalate any issues you spot to your manager, but sometimes you’ll be the most senior person on shift and will give people the direction they need to complete their tasks. Our operations have two key components. Our 'under the roof' associates process orders with industry-leading speed, picking and packing customer orders to enable our 30-minute delivery promise. We operate with a people-first approach, with teams working across morning and afternoon shifts to serve customers seven days a week.

We continuously innovate to improve customer experience, focusing on sustainable delivery solutions in dense urban areas while maintaining strict quality and food safety standards.

title: Senior Product Development Engineer, Annapurna Labs Silicon Operations
descriptionHtml:
AWS-Annapurna Labs develops the silicon used in our most advanced machine learning accelerator servers at cutting-edge process nodes. These SOCs are used in massively scaled server clusters to provide the best hardware platform for our customers to run training and inference workloads.

We are seeking a Senior Silicon Yield Product Engineer to take full ownership of a product's yield across one or more test insertions — from wafer sort through package final test, system level test, and downstream card/server/fleet test. You will set the yield strategy for your product by identifying and prioritizing the cost and quality activities, aligning requirements with key stakeholders, and directing the work of other engineers to deliver against them. You will engage foundry, OSAT, DFT, supply chain, test, manufacturing, and system validation partners at a strategic level to define the cost, schedule, and resource models required to bring a new product to production. Because our final product is a server, not just the silicon, you will routinely stretch beyond traditional silicon product engineering boundaries — solving complex, cross-organizational problems that no single team owns. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, deep knowledge of semiconductor manufacturing processes, and expertise in statistical analysis are essential.


Key job responsibilities
- Own the end-to-end yield of one or more products across wafer sort, final test, SLT, driving both systematic yield improvement and excursion response to targets you help define.
- Identify and address customer quality issues by monitoring downstream yields and quality from card test through customer utilization in production.
- Identify and prioritize cost, quality, characterization activities, and assign and coordinate the work across a team of engineers.
- Align product requirements with key stakeholders, and define and drive the cost, schedule, and resource requirements to successfully deliver a new product to production.
- Create new tools and analysis flows to keep pace with the rising complexity of Machine Learning products, and evaluate new tools and systems offered by external vendors.
- Engage strategically with DFT, supply chain, test, manufacturing, quality, foundry, and OSAT teams as a trusted resource counted on to solve complex problems requiring cross-organizational expertise.
- Lead functional and structural test coverage improvements at ATE and system through DOE planning and targeted characterization.
- Mentor junior engineers, identify knowledge and skill gaps within the team, and define growth paths for individuals and the organization.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field
- 7+ years of semiconductor industry experience as a product/test engineer analyzing test data, including ownership of yield or test for a product at one or more insertions
- Experience using Python or other scripting languages for data analysis and automation
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
- Demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional initiatives and influence stakeholders without direct authority

Preferred qualifications

- Experience owning yield and performance optimization at system or ATE test on advanced FINFET nodes across a full product lifecycle
- Deep understanding of ATE test content (Scan, BIST, Functional, IO tests) and experience defining test limits and screening methodologies based on characterization
- Experience with power and performance characterization on high-performance chips
- Experience defining cost, schedule, and resource models for new product introduction (NPI)
- Knowledge of usage of ATPG scan diagnostics and SRAM bitmap analysis for FA and yield debug.
- Proficiency in statistical analysis tools (JMP, Python) and automation for semiconductor test data.
- Experience building automated analysis systems and interactive dashboards for yield and quality monitoring.
- Experience mentoring engineers and evaluating vendor tools/systems
- Familiarity with AWS services (SageMaker, S3, QuickSight, etc.) and ability to use these for automation

title: Lab Test Engineer, Environmental Test, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon LEO is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite broadband network. Its mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet to customers and communities around the world, and we’ve designed the system with the capacity, flexibility, and performance to serve a wide range of customers, from individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

The Lab Test Engineer role is responsible for keeping aerospace environmental test production running smoothly. You will troubleshoot issues that technicians encounter during daily testing, resolving problems with test setup, equipment, and IT infrastructure. The Lab Test Engineer will be an expert for our various Automated Test Equipment (Test Racks) used during environmental testing. With your expertise in environmental testing procedures, equipment, and basic Python scripting, you will identify root causes and implement corrective actions to maximize productivity and product quality. Additionally, you are responsible for production support activities including ticket management, change management, monitoring, metrics, documentation, process development, host provisioning, and hardware management. You may also debug, evaluate, and resolve software issues for applications and services that will improve availability and performance. You will develop scripts and applications to automate redundant tasks and to improve operational efficiency. You will work cross-functionally with Development, QA, and other Support teams to maintain and improve availability and performance of Amazon LEO's production Automated Test Equipment.

Key job responsibilities
- Maintain, troubleshoot and improve test automation hardware supporting production testing
- Troubleshoot electrical, mechanical or software problems on the fly, working with an integrated cross-functional team of manufacturing engineers, test engineers, lab technicians and maintenance teams to resolve
- Perform RCCA of issues in production testing and implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence
- Develop and maintain calibration procedures for RF test equipment
- Define and implement solutions to optimize and automate environmental testing
- Work with other engineers to refine test requirements and the methodologies to achieve those requirements
- Willing to “roll up sleeves and do what needs to be done” in a small, specialized, team environment
- Must be willing to work off shifts and weekends as required



A day in the life
The primary goal of this role is to ensure all automated production test racks remain fully operational, properly calibrated, and ready for use by production technicians. Daily responsibilities include planning and coordinating preventive maintenance with schedulers, organizing and tracking all rack calibration activities, and maintaining accurate documentation and hardware configuration data in partnership with supporting engineering teams.

This role also oversees the readiness of spare test racks, ensuring they are maintained, functional, and available for rapid swap-in when needed. It includes coordinating any required repairs to return equipment to operational status. Additional responsibilities include cataloging test harness requirements, monitoring inventory and life-usage of harnesses, and ensuring adequate spare coverage.

The engineer is expected to respond quickly to escalations from technicians, providing troubleshooting support and resolving operational issues with the test racks to minimize production downtime.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of hardware development, test lab, space/aerospace maintenance or hands-on engineering environment experience
- 2+ years of experience testing, troubleshooting, and debugging automated test systems including electrical, mechanical, electronic, networking, and software systems
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related field and/or equivalent experience
- 2+ years of production test station (automated test equipment) hardware/software design and factory deployment
- 2+ years of experience with electrical test equipment, data acquisition, and control software
- Experience writing/reading/debugging software in Python, C, C# or other language

Preferred qualifications

- 4+ years of hardware design, development, validation and delivery of embedded hardware product experience
- 2+ years of experience with environmental testing focusing on thermal and vacuum test processes
- 2+ years of experience working with RF test systems

descriptionHtml:

title: Senior Program Manager, Seller Fees Science & Tech
descriptionHtml:
The Fee Strategy Operations team is seeking an experienced, enthusiastic, and diligent Program Manager to drive cross-functional go-to-market (GTM) execution for fee and incentive launches across Amazon's worldwide marketplace. This role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution—partnering with Fee Strategy, Product, Operations, Legal, Seller Communications, and regional stakeholders to ensure seamless delivery of fee/incentive changes to Sellers globally. This role provides the unique opportunity of managing billion dollar incentive programs across stores and drive seller success.

Our environment is fast-paced and demands a self-starter who is detail-oriented, analytical, and comfortable navigating ambiguity across multiple teams, partners, and levels of management. You will own end-to-end program delivery, understand business problems at a strategic level, and have the ability to prevent or mitigate the consequences of poor business decisions. As the program owner, you will look at the bigger business picture, drive outcomes by understanding relevant business requirements, and deliver results with minimal oversight.

Key job responsibilities
Cross-Functional Partnership & Stakeholder Management

Partner with worldwide cross-functional teams to align GTM strategy, timelines, and deliverables for fee and incentive launches and changes. Collaborate closely with Fee Strategy Product Managers to understand GTM requirements, translate them into actionable work-backwards plans, and drive execution of GTM activities across all fee/incentive types. Act as the primary liaison between Fee Strategy and WW partner teams—Country Fees POCs, GPO, Legal, Science, Seller Communications, Reporting, and Operations—to track, report, and monitor launch readiness, central content readiness, country teams' readiness, announcement plans, and cross-team alignment. Develop working-backwards plans and establish mechanisms to track, monitor, and report on GTM execution and launch readiness.

GTM Execution & Content Management

Identify and deliver updates to Seller-facing communications (SeCe), partnering with Country Fees POCs and partner teams to prepare and align on internal content and readiness for launches and changes. Manage end-to-end delivery of content updates for BRDs, TRDs, ARDs, Help Pages, Paragon SOPs, and country/partner teams' internal readiness for all fee/incentive types, following the GTM Launch Playbook. Maintain a centralized repository of Seller-facing content resources and internal launch documentation, managing ongoing content updates throughout the year while ensuring accuracy and version control.

Process Development & Operational Excellence

Build and implement program mechanisms to drive GTM execution, collect Seller Voice of Seller (VOS) feedback, define program performance metrics, synthesize insights, and share actionable summaries with product teams. Perform fee/incentive change validation activities, report observations and discrepancies to Product and Tech teams, and drive resolution to closure.

Program Leadership

Execute high-priority, cross-functional, high-impact projects self-sufficiently with minimal oversight. Solve complex, ambiguous problems independently by applying sound judgment, data-driven analysis, and structured thinking. Identify process gaps and proactively propose scalable solutions that improve efficiency and reduce operational risk. Analyze the overall program performance and drive program roadmap with product.

A day in the life
As a Senior Program Manager in Fee Strategy Operations, you operate at the intersection of strategy and execution. Your day involves leading cross-functional syncs with Fee Strategy PMs, Country Fees POCs, GPO, Legal, Seller Communications, and Operations to align on launch readiness, resolve blockers, and confirm content and announcement timelines across regions. You manage hands-on deliverables—reviewing and updating Help Pages and Paragon SOPs in the centralized content repository, tracking program documentation completion and updates, performing fee change validations against Seller-facing surfaces, and escalating discrepancies to Tech/Product teams for resolution. Equally, you invest time in building scalable mechanisms—developing work-backwards plans for newly approved fee/incentive changes, synthesizing Seller VOS feedback into actionable insights for product teams, and refining the GTM playbook based on lessons learned from prior cycles. You independently manage ambiguity across 6+ partner teams spanning multiple geographies, drive cross-functional alignment without authority, and deliver results with minimal oversight—balancing strategic coordination with operational rigor every single day. You monitor the performance of the program, identify gaps, and work with country team to improve key conversion and selection metric.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of program or project management experience
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- 4+ years of developing program strategies and plans, diving execution, and influencing senior stakeholders experience

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
- Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams
- Experience managing competing priorities across a wide range of stakeholders
- Experience in written and verbal communication skills to communicate with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership
- Experience with go-to-market planning, launch execution, or operational readiness programs

title: Controls Engineer, Deployment, CDS - DCCD
descriptionHtml:
As part of the global controls team, you will work with highly motivated experts and innovators in the data center industry. You will be responsible for troubleshooting, project management, and maintaining the building management system (BMS) and electrical power monitoring system (EPMS). Using Amazon leadership principles, you will develop new processes and standards while innovating in the controls space. AWS Data centers have multiple components such as generators, uninterruptible power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic/static transfer switches, chillers [air-cooled and water-cooled], pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, CRAHs, air economizers, etc. All these components have local control systems that interact with each other via open and/or proprietary communications protocols. The BMS is the primary method of control of all mechanical systems within a data center. The EPMS is the primary method of monitoring all electrical systems within a data center.

Key job responsibilities
Train and assist internal customers and stakeholders with the creation, design, configuration, validation, installation, commissioning and operation of BMS and EPMS systems.

Provide technical assistance and support to operations during life cycle of the data center. Review results and action items from the quarterly maintenances for BMS and EPMS and take actions to get them resolved.

Develop BMS & EPMS projects scope of work, schedule, budget, and level of efforts (LOE) to projects requested by customers and stakeholders.

Manage scope, schedule, finance and execution of BMS and EPMS improvement projects in AWS data centers.

Assist in procurement related activities including request for quotation/proposals, responding to request for information, review of vendors proposal and issuance of purchase orders.

Participate in AWS global on-call schedule to provide immediate BMS and EPMS technical support to in-service data centers.

Attend project related meetings, coordinate with project leaders and regularly report status to Controls and stakeholders’ management.

Support Controls projects related commissioning activities in the data centers.

Review, implement, troubleshoot and iterate on the controls sequence of operation (SOO) and provide necessary feedback to the design team.

Develop and modify controls logic programming and graphical user interfaces.

Manage multiple stakeholder deliverables, requirements and navigate challenging situations.

Financially manage BMS and EPMS service contracts.

Frequently visit (locally) assigned in-operation and/or under construction data centers to troubleshoot, meet customers, supervise vendor’s work to ensure compliance with the scope, design, SOO and applicable local codes.

A day in the life
As a Data Center Controls Engineer, your primary customers are Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO), who depend on you to deliver reliable, well integrated Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS). The problems you solve are technical: modifying controls logic to address operational issues, developing Methods of Procedure (MOPs) for firmware upgrades, or investigating complex alarm discrepancies across monitoring systems. For new builds, you own the controls scope from vendor submittal review through commissioning and turnover. You manage vendor relationships, budgets, and schedules for both service contracts and capital projects. Your internal stakeholders include your Controls Manager, Controls Technicians you provide technical direction to, and partner teams (Construction, Critical Projects Implementation, Commissioning, DCEO).

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
- Experience with Industrial control systems, both hardware and software
- 4+ years of general contractor and vendor management work (request for proposals, bidding, change orders, quality control, RFI/submittal tracking) associated with construction and project execution experience
- 5+ years of experience with industrial controls in critical environment (data center, pharmaceutical, oil & gas, petrochemical, laboratory, power, water etc.).

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of engineering documentation, electrical diagrams and standard operating procedures
- Master's degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering or a related field
- 4+ years of military experience
- Experience designing, configuring, programming, installing, troubleshooting or servicing HVAC Controls or Electrical SCADA systems application specific controllers, software and networks.
- Experiencing using common industrial communication protocols (MQTT, BACnet and/or MODBUS).
- Demonstrated understanding of engineering documentation, electrical and mechanical diagrams, and standard operating procedures.
- Registered as a Professional Engineer (PE), or certified Project Management Professional (PMP).

title: Senior Manager, Internal Comms
descriptionHtml:
If you are interested in this position, please apply on Twitch's Career site https://www.twitch.tv/jobs/en/

About Us:

Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day.
We’re about community, inside and out. You’ll find coworkers who are eager to team up, collaborate, and smash (or elegantly solve) problems together. We’re on a quest to empower live communities, so if this sounds good to you, see what we’re up to on LinkedIn and X,  and discover the projects we’re solving on our Blog. Be sure to explore our Interviewing Guide to learn how to ace our interview process.

About the Role

We’re looking for someone to lead internal communications across the company. You’ll help employees understand what’s happening and why it matters, help navigate complex company moments and transitions, and develop company All Hands programming that people look forward to.

It’s a role with range. One day you might be shaping comms for an organizational change; the next, developing a new All Hands segment or finding a great story buried somewhere in the company. We’re looking for someone with excellent judgment, strong instincts, and real creative ambition — someone who runs toward the hard stuff and is always thinking about how to make internal communications more useful, interesting, and engaging. Keeping employees informed and connected, and finding ways to highlight and celebrate our people, our work, and our community, are at the heart of this position.

You can work in New York, NY; San Francisco, CA; Los Angeles, CA; Irvine, CA; or Seattle, WA

You Will

Manage Internal Comms
- Own internal comms strategy and execution across the company.
- Author company-level messaging, making sure employees get the information and context they need.
- Partner with executives and teams across Twitch on sensitive or complex issues, anticipating employee questions and helping leaders communicate clearly.
- Develop comms plans for organizational changes, company announcements, and other important moments.
- Track employee engagement and feedback, using what you learn to make our communications more useful and effective.
Own All Hands
- Lead All Hands programming, including editorial strategy and content development.
- Work closely with production and creative partners on run of show, speaker prep, creative elements, and live production.
- Build relationships across the company to uncover great stories, interesting speakers, and work employees should know about.
- Develop new segments and formats that keep All Hands fresh, engaging, and worth employees’ time.
- Think creatively about how All Hands can evolve. We want someone who sees it as programming—not just a company meeting—and has ideas for making it better.
- Bring rigor to how we measure success, using attendance, engagement, feedback, and other signals to understand what employees are responding to and what we should change.

Perks
- Medical, Dental, Vision & Disability Insurance
- 401(k)
- Maternity & Parental Leave
- Flexible PTO
- Amazon Employee Discount

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
- 5+ years of experience
- You can build a communications strategy around a complicated transition, and then get into the details of an All Hands segment.
- You’re curious about what’s really happening around the company, what employees care about, and what they need to hear from us. You’re comfortable asking tough questions and pushing for clarity when something doesn’t make sense.
- You’re creative, too. You have opinions about what makes internal programming interesting, know how to find a good story inside a company, and are excited to try new things. You want to build an All Hands that earns employees’ attention, and you’re willing to experiment, measure, and pivot when needed.
- You’re a strong project manager and producer who can keep multiple timelines moving at once — delivering weekly programming while planning for what’s ahead. You can turn an idea into a compelling segment, bring company and community moments to life, and partner with creative and production teams to make the final product stronger.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience driving direction and alignment with large cross-functional teams and agency partners

title: Responsable Contrôle d’Inventaire et Audit Qualité - H/F
descriptionHtml:
La maitrise de l'anglais (B2) est un pré-requis pour ce poste. Veuillez nous soumettre votre CV en anglais.

Souhaitez-vous avoir un impact dynamique sur le monde ? Êtes-vous prêt(e) à créer des solutions et à résoudre les problèmes de demain dès aujourd'hui ? Alors nous avons l'opportunité qu'il vous faut ! Nous recherchons un(e) ICQA Area Manager pour rejoindre notre équipe Inventory Control and Quality Assurance (ICQA) au sein de notre centre de distribution. Nos centres de distribution (FC) sont au cœur du réseau opérationnel en pleine croissance d'Amazon : c'est là que nous gérons nos stocks à rotation rapide. Dans chaque centre de distribution, nos équipes rangent les livraisons, prélèvent les produits, les emballent et les expédient ; chacun de ces groupes a contribué à nous amener là où nous sommes aujourd'hui. Ces centres de distribution sont des environnements dynamiques et gratifiants, où le respect des politiques et des procédures est essentiel. Nous avons besoin d'un(e) leader qui garantit une livraison aussi fiable que jamais à nos clients, tout en s'assurant que nos équipes incarnent l'obsession client.





Key job responsibilities
- Diriger et superviser une équipe d'associés (incluant des Team Leads et des Data Analysts) affectés aux opérations de contrôle des stocks, d'assurance qualité et de résolution de problèmes au sein du centre de distribution
- Soutenir les programmes de sécurité et la conformité afin de garantir un environnement de travail sûr pour tous les associés. Collaborer avec les équipes Opérations et Support pour établir, influencer et respecter les politiques et procédures
- Coordonner les opérations de contrôle des stocks, d'assurance qualité et de résolution de problèmes conformément aux stratégies du réseau et en assurant la conformité et la cohérence avec SOX
- Effectuer la planification et la prévision des postes, ainsi que l'attribution et la direction du travail. Superviser des projets visant à rationaliser les processus, augmenter la qualité et optimiser la productivité
- S'assurer que les KPIs sont revus quotidiennement, hebdomadairement ou mensuellement et effectuer des analyses qualité sur tout comportement/processus pouvant impacter l'intégrité des stocks et l'expérience client
- Acquérir une expertise dans les principaux flux de processus du centre de distribution et la gestion de leurs exceptions afin de piloter l'amélioration continue des processus aux côtés de l'équipe de management opérationnel
- Participer aux entretiens et à la formation des managers et associés du centre de distribution, développer les talents et recruter la prochaine génération de managers

A day in the life
Vous travaillerez en équipes postées dans l'un de nos centres de distribution, en supervisant les opérations de contrôle des stocks, d'assurance qualité et de résolution de problèmes. Votre journée commence généralement par une réunion d'équipe, au cours de laquelle vous passerez en revue les performances de l'équipe précédente, fixerez les objectifs quotidiens et aborderez les problèmes en cours. Tout au long de votre poste, vous effectuerez des analyses d'écarts d'inventaire, superviserez la résolution des problèmes de réception et accompagnerez les membres de l'équipe dans l'amélioration de la précision. Vous analyserez régulièrement les données, en recherchant des tendances et des opportunités d'amélioration des processus, en collaborant avec d'autres partenaires des opérations FC ou des équipes centrales responsables du Catalogue, des Achats, de la Supply Chain, de l'Ingénierie des Processus, de la Prévention des Pertes et de la Gestion de Programmes. Vous devrez prendre des décisions rapides et éclairées pour assurer le bon déroulement des opérations. Tout au long de votre poste, vous serez sur le terrain, observant les processus, accompagnant les membres de l'équipe et veillant au respect des normes de sécurité dans votre zone. Vous consacrerez également du temps au développement de vos collaborateurs, en leur fournissant des retours et en identifiant les besoins en formation. En fin de poste, vous préparerez un passage de relais pour l'équipe suivante, résumant les événements clés, les problèmes en cours et les priorités. Vous partirez en sachant que vous avez contribué au maintien de la précision des stocks, à la résolution des défis liés à la réception, et finalement à la satisfaction client grâce à des opérations de distribution efficaces et précises.

About the team
La mission de l'ICQA EU est de prévenir et d'éliminer les défauts impactant les clients, dans le but de fournir un service de classe mondiale à nos clients, au coût le plus bas possible. La vision de l'ICQA est de dépasser les attentes des clients, tant acheteurs que vendeurs. Nous assurons une exécution des commandes sans défaut en opérant de la manière la plus efficace et précise possible, grâce à la création et à la mise en œuvre de standards de qualité dans nos processus FC (réception, rangement, comptage, prélèvement, emballage et expédition) jusqu'à nos vendeurs et clients. Nous dirigeons avec empathie pour créer un environnement de travail plus sûr, plus productif, plus performant et plus diversifié. Nous nous engageons à responsabiliser et à soutenir les membres de notre équipe pour qu'ils grandissent et réalisent leurs aspirations.

Basic qualifications

- Diplôme d'une université accréditée ou expérience équivalente en gestion des opérations
- Expérience pertinente dans l'analyse de données et la compréhension des jeux de données et des outils
- Maîtrise de la langue locale et de l'anglais, à l'oral comme à l'écrit
- Utilisateur avancé de la suite MS Office, en particulier Excel
- Expérience préalable en management d'équipes

Preferred qualifications

- Personne résiliente, concentrée, capable de résoudre des problèmes et autonome, avec la capacité de gérer plusieurs tâches simultanément et de prioriser dans un environnement complexe et ambigu
- Fort engagement envers le développement des collaborateurs, ainsi qu'un niveau exceptionnel de dévouement et de motivation pour la gestion d'équipe
- Capacité avérée à influencer ses pairs ou parties prenantes, à différents niveaux hiérarchiques, au sein de l'organisation Ops
- Personne concentrée, capable de résoudre des problèmes et autonome, avec la capacité de gérer plusieurs tâches simultanément et de prioriser dans un environnement complexe
- Connaissance et expérience des méthodologies et techniques Lean et Six Sigma

Amazon est un employeur engagé pour l'égalité des chances. Nous sommes convaincus qu'une main d'oeuvre diversifée est essentielle à notre réussite. Nous prenons nos décisions de recrutement en fonction de votre expérience et de vos compétences. Nous apprécions votre envie de découvrir, d'inventer, de simplifier et de construire. descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. As a Workplace Health & Safety Specialist (WHSS), you'll be at the forefront of transforming workplace safety culture at one of the world's most innovative companies. Your expertise and dedication will directly protect employees, ensuring they return home safely to their families every day. You'll facilitate new approaches to safety, combining technology with human-centered solutions to create an environment where safety and productivity thrive together. This isn't just about maintaining safety standards – it's about revolutionizing how we think about and implement workplace safety, making a lasting impact on our people and operations. As your building's designated safety champion, you'll have the unique opportunity to build relationships, influence positive change, and help write the next chapter in Amazon's commitment to becoming Earth's Safest Place to Work.

descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Data Center Engineering Operations Technician (EOT) are Amazon’s front line responders for hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operation. This equipment includes, but is not limited to, stand-by diesel generators, switchboards/switchgears, UPSs, PDUs, AHUs, pumps, motors, VFDs, and building automation systems. They provide 24/7 shift coverage which could include 12 hour shifts, rotating shifts, 3, 4, or 5 day work weeks.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US citizen and currently possess and maintain an active Top Secret security clearance with SCI eligibility.

Key job responsibilities
- Operate and maintain mechanical and electrical, mechanical, emergency generator, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center
- Troubleshoot of facility and rack-level events within internal SLAs
- Perform limited maintenance tasks to including filter changes, HVAC PMs, rack power installs, rack PDU, and rack ATS replacements
- Provide support to Data Center Operations technicians
- Perform root cause analysis of equipment failures
- Ensure all safety procedures are adhered to while performing work
- Work a 12 hour shift (rotating 3 and 4 day work weeks days or nights)
- Take daily operational readings of all mechanical and electrical equipment through routine rounds/log taking (temperatures, voltages, currents, etc.)
- Utilize internal CMMS to manage building workflows and spare part inventory

- Fully comply with all physical security procedures and policies
- Drive innovation while reducing operational costs in the facilities
- Manipulate small wires and objects
Perform the following tasks, with or without reasonable accommodation:
- Walk job sites in uneven terrain
- Work at heights and from ladders
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 40 pounds or more
- Bend or twist the body into unusual positions while working
- Push or pull heavy objects into position
- Work in noisy environments

A day in the life
After an initial training period, you will support data center infrastructure operations on a shift schedule supporting our 24/7 staffing model. You will get information from your peer technicians who are ending shift, review the maintenance schedule for any tasks due that day, and then perform routine physical checks of our critical systems. After these rounds are complete, you and your shift partner will perform preventative maintenance, troubleshoot technical issues, take repair actions, and perform facility maintenance. You will also author technical procedures, work orders, and work on advanced qualifications and projects as your career progresses at AWS!

title: Regional WHS Specialist, EF, Central Safety
descriptionHtml:
アマゾンでは、"地球上で最もお客様を大切にする企業になること”というミッションの元に日々改善と改革が行われています。
本ポジションは、アマゾンの物流プロセスにおいて重要な役割を担う外部業務委託配送拠点 External Fulfillment Center（以下EF）及び拠点間の路上輸送において、もっとも重要な「安全」をLeadし、お客様一人一人に確実に商品をお届けすることに貢献していただきます。

Central Safetyは、アマゾンの物流を担う各拠点と拠点間輸送で働くあらゆる立場の方が、安全且つ安心して業務が行える環境を提供します。本ポジションは、担当するEFと路上の自然災害・火災・オペレーションに関わるリスク検出、それらの予防措置と是正措置導入、事故防止と削減計画、について関連部署と実行します。また、標準化を進めることで、より効果的且つ効率的な方法を国内外のNetworkへ展開していきます。

title: Package Program Manager, JCFS CPEX
descriptionHtml:
Amazonでは、環境に配慮した梱包施策の企画・導入を進めています。これを担うオペレーション技術統括本部（JCFS: Japan Customer Fulfillment Solutions）のCustomer Packaging Experience（CPEX）部門では、事業の成長と、お客様の購入体験の保護、そして環境・サステナビリティへの貢献を同時に実現するため、梱包の最適化（梱包内の無駄な空間を減らし、配送物の体積と配送コストを削減する取り組み、製品の箱のまま出荷する簡易包装の拡大、CO2・プラスチック削減）を推進しており、体制強化のため新たなメンバーを募集しています。

近年、当日配送のGrocery（食品・日用品）ECサービスが急速に拡大しており、新しい業態特有の商品・配送形態に対応したパッケージ施策とプロジェクトマネジメントの強化が求められています。本ポジションは、こうしたGrocery配送サービスの拡大に伴う新規プロジェクトのマネジメント体制を強化するために新設された枠であり、拡大するビジネスを支える新たなメンバーを募集しています。

パッケージ プログラムマネージャーは、「配送・資材コストの低減（配送1件あたりコストの削減を含む）」「お客様の購入体験」「環境配慮」の3つを両立できる梱包施策を、出荷データの分析と現場での検証に基づいて企画・立案し、社内外の関係者を巻き込みながら、企画から実行まで一貫して推進します。出荷実績データに基づいて最適な梱包を導入し、使用する梱包の種類を整理・統合することで効率化を図ります。効果予測に基づくプロジェクトの企画・立案、実行計画の策定、導入後の成果説明までに責任を持ちます。

Amazon is committed to reaching net-zero carbon by 2040, and Amazon Japan is looking for a self-driven and strategic Package Program Manager to help achieve this goal within the JCFS (Japan Customer Fulfillment Solutions) team in Tokyo. In the Customer Packaging Experience (CPEX) organization, you will plan and run packaging programs that reduce shipment volume and delivery cost, expand simplified shipping, and advance sustainability — working effectively with internal teams and external partners.
With the rapid growth of same-day grocery (food and daily-goods) e-commerce services, we need to strengthen packaging programs and project management for the unique products and delivery formats these new businesses require. This position has been newly created to reinforce project management capacity as these grocery delivery services expand.

As a Package Program Manager, you will identify cost-reduction opportunities from large internal datasets (using tools such as SQL and Excel) and from on-site verification, propose the highest-priority packaging programs to leadership, and own them from planning through implementation. You will clarify business requirements for package size, type, and cost; introduce optimal packaging based on actual shipment data; consolidate the range of packaging in use; and reduce per-shipment cost — all while understanding the end-to-end flow from fulfillment centers through sortation and delivery stations to final-mile delivery.

Because packaging-reduction initiatives do not always improve operational productivity, you will balance dialogue, active listening, clear proposals, logical thinking, and change management to co-design the right operations and process improvements, building trusted relationships with diverse stakeholders. Not everything goes as planned, so you are expected to solve unexpected problems and ask for support when needed. Your results will be shared with Japan and global leadership through regular business reviews.
The CPEX mission is to delight customers by advancing packaging innovations that reduce waste, cost, and carbon emissions. The Package PM team plans and executes packaging programs that reduce shipment volume and delivery cost, expand simplified shipping (sending orders in the product’s own box without extra Amazon packaging), and advance carbon and plastic reduction. Success depends on close collaboration with internal teams (fulfillment and delivery operations, supply chain, finance, procurement, customer service, and sales) and external partners (vendors, marketplace sellers, logistics providers, and packaging suppliers).


Key job responsibilities
• エンジニアや関連部門と連携して、梱包施策に求められる最新の要件を把握し、優先度の高い施策（梱包の体積削減、簡易包装の拡大など）をリーダー層へ提言し、企画・導入を推進します。
• 出荷データの分析（SQL・Excel等）と現場検証に基づき、資材費・配送費や配送1件あたりコストの削減につながる施策を企画・立案し、実行計画を策定します。
• 社内外の関係部門・取引先（物流・配送オペレーション、調達、サプライチェーン、販売、カスタマーサービス、資材メーカーや出品者など）を巻き込み、企画から実行まで一貫して推進し、結果に責任を持ちます。成果は定量的に評価し、共有・合意を図ります。
• 環境配慮（CO2・プラスチック削減）と現場の生産性を両立させる合意形成を行い、若手メンバーの指導・育成も担います。

• Work closely with engineers and business stakeholders to clarify requirements for packaging programs and present proposals to Amazon Japan leadership.
• Build execution plans for packaging solutions using data and metrics, engage stakeholders and leadership to obtain approval, and launch projects.
• Implement projects with company-wide stakeholders across operations, transportation, supply chain, customer service, finance, and sales, and provide clear, timely reporting of key performance metrics to internal and external stakeholders.
• Report to the CPEX Manager within JCFS, while serving as a point of contact for packaging and technology teams in Japan and across global regions.

A day in the life
パッケージ プログラムマネージャーは、出荷データを分析して体積やコストの削減機会を見つけ、物流・配送拠点を訪問して現場を確認し、施策の提案・関係者との合意形成・経営層への定量的な成果報告まで、プログラムを一貫して推進します。
A Package Program Manager spends time analyzing shipment data to find opportunities to reduce volume and cost, visiting fulfillment and delivery sites to verify operations, and driving programs end to end — proposing initiatives, aligning stakeholders, and reporting measurable results to leadership.

- 3+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
- 3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements

- 3+ years of driving process improvements experience
- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization

title: 2027 Applied Scientist Internship – Masters, Amazon University Talent Acquisition
descriptionHtml:
We're building systems that turn research into real-world impact — powering sports experiences for millions of Prime Video customers, pioneering multimodal document intelligence, building autonomous AI agents that reason, plan, and act, and transforming how customers discover products they love. If this sounds interesting to you then we have a range of opportunities for you to explore.

We're looking for Masters students across multiple research domains to invent, design, and implement state-of-the-art solutions for never-before-solved problems. Your work here won't just stay in a notebook — it ships to production and reaches customers worldwide.

Check out the details below including the job responsibilities, team details, and basic qualifications before submitting your application.

You can find more information about the Amazon Science community as well as interview preparation tips via the links below;

- https://www.amazon.science/
- https://amazon.jobs/content/en/career-programs/university/science
- https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/university-roles/applied-science

Key job responsibilities
As an Applied Science Intern, you will own the design and development of end-to-end systems. You'll have the opportunity to write technical white papers, create roadmaps and drive production level projects that will support Amazon Science.

You will work closely with Amazon scientists and other science interns to develop solutions and deploy them into production. You will have the opportunity to design new algorithms, models, or other technical solutions whilst experiencing Amazon's customer focused culture.

The ideal intern should have the ability to work with diverse groups of people and cross-functional teams to solve complex business problems.


A day in the life
You'll spend your first weeks scoping your project with your mentor, then own the research and implementation end-to-end.

Your work could involve building computer vision models that power live sports experiences for Prime Video, developing multimodal GenAI solutions for AWS document intelligence, creating agentic AI systems that reason and act autonomously, or advancing recommendation models that transform how customers discover content — depending on the team you're matched with.

Many interns publish at top-tier conferences or see their work deployed to production before the internship ends. Interns may also be considered for a return offer at the end of their internship, subject to performance evaluation and headcount availability.

Further benefits of an Amazon Science internship include;

- All of our internships offer a competitive salary
- Interns are paired with an experienced manager and mentor(s)
- Interns get invited to different intern program or office events
- Interns can build their professional and personal network with other Amazon Scientists


About the team
We're hiring interns for multiple teams in Israel, including but not limited to;

• Prime Video Sports — Build innovative sports experiences for Prime Video, spanning computer vision, 3D simulation, and personalized content recommendations.
• Personalization — Leverage LLMs, NLP, and recommender systems to match customers with products that align with their passions and shopping preferences.
• Agentic AI — Build next-generation agentic AI systems that automate real-world knowledge work, spanning retrieval-augmented generation, multi-agent workflows, long-term memory and personalization, knowledge-graph construction, and agent evaluation.
• DS3 Textract — Develop multimodal generative AI algorithms that pioneer state-of-the-art document understanding solutions impacting millions of customers.

You'll submit a single application and we'll match you with science teams best aligned with your research interests.

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, and your application stays active until we find a team match or confirm there are no matches available.

Start dates are available throughout the year. Some teams offer full-time internships (3–6 months) while others offer part-time positions (50–60%, 8–12 months) — your recruiter will confirm the format during team matching.

We offer science internships in multiple locations across the EMEA region and you can indicate your interest in all these locations by applying here (Austria, Estonia, France, Germany, Ireland, Israel, Italy, Jordan, Luxembourg, Netherlands, Poland, Romania, South Africa, Spain, Sweden, UAE, and UK).

Please note we do not offer remote internships.

Basic qualifications

- Are enrolled in a Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Machine Learning, Operations Research, Statistics, or related fields
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English

Preferred qualifications

- Have publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
- Experience in solving business problems through machine learning, data mining and statistical algorithms
- Experience in designing experiments and statistical analysis of results
- Experience implementing algorithms using both toolkits and self-developed code

title: Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
Job summary
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. You will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. To achieve this, managers are expected to provide their team with the tools needed for success while driving improvements in productivity and efficiency through data-driven decisions and analytical problem-solving. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

Support, mentor, and motivate your salaried and hourly workforce

Collaborate with all support teams including Safety, Engineering, Loss Prevention, Quality Assurance, Human Resources to develop plans to meet business objectives
Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud
Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)
Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Operations Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.

-3+ years of employee and performance management experience
-Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
-Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
