Nossos Técnicos de RME aumentam a disponibilidade e qualidade de nossos equipamentos e também trabalham para melhorar o ambiente operacional.

Key job responsibilities
- Tarefas de manutenção proativa e preventiva em uma ampla gama de equipamentos do site.
- Realizar reparos reativos e diagnóstico de falhas em um centro de distribuição em operação.
- Utilizar as ferramentas mais recentes para maximizar a eficácia dos equipamentos.
- Manter todas as políticas e práticas de saúde e segurança.
- Apoiar o desenvolvimento e a progressão de aprendizes no local.
- Trabalhar em projetos de melhoria contínua e implementar as melhores práticas em diversos sites do Brasil.


A day in the life
Nossos Técnicos de RME estão baseados no site, para que possam responder rapidamente a quaisquer problemas com maquinários. Você realizará uma série de manutenções preventivas planejadas nos equipamentos de nossos sites para garantir que estejam funcionando com segurança. Como Técnico de RME, você também responderá prontamente a avarias, investigando, encontrando e implementando soluções o mais rápido possível. Você também fará sugestões para melhorias de longo prazo.

Trabalhando ao lado de colegas mais experientes, você realizará tarefas de manutenção diárias e fará a ligação com contratados se precisar de expertise externa. Você poderá trabalhar em uma variedade de turnos (dia ou noite) para garantir que nossos sites sejam apoiados 24 horas por dia - permitindo que a Amazon entregue na velocidade pela qual somos conhecidos.

About the team
Nossa equipe de Engenharia de Manutenção e Confiabilidade ou RME mantém nossos equipamentos funcionando em seu melhor desempenho. Somos uma equipe com mentalidade técnica, composta por excelentes jogadores de equipe e guiada por líderes experientes. Trabalhamos juntos para manter, solucionar problemas e reparar equipamentos em nossa rede global de centros de distribuição. Algumas de nossas pessoas são líderes, que supervisionam a equipe enquanto trabalham com tecnologia empolgante - algumas das quais existem apenas na Amazon.

Desde a instalação de sistemas automatizados de embalagem até a supervisão da manutenção geral de um site e o reparo de equipamentos-chave de distribuição, nossa equipe lida com a maioria dos aspectos técnicos da Amazon. Isso inclui manter os edifícios em conformidade legal, garantindo que todos estejam seguros e que nossos sites estejam operando com eficiência máxima. Há muitas oportunidades de progressão, tanto dentro da equipe de RME quanto mais amplamente na Amazon.

Trabalhamos para reduzir o tempo de inatividade nos sites cruciais de operações da Amazon, para que os clientes recebam seus pedidos no prazo. Se identificamos uma maneira melhor de fazer algo, temos as habilidades e a oportunidade de desenvolver e introduzir processos completamente novos ou tecnologias de ponta.

Basic qualifications

- Experiência em sistemas de manutenção preventiva programada
- Experiência em tarefas de manutenção mecânica e/ou elétrica
- Experiência em busca de falhas de sistemas de correias transportadoras (MHE, do inglês: Material Handling Equipment) e Automação
- Pensamento estratégico para buscar soluções de problemas
- Trabalhar em horário/turno/área de trabalho flexível, incluindo fins de semana, noites e/ou feriados
- Ensino médio completo ou diploma equivalente
- Experiência com produtos e aplicativos do Microsoft Office

Preferred qualifications

- Experiência com padrões de segurança de equipamentos de movimentação de materiais (MHE) de acordo com o fabricante original do equipamento (OEM) e normas de segurança
- Fluencia em inglês.
- Experiência com sistemas e controles de transportadores automatizados
- Experiência na realização de procedimentos de manutenção preditiva e preventiva

title: Technik Utrzymania Ruchu
descriptionHtml:
Sekcja utrzymania ruchu i infrastruktury w firmie Amazon stanowi fundament naszych operacji – to właśnie technicy wchodzący w jej skład dbają o to, by kluczowe urządzenia działały sprawnie i bez przerw. Rola technika utrzymania ruchu i infrastruktury obejmuje prowadzenie konserwacji szerokiej gamy sprzętu i stanowisk pracy przy zachowaniu najlepszych praktyk BHP, dbając o bezpieczeństwo współpracowników i zapobiegając przestojom maszyn. Pracuje nad podnoszeniem dostępności i jakości naszego sprzętu oraz nad poprawą środowiska operacyjnego



Key job responsibilities
• Proaktywne i zapobiegawcze prace konserwacyjne dla szerokiej gamy urządzeń w centrach logistycznych
• Przeprowadzanie nieplanowanych napraw i diagnostyka usterek w centrum logistycznym
• Korzystanie z najnowszych narzędzi w celu osiągnięcia maksymalnej wydajności
• Przestrzeganie wszystkich zasad i praktyk w zakresie BHP
• Wspieranie rozwoju i doskonalenia zawodowego praktykantów
• Prowadzenie projektów ciągłego doskonalenia i wdrażanie najlepszych praktyk w centrach na terenie UE


A day in the life
Nasi technicy utrzymania ruchu i infrastruktury pracują w naszych centrach logistycznych, dzięki czemu mogą szybko reagować na wszelkie problemy związane z urządzeniami oraz przeprowadzają szereg zaplanowanych konserwacji zapobiegawczych, by zapewnić ich bezpieczne działanie. Do ich obowiązków należy również natychmiastowe reagowanie na awarie, diagnozowanie ich źródła, oraz opracowywanie i jak najszybsze wdrażanie rozwiązań. Przedstawiają również swoje sugestie dotyczące wprowadzania długoterminowych ulepszeń.
Współpracując z bardziej doświadczonymi pracownikami, osoba na tym stanowisku będzie przeprowadzać bieżące zadania konserwacyjne, takie jak malowanie lub hydraulika, oraz komunikować się z kontrahentami, by w razie potrzeby zasięgać u nich fachowej wiedzy. Stanowisko to obejmuje pracę na różnych zmianach, dzięki czemu nasze centra logistyczne są pod opieką techników utrzymania ruchu i infrastruktury przez całą dobę – pozwalając firmie Amazon na dostarczanie klientom produktów z prędkością, z jakiej słyniemy.

About the team
Dział utrzymania ruchu i infrastruktury pracuje nad zapewnieniem niezawodności urządzeń firmy Amazon. W skład działu wchodzą wyspecjalizowani technicznie, utalentowani inżynierowie pod przewodnictwem doświadczonej kadry kierowniczej. Działają oni wspólnie przy konserwacji, diagnostyce i naprawach urządzeń w globalnej sieci centrów logistycznych. Niektórzy członkowie tego zespołu to liderzy, którzy nadzorują pracę zespołu nad niezwykle fascynującą technologią – której elementy istnieją tylko w Amazon.
Od instalacji zautomatyzowanych systemów pakowania, przez nadzór nad ogólną konserwacją wyposażenia technicznego w centrach logistycznych, po naprawę kluczowego sprzętu dystrybucyjnego – zespół ten zajmuje się większością aspektów technicznej strony działalności firmy Amazon. Do jego obowiązków należy również utrzymanie obiektów budowlanych w należytym stanie zgodnym z przepisami prawnymi, dzięki czemu wszyscy pracownicy są bezpieczni, a nasze centra działają z zachowaniem maksymalnej wydajności. Istnieje wiele możliwości rozwoju zarówno w samym dziale utrzymania ruchu i infrastruktury (RME), jak i we wszystkich innych obszarach firmy Amazon.
Wszystkie działania Działu utrzymania ruchu i infrastruktury skupiają się na ograniczeniu przestojów w kluczowych miejscach działalności firmy Amazon, dzięki czemu klienci otrzymują swoje zamówienia na czas. Pracownicy działu często pracują we wczesnych lub późnych porach, w tym na zmianach nocnych, aby przeprowadzając konserwację zminimalizować zakłócenia. Jeśli zauważą, że coś można zrobić lepiej, wykorzystują swoje kompetencje oraz możliwości, by opracować i wprowadzić całkowicie nowe procesy lub najnowocześniejsze technologie, takie jak Amazon Robotics czy Complex Item Sorter.

Basic qualifications

- Państwowe uprawnienia zawodowe w dyscyplinie inżynierskiej lub inne praktyczne kwalifikacje inżynierskie
- Wcześniejsze doświadczenie jako wykwalifikowany inżynier
- Wcześniejsze doświadczenie w zakresie konserwacji instalacji mechanicznych i/lub elektrycznych
- Biegła znajomość języka polskiego w mowie i piśmie

Preferred qualifications

- Doświadczenie w monitorowaniu warunkowym
- Doświadczenie w pracy z urządzeniami do drukowania i aplikowania etykiet
- Doświadczenie w wykrywaniu usterek i konserwacji systemów przenośnikowych i automatyzacji

title: Controls Engineer, Data Center, Colocation Regional Engineering - AMER
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Nov 9, 2026

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

As a Controls Colo Engineer, you will work with internal business teams and with colocation vendors to identify, document, and resolve any operational/design deficiencies which could impact a site’s capability or availability. You will provide full life-cycle support to Data Centers from design inception through site improvement and maintenance. You will be the ‘go to’ engineering resource when technical advice is needed, and will use your subject matter expertise and engage with diverse teams to:

• Work in close relationship with the control team of DCE Colocation Design and Standards (CoDeS) to develop and implement new and existing standards.
• Perform design and equipment submittal review for Controls for new Colo Data Centers in the region in order to ensure consistent standards across Colocation Data Centers and AWS owned sites.
• Review and Identify risks within the scope of Building Management System (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS) for in-flight AWS Colo Data Centers.
• Review and identify risks within automation controls drawings and wiring diagrams, the controls logic programming and the graphical user interface.
• Review and accept proposed changes to the site-specific control infrastructure against AWS Data Center standards, and document accepted deviations when appropriate.
• Review Colo and Hybrid controls sequence of operation and provide feedback to design.
• Support the design for existing Colo Data Center control system upgrades and design-solutions, which add capacity, improve availability, and increase efficiency.
• Troubleshoot, conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and create Corrective Action (CA) documentation for site/equipment failures related to control equipment.
• Conduct site audits of Colo Data Centers, including producing reports outlining risks with recommended mitigations and remediation.
• Support construction, commissioning, and turnover for Controls for any new construction projects (could be remote with local Colo Engineer presence).
• Lead internal team training and knowledge sharing sessions on Colo controls.
• Review and improve controls related processes, including quick reference guides for the team.

Key job responsibilities
Amazon's vision is to be the world's most customer-centric company, and this role is key to that vision. As a Controls Engineer, you will be leading projects to fit out the data centers we support to meet ever-evolving customer needs as we continue expanding our fleet to hyper-scale.

As an ideal candidate, you:
• Possess Strong Engineering judgment and are able to provide recommendations despite uncertainty
• Detail- and data oriented
• Have experience managing engineering projects and consultants.
• Build trust and relationships with different stakeholders (e.g., Business Development, Operations, Commissioning)
• Be inclined to get into the field to see things up close.



About the team
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic qualifications

- 4+ years of industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation or oil and gas facilities experience
- 5+ years of designing Data Center, Mission Critical, Hospital, Schools, Commercial, or Residential Tower facilities experience
- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel
- Experience in industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation or oil and gas facilities
- Experience researching new designs, technologies, and construction methods of data center equipment and facilities
- Experience in commissioning

Preferred qualifications

- Professional Engineer License
- Experience with building codes and regulations for your region
- Experience carrying design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
- Experience reading, interpreting, and creating construction drawings, specifications, and submittal documents
- Experience in data center design, construction, operations, or facility maintenance
- Experience with AutoCAD, Revit, Bluebeam, and MS Office Suite
- Experience evaluating the constructability of new technologies and determining construction methods for data center equipment and facilities
- Experience performing and presenting business case analyses

title: Supply Chain Analyst, GPCS - AMER
descriptionHtml:
The Supply Chain Analyst is responsible for building and maintaining the reporting infrastructure that enables data-driven decision making across GPCS. This includes owning KPI dashboards, supplier and inventory visibility tools, launch tracking, pricing analysis, and deep-dive reporting that surfaces defects and operational gaps at the site and supplier level.

The Supply Chain Analyst is the owner of GPCS operational reporting accuracy — monitoring the quality and consistency of data across reporting surfaces, and partnering with system owners (including Coupa, Delphi, and other source systems) to drive resolution when data is incorrect or inconsistent.
This role requires proficiency in dashboard development (e.g., QuickSight, Asana, or equivalent BI tools), SQL or equivalent query languages, and the ability to translate complex operational data into clear, actionable reports for stakeholder groups that include finance, operations, ACES, and internal GPO teams.

Successful candidates are natural self-starters who thrive in ambiguous, fast-changing environments. This role requires someone who is highly adaptable — capable of quickly adjusting strategies and implementation plans in response to dynamic business needs and varying site conditions. The ideal candidate excels at managing multiple stakeholder relationships, driving consistent standards across diverse partners, and balancing technical requirements with operational constraints.

Key job responsibilities
Dashboard and Reporting Infrastructure
Build, maintain, and report on KPI dashboards that serve as the single source of truth for GPCS operational performance
Develop and manage supplier ETA and inventory level dashboards at the site and vendor level
Maintain the SEV2 Asana dashboard and produce miss reports that surface root causes and prevention recommendations to reduce SEV2 reoccurrence, distributed to stakeholder groups including operations and internal GPO teams

Ad Hoc and On-Demand Reporting
Produce cross-team project status reporting on a defined cadence
Conduct pricing change reporting and build ad hoc reports or dashboards as requested by stakeholders to address emerging business questions, one-time analytical needs, or leadership requests outside the standard reporting cadence
Support ad hoc data collection, reporting and dashboard creation across supply and inventory topics — such as excess inventory exposure, forecast versus orders performance, supplier stock shortage risks, cycle count values versus usage, and invoice hold trends.

Analysis and Deep Dives
Perform deep-dive analyses on recurring operational issues and escalations, including ordering logic failures, system trigger anomalies, and stakeholder-submitted questions

Data Accuracy and Governance
Conduct regular audits of dashboard data against source-of-truth systems; document discrepancies, corrective actions, and recurring failure patterns — and escalate pipeline-level issues to the AI/Automation Specialist for technical resolution
Establish and maintain data definitions, metric formulas, and refresh cadences that are consistent across all GPCS dashboards and business reviews

About the team
Global Procurement Central Services (GPCS) is a centralized corporate team that provides non-inventory procurement support across Amazon's operational network. GPCS manages the end-to-end supply chain of forecasting, purchasing, delivery, escalation management, and financial reconciliation. descriptionHtml:

A Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) embeds directly inside a strategic enterprise customer to design, build, deploy, and run AI-powered production systems alongside the customer's engineering team. FDEs write production-grade software and own outcomes end-to-end, from prototype through enterprise-scale deployment, combining the technical rigor of an AWS SDE with the urgency and ownership required to deliver measurable customer business outcomes. They create reusable architectures, patterns, and engineering mechanisms that scale the entire FDE practice. Drive clarity where neither the business problem nor the technology approach is fully defined. Build production systems that handle enterprise-scale traffic and reliability requirements.

A Senior FDE spends the day leading technical delivery inside the customer's environment: setting the architecture direction across workstreams, building alongside customer engineers on the hardest production AI problems, reviewing designs and code, and mentoring FDEs into independent contributors.

descriptionHtml:

How do you get items to customers quickly, cost-effectively, and most importantly safely, in less than an hour? And how do you do it in a way that can scale? If you are seeking an iterative environment where you can drive innovation, apply state-of-the-art technologies to solve real world delivery challenges, and provide benefits to customers, Prime Air is the place for you.

As a Senior Technical Program Manager (TPM) in Prime Air Europe, you'll own the end-to-end lifecycle of complex, cross-functional programs that underpin Prime Air's mission to deliver safely and at scale. This role sits at the intersection of technical delivery and strategic program leadership, serving as the critical bridge between engineering teams and business stakeholders while driving operational excellence across Prime Air's European operations. Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities. As a Senior TPM in Prime Air's European Operations, you will own the full lifecycle of technical programs spanning drone delivery systems, ground infrastructure systems and the customer experience built on top of them, ensuring on-time, on-budget delivery at the highest safety and quality standards. You will work backward from customer opportunity: identify where the European customer experience limits adoption or leaves opportunity unrealised, quantify what it is worth, write the requirements, and define success in measurable customer terms before any build starts. You will insist on solutions that are durable and reusable, so that what one country needs is built once in a way the next country inherits, rather than accumulating per-country workarounds. You will lead technical risk assessment frameworks, proactively identifying risks, developing mitigation strategies, and driving resolution across cross-functional engineering teams to keep programs on track. You will drive cross-functional integration of European and US technical infrastructure, coordinating with engineering teams on system architecture decisions and technical dependencies, and evaluating the system-level designs that come back. A critical part of your role involves establishing and maintaining standardized technical processes, tooling, and operational frameworks that drive efficiency and scalability across European programs. You will develop and maintain executive-level technical dashboards (e.g., QuickSight), creating standardized metrics and review processes that enable data-driven decision making across global operations, and you will own the business cadence those reviews run on. In partnership with senior technical and business leadership across EU and US, you will drive alignment on priorities and program execution, translating complex technical information into clear, actionable insights. You will champion continuous improvement and innovation initiatives while ensuring teams maintain the highest safety and security standards. Working with the Infrastructure Expansion and Deployment, Regulatory and Operations teams, you will ensure that the technical infrastructure, the systems and the customer experience are ready for each new site launch in the UK and the EU, and that operations can run what you deliver without you.

title: Program Manager, Integrated Planning, GEMS, NA Startup
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is seeking a Program Manager to join the Startup Integrated Planning team within the Global Engineering, Materials, & Sustainability (GEMS) organization. This team owns the integrated planning function for North America's infrastructure project portfolio, connecting cross-functional workstreams into unified, reliable schedules that guide execution across large-scale new build and expansion/retrofit projects.

This Program Manager will contribute to the strategic evolution of the integrated planning program, helping mature planning as a discipline. The role oversees a team of contracted project planners, setting the bar for quality and ensuring consistent delivery, while balancing program-level strategy, cross-functional influence, and scaling mechanisms.

This is a rapidly scaling environment where processes exist but are still maturing. Success requires strategic thinking, comfort navigating ambiguity, and the judgment to refine and extend existing frameworks. A strong background in integrated scheduling is critical for providing effective program management at this scale.

This role requires up to 50% travel in the US and Canada and availability to work from a corporate office when not traveling. Candidates should either live near or be willing to relocate within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Relocation assistance may be provided.


Key job responsibilities
Program Strategy & Contracted Planner Oversight
• Shape and advance the workforce and vendor strategy for contracted planners, including capacity modeling, skill-mix optimization, and procurement negotiations that scale with portfolio growth.
• Oversee contracted project planners: set expectations, provide training on planning standards, review deliverable quality, and support escalations.
• Assign and rebalance planners across projects based on priority, complexity, and workload.
• Track project budgets, manage invoicing, and provide funding inputs for planning resources.

Planning Quality, Standards, & Governance
• Refine and enforce quality standards for integrated project schedules, ensuring all plans connect discipline timelines, dependencies, and handovers into a single source of truth.
• Contribute to the planning maturity model and roadmap, setting progressive quality targets that evolve as the program scales.
• Design and implement governance mechanisms that validate schedule quality at scale, removing the need for manual review.
• Ensure weekly planning status reports are accurate, complete, and distributed on time to stakeholders.
• Track planning health via KPI dashboards measuring schedule integrity, milestone adherence, plan variance, and delivery date accuracy.

Standardization & Continuous Improvement
• Develop, maintain, and enforce Standard Operating Procedures for all planning activities.
• Develop and improve planning tools, templates, and AI-driven automations to boost planner productivity and eliminate manual workflows.
• Identify and lead initiatives that advance planning maturity, including automation, tooling, and capability building.
• Capture lessons learned from completed projects and convert them into repeatable, scalable best practices.

Risk Management & Reporting
• Identify and mitigate program-level planning risks; own escalation paths and drive issues to resolution.
• Ensure planners identify cross-functional dependencies and surface risks early, before they become execution problems.
• Develop and refine risk and reporting frameworks that give leadership the signal needed to make portfolio-level decisions
• Provide clear, data-driven status reporting to senior leadership on portfolio-wide planning performance.

Program-Level Cross-Functional Partnership
• Build and maintain program-level relationships with key partner functions (design, operations, construction, launch, IT, engineering) to drive planning adoption and standardization.
• Serve as the planning liaison with partner functions, championing integrated scheduling practices and ensuring planning inputs are prioritized.
• Drive continuous improvement of integrated planning by gathering feedback from partner functions and refining how planning intersects with their workflows.
• Represent the Integrated Planning program in global and cross-functional forums, aligning planning standards and resolving systemic gaps across disciplines.

- 3+ years of program or project management experience
- 3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
- Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
- 3+ years of integrated scheduling experience including use of MS Project, Primavera P6, or equivalent tool
- Experience applying AI tools and automation to scale program operations and drive measurable efficiency improvements.
- Experience handling ambiguous or undefined challenges through strong problem solving abilities

Preferred qualifications

- Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

title: Software Development Engineer, SoC HAL
descriptionHtml:
Description

Annapurna Labs builds the custom silicon at the heart of AWS machine learning servers, and we are hiring a software engineer to help build the Hardware Abstraction Layer (HAL) that brings these chips to life. If you love working where hardware meets software, writing the code that boots, configures, and debugs some of the largest custom silicon in the world, this is your team.

As a Software Engineer on the SoC HAL team, you will write and test C++ for the driver stack across the hardware blocks that make up our chips, learn how the silicon works from the engineers who design it, and grow your skills on a small, fast-moving team inside a large organization. No machine learning background is required (you will pick up ML concepts from colleagues if you want to). This role is based in Cupertino, CA.

Key job responsibilities
Implement, test, and maintain HAL/driver features for individual hardware blocks (for example PCIe, DDR / HBM memory, DMA, system fabric, interrupt controllers, and boot / firmware), working from designs and interfaces set by more senior engineers.

Write clean, well-tested C++ and contribute to the team's test, code-review, and continuous-deployment practices.

Debug failures that span software and silicon, with support from the team, and build an understanding of how the HAL interacts with the hardware underneath it.

Learn the hardware/software interface by partnering with RTL and design verification engineers on well-scoped questions.

Provide feature additions and bug fixes on current and prior chips.

A day in the life
A typical day moves between writing and reviewing C++ for the HAL, pairing with a teammate on a tricky bug, and learning how a hardware block works from its spec or from the engineer who designed it. You might add a feature to a driver, write tests for it, and work through code-review feedback, then dig into a failure that spans software and silicon. Your teammates are the HAL engineers you build alongside; the hardware design, verification, and firmware teams are close partners you will learn from; and your customers are the internal software teams that rely on the HAL to boot, configure, and debug the chip.

About the team
Annapurna Labs designs and deploys some of the largest custom silicon in the world, including the Trainium and Inferentia machine learning accelerators. Our SoC HAL team builds the low-level software that boots, configures, and manages these chips, sitting between the hardware and the system software that runs the server. We are a small team that works closely with hardware, holds a high engineering bar, and invests in helping engineers grow. Based in Cupertino, CA, we value mentorship, clear written design, and software that outlasts any single chip.

Basic qualifications

- Knowledge of programming languages such as C/C++, Python, Java or Perl
- Experience (non-internship) in professional software development, or currently enrolled in or recently completed a Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science or a related field
- Experience with data structures, algorithms, and software design fundamentals

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related fields at time of application
- Coursework, internship, or project experience in computer architecture or operating systems
- Experience with C or C++ and object-oriented design
- Exposure to low-level, embedded, or hardware-adjacent programming
- Familiarity with testing, debugging, source control, and build processes in a team setting

title: Technischer Teamleiter:in Automatisierungs- und Instandhaltungstechnik
descriptionHtml:
Unser Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsteam (Reliability Maintenance Engineering Team oder RME-Team) ist der Kern von Amazons Engagement für Innovation. Amazon entwickelt sich weiter und dieses Team sorgt dafür, dass dies auch die von uns verwendeten Technologien und Tools tun. Als Senior RME Technician/Teamleiter hilfst Du uns, der Entwicklung einen Schritt voraus zu bleiben. Du setzt die neuesten Technologien ein und identifizierst neue, effiziente Arbeitsmethoden. In dieser Rolle achtest Du genau auf unsere Prozesse und trägst dazu bei, dass wir unsere höchsten Sicherheitsstandards befolgen und weiter erhöhen.

Key job responsibilities
- Best Practice und Unterstützen im Bedienen von Geräten und Anlagen mit den höchsten Sicherheitsstandards
- Verfolgen der Geräteleistung durch visuelle Prüfungen, zustandsorientierte Überwachung und vorbeugende Wartungsmaßnahmen und Einplanen zusätzlicher Wartung je nach Bedarf
- Verantwortung für das technische Team während seiner Schicht und dessen Unterstützung und Weiterentwicklung
- Lösung von Problemen an Anlagen, um Betriebsausfallzeiten zu reduzieren und die schnellstmögliche Abfertigung von Paketen zu ermöglichen
- Unterstützung bei der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung von Systemen und Standardisierung von Prozessen im ganzen EU-Netzwerk
- Schulung der Techniker in den Grundlagen der Steuerungstechnik-Fehlersuche, um das Wissensniveau im Vor-Ort-Team zu heben.

A day in the life


Du betreust ein Instandhaltungsteam innerhalb einer Schicht und sorgst dafür, dass alle Mitarbeitenden die erforderlichen Werkzeuge zur Verfügung haben und diese einwandfrei funktionieren. Das beinhaltet die Überwachung von Prozessen, damit Vorschriften und Richtlinien befolgt werden, ebenso wie die Gewährleistung der Durchführung vorbeugender Wartungsmaßnahmen, um die Betriebszeit unserer Anlagen zu maximieren.
Durch Deine Beobachtungen während der Schichtarbeit machst Du Verbesserungsvorschläge, um unsere Systeme noch effizienter und produktiver zu gestalten, und setzt diese Verbesserungen EU-weit um. Außerdem nutzt Du Tools wie SCADA zur Überwachung von Prozessen, um deren Leistungsfähigkeit zu gewährleisten, und unterstützt administrative Aufgaben in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Deinen Führungskräften.
Du arbeitest vor Ort in einem unserer Logistikzentren. Du arbeitest in Schichtmodellen, die Nächte und Wochenenden umfassen können. Mit den Kenntnissen und Erfahrungen, die Du sammelst, wirst Du Dich zu weiteren Führungspositionen weiterentwickeln. Der Schwerpunkt liegt auf Fehlersuche, Troubleshooting und der Verbesserung von Steuerungslösungen für automatisierte Materialflusstechnik wie Förderbänder, Sortieranlagen, Scanner, Kameras, Print-and-Apply-Systeme, Waagen, Mensch-Maschine-Schnittstellen (HMI) und Schaltschränke. Darüber hinaus schult der Automation Engineer die Servicetechniker in der Geräte-Fehlersuche und präventiven Wartung.

About the team
Unser Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsteam (Reliability Maintenance Engineering Team oder RME-Team) sorgt dafür, dass unsere Geräte und Ausstattung jederzeit optimal funktionieren. Wir sind ein Team von Techniker:innen und Ingenieur:innen, das aus hervorragenden Teamplayern besteht und von erfahrenen Führungskräften geleitet wird. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam daran, die Geräte in unserem gesamten globalen Netzwerk von Fulfillment-Centern zu warten, zu reparieren und ihre Fehler zu beheben. Einige unserer Mitarbeiter:innen sind Führungskräfte, die das Team bei der Arbeit an spannender, innovativer Technologie beaufsichtigen – die es teilweise nur bei Amazon gibt.
Von der Installation automatisierter Verpackungssysteme bis hin zur Beaufsichtigung der allgemeinen Wartungsarbeiten eines Standorts sowie der Reparatur von für den Vertrieb wesentlichen Geräten wickelt unser Team einen Großteil der technischen Aufgaben bei Amazon ab. Unter anderem sorgt es auch dafür, dass Gebäude weiterhin den rechtlichen Auflagen entsprechen, damit alle sicher bleiben und unsere Standorte mit maximaler Effizienz betrieben werden. Es gibt zahlreiche Aufstiegschancen im RME-Team selbst ebenso wie im gesamten Amazon-Unternehmen.
Alle unsere Aktivitäten sind darauf ausgerichtet, die Ausfallzeiten an Amazons wichtigsten Betriebsstandorten zu reduzieren, damit Kund:innen ihre Bestellungen rechtzeitig erhalten. Oft arbeiten wir früh morgens, spät abends oder in der Nachtschicht, um Wartungsarbeiten mit den geringstmöglichen Störungen vorzunehmen. Falls wir eine bessere Möglichkeit finden, eine bestimmte Aufgabe zu erledigen, verfügen wir über die Fertigkeiten und Gelegenheiten, vollständig neue Prozesse oder bahnbrechende Technologie wie Amazon Robotics oder unseren Complex Item Sorter einzuführen.

Basic qualifications

- Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung, idealerweise im Bereich Mechatronik, Elektrotechnik, Elektronik oder einem verwandten technischen Fachgebiet
- Bereitschaft, in flexiblen Arbeitszeiten/Schichten/Arbeitsbereichen zu arbeiten, einschließlich Wochenenden, Nachtschichten und/oder Feiertagen
- Erfahrung mit automatisierten Fördersystemen und Steuerungen, elektrischen und elektronischen Grundlagen, Verfahren der vorbeugenden Instandhaltung, dem Lesen von technischen Zeichnungen und Schaltplänen, Industrieelektrik, industriellen Steuerungen, Industrieelektronik, Programmen für speicherprogrammierbare Steuerungen (SPS), nationalen elektrotechnischen Vorschriften sowie Auftragsmanagement (Work Order Management)

Preferred qualifications

- Erfahrung in der Leitung von Technik-/Engineering-Teams als Mentor:in oder technische:r Teamleiter:in (Tech Lead)
- Erfahrung in der Instandhaltung von Robotik/Robotersystemen
- Erfahrung im Umgang mit Sicherheitsstandards für Materialflusstechnik (MHE) gemäß den Anforderungen der Erstausrüster (OEM)
- Erfahrung mit SPS-gesteuerter Automatisierung (speicherprogrammierbare Steuerungen) und Fehlerdiagnose in einem kontinuierlichen Prozess- oder Produktionsumfeld, oder Erfahrung mit Ladder Logic (Kontaktplan) und strukturierter Programmierung von SPS der Hersteller Siemens, Allen-Bradley oder Codesys
- Fehlersuche und Diagnose an speicherprogrammierbaren Steuerungen (SPS), Vertrautheit mit nationalen elektrotechnischen Vorschriften (NEC) sowie der effektive Umgang mit Auftragsmanagementsystemen (Work Order Management)
- Erfahrung mit CMMS (computergestützte Instandhaltungsmanagementsysteme) zur Nachverfolgung und Dokumentation reaktiver Fehlerbehebungsaufgaben und zur Unterstützung der proaktiven Instandhaltungsplanung

title: Recruitment Consultant Apprentice (18-month fixed term contract)
descriptionHtml:
The Recruitment Consultant apprenticeship will appeal to individuals who possess an entrepreneurial outlook and a genuine passion for candidate talent search and engagement. In this role, every day brings new challenges and discoveries, and you'll collaborate with teams focused on talent acquisition, process improvement, and strategy development. It's a fast-paced, dynamic environment where you'll help deliver an efficient, high-quality service to both internal and external customers.

As a Recruitment Consultant apprentice, you'll learn the full craft of recruitment - how to source, screen, and interview candidates effectively, build strong relationships with both job seekers and hiring managers, and read the job market to make successful placements. You'll also develop skills that many don't associate with recruitment: sales and negotiation to match candidates to the right opportunities, the legal and ethical foundations that keep hiring fair and compliant, and the data and recruitment-software skills that keep the whole process running smoothly.

A day in the life can involve:
- Identifying and contacting potential job candidates
- Scheduling and conducting candidate interviews and assessments
- Liaising with hiring managers to understand their hiring needs
- Matching candidates to suitable job openings
- Guiding and advising candidates throughout the recruitment process
- Maintaining accurate candidate records and managing databases
- Keeping up to date with industry trends and job-market developments
- Maintaining and analysing hiring data points to spot trends

We're looking for someone with a natural curiosity about recruitment who's eager to understand the industry and play a pivotal role in talent acquisition. You'll bring meticulous attention to detail and take pride in delivering high-quality, accurate work. Because the role moves quickly, you'll need to adapt fast, prioritise effectively, and stay agile when demands shift. And you'll enjoy working as part of a team, bringing a service-oriented mindset and a commitment to giving every customer an exceptional experience.

Here at Amazon, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Within this apprenticeship, you'll learn by doing, putting newfound knowledge into practice every day. Our first-class coaching, tailored development opportunities, and rewarding work will empower you to reach new heights. If you're a curious learner eager to grow, this is your chance to unlock your full potential and build the future you envision.

You'll gain a wide range of valuable experiences and skills while working towards the Level 3 Recruitment Consultant apprenticeship standard. You'll combine working in your assigned team with your studies: as a working student, your focus during your 20% off-the-job time is to develop the skills, knowledge and behaviours that lead to successful graduation. You'll be set objectives and goals by your training provider and manager to support your studies.

You'll build your skills over an 18-month period, starting in September, developing both personally and professionally. Your apprenticeship combines classroom and virtual training to cover the knowledge, on-the-job training at your Amazon base location, online learning, and mentoring from our experienced team members.

We value different perspectives and experiences, and we're dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. Our employee-led affinity groups — including communities for women in tech, LGBTQ+ employees, and underrepresented minorities — foster a culture of inclusion that empowers us to be proud of our differences. These groups provide community, mentorship, and a platform for your voice to be heard. We're committed to building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities we serve.

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Your career isn't a straight path - it's a journey you build as you go. A universe of opportunity awaits, and your next adventure starts here.

Basic qualifications

- To qualify for this programme, you must:
- Be 18 years or over before the start date (September 2027)
- Have the right to live and work in England at the point of enrolment (June 2027). If you are on a visa, this must enable you to legally work and reside in England for the entire duration of the programme from enrolment.
- Have lived in the UK or in the European Economic Area (EEA) for the last 3 years prior to the start date
- Not be registered to study on a UK government funded course ending August 2027 or later
- Be prepared to travel for external/mandatory training as part of the apprenticeship
- Have at least 5 GCSEs C grade (grade 4) or above including Maths and English
- Please note, if you have received educational qualifications outside of the UK then we will require a Statement of Comparability to confirm your eligibility for the scheme. Please ensure you obtain one during the application process, through UK ENIC: https://www.enic.org.uk/
- Previous qualifications will be reviewed for funding eligibility and offers are subject to funding approval
- PLEASE NOTE: This position is a 18 month fixed-term contract. You must NOT already have a qualification in a similar subject at the same or higher level than this apprenticeship.
- This Apprenticeship assumes the candidate has some or little knowledge/experience of the occupation

Preferred qualifications

- A genuine interest in recruitment and connecting people with opportunities
- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills - comfortable talking to a wide range of people
- A keen eye for detail and pride in accurate, high-quality work
- Well organised, able to juggle multiple priorities and stay calm when things move quickly
- A natural curiosity about the job market and how talent is sourced and matched
- A collaborative, service-oriented mindset and a genuine enjoyment of working as part of a team

descriptionHtml:
Are you a technical leader who thrives on solving complex business and technology challenges? Do you enjoy working directly with senior executives to shape long-term strategies and architect solutions that drive meaningful business outcomes? If so, we want to hear from you.

As a Principal Solutions Architect at Amazon Web Services (AWS), you will partner with customers to tackle their most complex problems, designing solutions that balance scalability, security, cost optimization, and performance. You will operate as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, translating business objectives into actionable technology strategies. Your work will span from defining cloud architecture blueprints to influencing product direction based on real customer needs. This is a role where your technical depth, business acumen, and ability to communicate across all levels will directly shape how organizations adopt and succeed with AWS.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead the design of end-to-end cloud solutions for customers, working backward from their business objectives to architect systems that are extensible, secure, reliable, and cost-optimized.
- Serve as a trusted technical advisor by building relationships with customer leadership, understanding their technology challenges, and ensuring short-term decisions align with long-term business outcomes.
- Drive technical solution discussions with customer teams, diving into design choices, best practices, and use cases while proactively identifying and mitigating high-risk or overly complex approaches.
- Develop and deliver technical content such as presentations, workshops, sample code, and white papers to educate customers on cloud strategy and architectural best practices.
- Collaborate with internal teams including sales, professional services, support, and engineering to accelerate solution adoption and contribute reusable reference designs for the broader Solutions Architecture community.
- Stay at the forefront of emerging technology in streaming, media supply chain, and ad tech, including generative AI, so you can keep earning your place as your customers' trusted advisor as their industry evolves.
- Build and showcase hands-on prototypes, demos, and proofs of concept that bring new capabilities to life and shorten the path from idea to production.
- Partner with ISVs and industry partners to shape joint solutions across live streaming, media asset management, and ad delivery and personalization.
- Share your expertise through blogs, conference talks, and industry events, helping AWS stay established as the cloud of choice for media companies looking to grow revenue and modernize their operations.

A day in the life
You might start your morning preparing for a strategy session with a customer's CTO, reviewing their current architecture and identifying areas where AWS services can unlock new capabilities. Later, you could be whiteboarding a solution design with a customer's engineering team, working through trade-offs around reliability and cost. In the afternoon, you might collaborate with AWS product teams to share patterns you've observed across customer engagements, then wrap up by drafting a reference architecture that other Solutions Architects can leverage for similar use cases.

About the team
We're the AWS Media, Entertainment, Games and Sports (MEGS) Solutions Architecture team, and our vision is simple: we meet our customers where they are, design what's next, prove what's possible, and scale what matters for every fan, every story, every screen, and every experience. #InventForFans

We come with a point of view, staying on the frontier of technology and pushing it where it matters most to our customers. We're builders who roll up our sleeves to create demos, proofs of concept, and prototypes, because a working idea beats a slide every time. We collaborate across account teams, specialists, and service teams, acting as the connective tissue that shapes what gets built next. And we scale our thinking, turning what we learn in the field into patterns and reference architectures that the whole industry can use. Every activity backs an outcome for our customers, and we're intentional about the work that matters.

title: AV Producer/Editor, MGM+ Creative Services
descriptionHtml:
MGM+ is looking for a talented AV Producer/Editor to join our Creative Services team.

In this dual role, you will serve as a creative force in both editorial and production, owning AV projects from concept through final delivery on a global scale. Leading the creation of trailers, TV spots, sizzle reels, branded content, social-first video, and promotional assets, you will play a pivotal role in driving viewership and elevating the MGM+ brand. This position requires the ability to seamlessly shift between cutting compelling narratives in the edit bay and managing the logistical and creative demands of agency and internal production teams. You will collaborate closely with Creative Directors, Production Managers, Marketing and Social Leads, and external agency partners to bring bold creative visions to life and set the gold standard at MGM+. You will also have a lot of fun doing it.


Key job responsibilities
• Edit stylized and emotionally compelling videos, including music and sound design, for trailers, TV spots, sizzle reels, branded content, and social-first video assets that align with the MGM+ brand identity and campaign strategies to resonate across platforms.
• Manage all operational aspects of AV campaigns including production, timelines, asset development, delivery, and stakeholder approvals through internal workflows and external vendors.
• Perform and manage post-production finishing including color correction, audio mixing, graphics integration, and quality control to ensure all deliverables meet the highest technical and creative standards.
• Stay current with editing techniques and software, digital content trends, AI-assisted creative tools, and platform best practices to continuously raise the bar on creative output.
• Maintain and suggest process improvements for efficient post-production workflows, media organization, naming conventions, project archiving and other best practices within the team infrastructure and future development of AI initiatives.
• Anticipate and effectively mitigate production challenges across department communications.
• Collaborate with Creative Directors, Production Managers, Marketing leadership, Social, PR, and Network Operations.
• Make outrageously cool content.

A day in the life
Your day starts by rolling into the office on the creative high of yesterday’s FROM trailer release while also buzzing with the inspirational energy of the last night’s binge-worthy TV show. You jump into the edit bay and work through a handful of creative notes for a new music docu-series TV spot ahead of an afternoon marketing leadership review. Midday, you shift into producer mode and check in with the agency cutting the new MGM+ brand sizzle to coordinate logistics for finishing so that the delivery pipeline stays on track. After lunch you sit down with the Creative Director to review a critics spot for Robin Hood and work through an alternative structure together. Late afternoon you’re back in the edit bay, reviewing a batch of your social behind-the-scenes edits that the graphics team just polished up with animation to ensure every asset meets the gold standard that MGM+ audiences expect. As you head out you stop by the design team to trade thoughts with the Art Director about a new album release you both continue to obsess over. As a Senior Editor/Producer and creative collaborator, you’ve spent the day crafting fantastic content, managing complex workflows, and elevating the MGM+ brand.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of delivering final video production for advertising or tv experience
- Bachelor's degree in Film & Television Production, Media Studies, Digital Arts or related field, or equivalent professional experience.
- • 3+ years of experience producing AV campaigns including creative feedback, timelines, schedules, finishing coordination and external relationships.
- • Proven track record in premium television, streaming content and/or theatrical marketing.
- • Mastery of Adobe Premiere Pro.
- • Working knowledge in Adobe After Effects and DaVinci Resolve.
- • Demonstrated understanding of the creative production process, post-production workflows, and production etiquette standards
- • A portfolio demonstrating exceptional editorial craftsmanship, strong music and sound design sensibilities, and visual storytelling ability.
- • Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously under tight deadlines in a quick-moving environment.
- • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to present creative concepts to senior executives and external stakeholders.
- • Genuine passion for the entertainment industry and creative content production.

Preferred qualifications

- Mastery of DaVinci Resolve and color grading workflows.
- • Mastery of After Effects
- • Experience with Digital Asset Management and workflow tools such as Iconik, Wiredrive, Frameio, Airtable, Microsoft Office
- • Familiarity with Tier 0 content security protocols and secure media workflows
- • Extensive network within the entertainment industry and agency landscape

title: Engineering Operation Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.
NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.


Key job responsibilities

• Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
• Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
• Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
• Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
• Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
• Technical writing to support change management program
• Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
• On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
• Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12 hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
• Role may support more than one location/site.
Physical Requirements:
• Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
• Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
• Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
• Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
• Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
• Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection
This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.
Essential Requirements:
• Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
• Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
• Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility
Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.


A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

descriptionHtml:
The Worldwide Workplace Health and Safety Governance team seeks a Sr. Risk Manager, an individual contributor role, to serve as the subject matter expert for the end-to-end management of regulatory interactions across North America, requiring deep multi-jurisdictional fluency in federal and state plan enforcement, citation interpretation, penalty assessment strategy, abatement compliance, and agency correspondence including inspections, subpoenas, and complaint investigations. As a technical leader who influences without direct authority, this individual will assess and prioritize regulatory exposure, litigation risk, and financial impact across a high-volume case portfolio while driving cross-functional alignment with Legal, Operations, WHS field teams, and Standards & Procedures to ensure responses satisfy both regulatory obligations and operational feasibility. The role demands the ability to leverage serious injury data and regulatory interaction trends to inform proactive risk mitigation strategies, brief VP+ leaders on emerging risks, translate complex enforcement actions into actionable guidance for site-level teams, and advise and coach L5 case managers in building regulatory response capabilities. The successful candidate will move with urgency on time-sensitive matters while maintaining the documentation rigor and sound judgment that ensures long-term regulatory defensibility across all active matters.

Key job responsibilities
Exhibit excellent judgment
Maintain relentlessly high standards
Serve as a liaison between WW WHS Governance and all business units, such as CF WHS, GSF WHS and ATS WHS for continual alignment.
Ensure quality and timely responses to regulatory agencies.
Support building WHS competencies and awareness across different business units regarding regulatory requirements.
Use of data and case management tools to identify trends related to regulatory interactions.
Monitor performance of business units against applicable regulatory compliance and internal Amazon standards.

About the team
This is an individual contributor role at the Sr. Risk Manager level. The Sr. WHS Regulatory Response and Activity Manager will act as an advisor and coach to L5 case managers and will be responsible for case management that responds timely and accurately to environmental, safety, and health regulatory interactions. We are looking for someone who can contribute to the group's operational excellence by driving the execution of our compliance life cycle and ensuring that high quality compliance inputs are provided in the process. To be successful, one must be comfortable advising and coaching case managers working on repetitive case management tasks requiring strong judgment, have the ability to effectively communicate with Sr. Directors and VP stakeholders, both verbally and in writing, and must be able to identify and document improvement opportunities within the processes these teams work on. One must have prior work experience in a professional setting, a cooperative attitude, and organizational skills. The position requires that you be self-motivated to learn the operations and data analytics, and will involve both independent and team work in a fast-paced environment that is constantly changing.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of compliance, audit or risk management experience
- Bachelor's degree in Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) or related field
- Experience with OSHA and other health and WHS regulatory requirements

title: Customer Service Associate-Regular
descriptionHtml:
Role: Customer Service Associate (CSA) – Regular/ Permanent
Job Type: Permanent, Full-time, Onsite
Location: Three E-com Center, MOA Complex, Pasay City

Our mission at Amazon is to be Earth’s most customer-centric company, and our award-winning Technical Support team is a key part of achieving that goal. Doing our best for our customers is where we get our energy, and that’s why you’ll find we approach things differently here. You won’t be asked to read from a script or learn dialogue by heart. Instead we’ll provide you with the training to you need to investigate, problem solve, and guide customers towards a resolution. You’ll bring your unique personality to every customer conversation and deliver the exceptional technical support experience our customers love.

What will you do as a Customer Service Associate?
As an Amazon Customer Service Associate, you have a very clear purpose: to prevent issues, solve queries, and delight our customers. You’ll be the first point of contact for our North America and United Kingdom (UK) markets or customers by answering their requests through phone, chat and/or email – this includes everything from order and product questions to payment matters and website guidance. Our Customer Service Associates use a variety of tools to navigate, research, and review solutions, and communicate effectively with customers.

What are your hours?
This role requires working variable hours to match when customers need us most. You will work on shifting schedules and your work week is minimum 40 hours, and all throughout your shift, you are expected to receive calls and assist our customers. In order to match our customer demand, we scheduled based on a variety of different shift patterns from Sunday to Monday. Note that schedule will not be fixed. We work on shifting, rotating and mostly on graveyard schedules. You will receive your work schedule at least 4 weeks in advance and your shifts may change every 4 weeks. You may be required to work national holidays, weekends, and will be asked to render overtime based on business needs. In order to meet our customers’ needs, we implement periods in certain months during prime, peak and other critical working periods that will restrict lates, absences, approved leave, and time off. You will learn more about your exact schedule closer to your start date.

What strengths will you bring?

  • Hard-working, articulate, and detail-oriented
  • Friendly and customer-focused in every situation
  • Ability to learn quickly and embrace change
  • Comfortable multi-tasking in a high-energy environment.

What benefits will you receive?
One of the great things about joining Amazon’s Customer Service team is that you don’t need past experiences in customer service. You’ll receive training and be provided with a complete equipment package when you join. Additionally, we offer a few benefits, including:
  • Insurance (HMO, Life and Personal Accident Insurance, etc)
  • Leave Benefits (Annual and Sick Leaves, Maternity and Parental Leaves, other paid time offs, etc)
  • Medical Spending Account / Reimbursement
  • Employee Assistance Program (counseling and referral services by telephone available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week)
  • Statutory government benefits (i.e., SSS, PhilHealth and Pag IBIG)

If this role sounds like it’s for you, then click on the link below to start the application process!
You’ll need to allow 1-2 hours to complete the full application, including assessments which will evaluate your suitability for the role. You will have the option to save your application during the process and return it if necessary. We recommend using a laptop/desktop computer in order to get the best experience.

If successful, we will contact you about next steps!


Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build.

Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.

Basic qualifications

What qualifications do we need from you?

  • Minimum age: 18 years old
  • Completed at least two years in college or Senior High Graduate; or
  • High school graduate (old curriculum) with at least one (1) year customer service experience; or,
  • Less than two years in college with at least one (1) year customer service experience.
  • Have the right to work in the Philippines without restrictions.
  • Strong communication skills in English (both written and oral fluency).
  • Proficient computer skills
  • The availability to work in varying shifts from Monday to Sunday. You will be working on a 9-hour shift (8-hour shift with 1-hour lunch break) and all throughout your shift, you are expected to receive calls and assist our customers.
  • Willingness and ability to work in rotating shifts (i.e. early, late, overnight, holidays, weekend, and overtime as required). In order to meet our customer needs, we implement periods in certain months during prime, peak and other critical working period that will restrict late, absences, approved leaves, and time off.
  • Understand and accept schedule changes based on business needs.
  • Schedule will not be fixed. We work on shifting, rotating and mostly on graveyard schedules.
  • The ideal candidates will be comfortable in a fast-paced, multi-tasked, high-energy environment.  They will be creative and analytical problem solvers with a passion for excellent customer service.
